WITH bundles AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_bundles
), components AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_bundle_components
), price_history AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_price_history
), current_prices AS (
  SELECT
    ph.sku,
    ph.currency_code,
    ph.list_amount_minor
  FROM price_history AS ph
  WHERE
    ph.effective_valid_to IS NULL
), required_components AS (
  SELECT
    c.bundle_sku,
    c.component_sku,
    c.quantity
  FROM components AS c
  WHERE
    NOT c.is_optional
), priced_components AS (
  SELECT
    rc.bundle_sku,
    cp.currency_code,
    rc.quantity * cp.list_amount_minor AS extended_minor,
    cp.list_amount_minor AS unit_list_minor
  FROM required_components AS rc
  INNER JOIN current_prices AS cp
    ON rc.component_sku = cp.sku
), component_counts AS (
  SELECT
    rc.bundle_sku,
    COUNT(*) AS component_count
  FROM required_components AS rc
  GROUP BY
    rc.bundle_sku
), totals AS (
  SELECT
    pc.bundle_sku,
    pc.currency_code,
    COUNT(*) AS priced_count,
    SUM(pc.extended_minor) AS components_list_minor,
    MIN(pc.unit_list_minor) AS cheapest_unit_minor
  FROM priced_components AS pc
  GROUP BY
    pc.bundle_sku,
    pc.currency_code
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      t.bundle_sku || ':' || t.currency_code
    ) AS STRING) AS bundle_price_key,
    t.bundle_sku,
    t.currency_code,
    CAST(cc.component_count AS INT) AS component_count,
    CAST(t.components_list_minor AS INT) AS components_list_minor,
    CAST(CASE b.pricing_mode
      WHEN 'fixed'
      THEN IF(b.pricing_currency_code = t.currency_code, b.fixed_amount_minor, NULL)
      WHEN 'percent_off'
      THEN ROUND(t.components_list_minor * (
        1 - b.percent_off / 100
      ))
      WHEN 'cheapest_free'
      THEN t.components_list_minor - t.cheapest_unit_minor
    END AS INT) AS bundle_price_minor,
    CAST((
      t.components_list_minor - CASE b.pricing_mode
        WHEN 'fixed'
        THEN IF(b.pricing_currency_code = t.currency_code, b.fixed_amount_minor, NULL)
        WHEN 'percent_off'
        THEN ROUND(t.components_list_minor * (
          1 - b.percent_off / 100
        ))
        WHEN 'cheapest_free'
        THEN t.components_list_minor - t.cheapest_unit_minor
      END
    ) AS INT) AS saving_minor,
    CAST(ROUND(
      100 * (
        1 - CASE b.pricing_mode
          WHEN 'fixed'
          THEN IF(b.pricing_currency_code = t.currency_code, b.fixed_amount_minor, NULL)
          WHEN 'percent_off'
          THEN ROUND(t.components_list_minor * (
            1 - b.percent_off / 100
          ))
          WHEN 'cheapest_free'
          THEN t.components_list_minor - t.cheapest_unit_minor
        END / NULLIF(t.components_list_minor, 0)
      ),
      4
    ) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS saving_pct,
    (
      t.priced_count < cc.component_count
    ) AS has_unpriced_component
  FROM totals AS t
  INNER JOIN bundles AS b
    ON t.bundle_sku = b.bundle_sku
  INNER JOIN component_counts AS cc
    ON t.bundle_sku = cc.bundle_sku
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH RECURSIVE categories AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_categories
), tree AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.parent_category_id,
    c.slug,
    c.display_name,
    c.sort_order,
    1 AS depth,
    '/' || c.slug AS slug_path,
    c.category_id AS root_category_id
  FROM categories AS c
  WHERE
    c.is_root
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.parent_category_id,
    c.slug,
    c.display_name,
    c.sort_order,
    t.depth + 1 AS depth,
    t.slug_path || '/' || c.slug AS slug_path,
    t.root_category_id
  FROM tree AS t
  INNER JOIN categories AS c
    ON t.category_id = c.parent_category_id
), parents AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.parent_category_id
  FROM categories AS c
  WHERE
    NOT c.parent_category_id IS NULL
), final AS (
  SELECT
    t.category_id,
    t.parent_category_id,
    CAST(t.root_category_id AS STRING) AS root_category_id,
    t.slug,
    t.display_name,
    CAST(t.depth AS INT) AS depth,
    CAST(TRIM(LEADING '/' FROM t.slug_path) AS STRING) AS slug_path,
    (
      p.parent_category_id IS NULL
    ) AS is_leaf,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t.parent_category_id
      ORDER BY t.sort_order NULLS LAST, t.slug NULLS LAST
    ) AS INT) AS sibling_rank
  FROM tree AS t
  LEFT JOIN parents AS p
    ON t.category_id = p.parent_category_id
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH price_lists AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_price_lists
), ordered AS (
  SELECT
    p.price_list_id,
    p.sku,
    p.currency_code,
    p.list_amount_minor,
    p.valid_from,
    COALESCE(
      p.valid_to,
      LEAD(p.valid_from) OVER (
        PARTITION BY p.sku, p.currency_code
        ORDER BY p.valid_from NULLS LAST, p.price_list_id NULLS LAST
      )
    ) AS effective_valid_to,
    LAG(p.list_amount_minor) OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.sku, p.currency_code
      ORDER BY p.valid_from NULLS LAST, p.price_list_id NULLS LAST
    ) AS previous_amount_minor,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.sku, p.currency_code
      ORDER BY p.valid_from NULLS LAST, p.price_list_id NULLS LAST
    ) AS price_version,
    MIN(p.list_amount_minor) OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.sku, p.currency_code
      ORDER BY p.valid_from NULLS LAST
      RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30' DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS lowest_price_30d_minor
  FROM price_lists AS p
), final AS (
  SELECT
    o.price_list_id,
    o.sku,
    o.currency_code,
    o.list_amount_minor,
    o.valid_from,
    o.effective_valid_to,
    CAST(o.previous_amount_minor AS INT) AS previous_amount_minor,
    CAST(ROUND(
      100 * (
        o.list_amount_minor - o.previous_amount_minor
      ) / NULLIF(o.previous_amount_minor, 0),
      4
    ) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS change_pct,
    COALESCE(o.list_amount_minor < o.previous_amount_minor, FALSE) AS is_markdown,
    CAST(o.price_version AS INT) AS price_version,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(o.effective_valid_to, o.valid_from) AS INT) AS days_at_price,
    CAST(o.lowest_price_30d_minor AS INT) AS lowest_price_30d_minor
  FROM ordered AS o
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH variants AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_product_variants
), products AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_products
), brands AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_brands
), category_paths AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_category_paths
), media AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_product_media
), specs AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_product_specs_flat
), bundle_components AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_bundle_components
), leaf_categories AS (
  SELECT
    cp.category_id,
    cp.slug_path
  FROM category_paths AS cp
), images AS (
  SELECT
    m.product_id,
    MIN_BY(m.media_url, m.position) AS primary_image_url,
    COUNT(*) AS image_count
  FROM media AS m
  WHERE
    m.media_type = 'image'
  GROUP BY
    m.product_id
), component_skus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    bc.component_sku
  FROM bundle_components AS bc
), final AS (
  SELECT
    v.sku,
    v.product_id,
    CAST(UDF__SKU_FAMILY(v.sku) AS STRING) AS sku_family,
    p.title,
    CAST(NULLIF(
      CASE
        WHEN ' / ' IS NULL OR v.colour IS NULL OR v.size_label IS NULL
        THEN NULL
        ELSE CONCAT_WS(' / ', v.colour, v.size_label)
      END,
      ''
    ) AS STRING) AS variant_label,
    p.brand_code,
    b.brand_name,
    COALESCE(b.is_private_label, FALSE) AS is_private_label,
    lc.category_id,
    CAST(COALESCE(lc.slug_path, p.category_path) AS STRING) AS category_slug_path,
    p.category_level_1,
    s.material,
    v.weight_kg,
    CAST(i.primary_image_url AS STRING) AS primary_image_url,
    CAST(COALESCE(i.image_count, 0) AS INT) AS image_count,
    p.is_active,
    p.launched_on,
    (
      NOT cs.component_sku IS NULL
    ) AS is_bundle_component
  FROM variants AS v
  INNER JOIN products AS p
    ON v.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN brands AS b
    ON p.brand_code = b.brand_code
  LEFT JOIN leaf_categories AS lc
    ON p.category_path = lc.slug_path
  LEFT JOIN images AS i
    ON v.product_id = i.product_id
  LEFT JOIN specs AS s
    ON v.product_id = s.product_id
  LEFT JOIN component_skus AS cs
    ON v.sku = cs.component_sku
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH catalogue AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_product_catalogue
), price_history AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_price_history
), costs AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_supplier_cost_current
), fx_rates AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
), currencies AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__currencies
), current_prices AS (
  SELECT
    ph.sku,
    ph.currency_code,
    ph.list_amount_minor,
    CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE) AS valuation_date
  FROM price_history AS ph
  WHERE
    ph.effective_valid_to IS NULL
), with_exponent AS (
  SELECT
    cp.sku,
    cp.currency_code,
    cp.list_amount_minor,
    cp.valuation_date,
    c.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM current_prices AS cp
  INNER JOIN currencies AS c
    ON cp.currency_code = c.currency_code
), with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    w.sku,
    w.currency_code,
    w.list_amount_minor,
    w.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.usd_to_rate
  FROM with_exponent AS w
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM fx_rates AS fx
    WHERE
      w.currency_code = fx.currency_code AND w.valuation_date >= fx.rate_date
    ORDER BY
      fx.rate_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fx
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      r.sku || ':' || r.currency_code
    ) AS STRING) AS sku_price_key,
    r.sku,
    r.currency_code,
    CAST((
      CAST(ROUND(
        CAST((
          r.list_amount_minor / NULLIF((
            CAST(POWER(10, r.minor_unit_exponent) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
          ), 0)
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
        4
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS list_price,
    CAST(ROUND(c.unit_cost_usd * r.usd_to_rate, 4) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS unit_cost,
    CAST((
      (
        CAST(ROUND(
          CAST((
            r.list_amount_minor / NULLIF((
              CAST(POWER(10, r.minor_unit_exponent) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
            ), 0)
          ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
          4
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
      ) - ROUND(c.unit_cost_usd * r.usd_to_rate, 4)
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS unit_margin,
    CAST(ROUND(
      100 * (
        1 - ROUND(c.unit_cost_usd * r.usd_to_rate, 4) / NULLIF(
          CAST(ROUND(
            CAST((
              r.list_amount_minor / NULLIF((
                CAST(POWER(10, r.minor_unit_exponent) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
              ), 0)
            ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
            4
          ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
          0
        )
      ),
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(9, 2)) AS margin_pct,
    COALESCE(
      ROUND(c.unit_cost_usd * r.usd_to_rate, 4) > (
        CAST(ROUND(
          CAST((
            r.list_amount_minor / NULLIF((
              CAST(POWER(10, r.minor_unit_exponent) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
            ), 0)
          ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
          4
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
      ),
      FALSE
    ) AS is_below_cost,
    cat.category_level_1
  FROM with_rate AS r
  LEFT JOIN costs AS c
    ON r.sku = c.sku
  LEFT JOIN catalogue AS cat
    ON r.sku = cat.sku
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH products AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_products
), spec_entries AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(k.value AS STRING), '[^A-Za-z0-9]+', '_')) AS spec_key,
    TRY_ELEMENT_AT(FROM_JSON(TO_JSON(p.specs), 'MAP<STRING, VARIANT>'), CAST(k.value AS STRING)) AS spec_value
  FROM products AS p, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(CAST(JSON_OBJECT_KEYS(TO_JSON(p.specs)) AS VARIANT)) AS k
), typed_entries AS (
  SELECT
    e.product_id,
    e.spec_key,
    e.spec_value,
    SCHEMA_OF_VARIANT(e.spec_value) AS value_type,
    CASE
      WHEN (
        SCHEMA_OF_VARIANT(e.spec_value) IN ('TINYINT', 'SMALLINT', 'INT', 'BIGINT')
        OR SCHEMA_OF_VARIANT(e.spec_value) LIKE 'DECIMAL%'
      )
      OR SCHEMA_OF_VARIANT(e.spec_value) IN ('TINYINT', 'SMALLINT', 'INT', 'BIGINT')
      THEN CAST(e.spec_value AS DECIMAL(18, 4))
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(CAST(e.spec_value AS STRING), '(?i)^\\s*[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?\\s*(mm|cm|m)\\s*$')
      THEN CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAST(e.spec_value AS STRING), '[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?') AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) * DECODE(
        LOWER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAST(e.spec_value AS STRING), '(?i)(mm|cm|m)')),
        'mm',
        0.1,
        'm',
        100,
        1
      )
    END AS numeric_value
  FROM spec_entries AS e
), pivot_source AS (
  SELECT
    t.product_id,
    t.spec_key,
    t.spec_value
  FROM typed_entries AS t
  WHERE
    t.spec_key IN ('material', 'colour_family', 'dishwasher_safe')
), pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.material,
    p.colour_family,
    p.dishwasher_safe
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM pivot_source
    PIVOT(MAX(spec_value) FOR 
      spec_key IN (
        'material' AS `'material'`,
        'colour_family' AS `'colour_family'`,
        'dishwasher_safe' AS `'dishwasher_safe'`
      )
    )
  ) AS p(product_id, material, colour_family, dishwasher_safe)
), dimensions AS (
  SELECT
    t.product_id,
    MAX(IF(t.spec_key IN ('width', 'width_cm'), t.numeric_value, NULL)) AS width_cm,
    MAX(IF(t.spec_key IN ('height', 'height_cm'), t.numeric_value, NULL)) AS height_cm,
    MAX(IF(t.spec_key IN ('capacity', 'capacity_ml'), t.numeric_value, NULL)) AS capacity_ml,
    COUNT(t.numeric_value) AS numeric_spec_count,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(t.value_type)) AS spec_value_types
  FROM typed_entries AS t
  GROUP BY
    t.product_id
), leftovers AS (
  SELECT
    t.product_id,
    TO_VARIANT_OBJECT(
      MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(
        COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(t.spec_key, t.spec_value)) FILTER(WHERE
          NOT t.spec_key IS NULL AND NOT t.spec_value IS NULL)
      )
    ) AS other_specs
  FROM typed_entries AS t
  WHERE
    NOT t.spec_key IN (
      'material',
      'colour_family',
      'dishwasher_safe',
      'width',
      'width_cm',
      'height',
      'height_cm',
      'capacity',
      'capacity_ml'
    )
  GROUP BY
    t.product_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    CAST(INITCAP(CAST(pv.material AS STRING)) AS STRING) AS material,
    CAST(LOWER(CAST(pv.colour_family AS STRING)) AS STRING) AS colour_family,
    CAST(ROUND(d.width_cm, 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS width_cm,
    CAST(ROUND(d.height_cm, 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS height_cm,
    CAST(d.capacity_ml AS INT) AS capacity_ml,
    CAST(CAST(CAST(pv.dishwasher_safe AS STRING) AS BOOLEAN) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_dishwasher_safe,
    CAST(COALESCE(d.spec_value_types, ARRAY()) AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS spec_value_types,
    CAST(COALESCE(l.other_specs, PARSE_JSON('{}')) AS VARIANT) AS other_specs,
    CAST(COALESCE(d.numeric_spec_count, 0) AS INT) AS numeric_spec_count
  FROM products AS p
  LEFT JOIN pivoted AS pv
    ON p.product_id = pv.product_id
  LEFT JOIN dimensions AS d
    ON p.product_id = d.product_id
  LEFT JOIN leftovers AS l
    ON p.product_id = l.product_id
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH supplier_costs AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_supplier_costs
), suppliers AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_suppliers
), fx_rates AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
), currencies AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__currencies
), current_costs AS (
  SELECT
    c.cost_id,
    c.supplier_code,
    c.sku,
    c.currency_code,
    COALESCE(c.best_break_cost_minor, c.unit_cost_minor) AS unit_cost_minor,
    c.effective_from
  FROM supplier_costs AS c
  WHERE
    c.effective_to IS NULL OR c.effective_to >= CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE)
), with_exponent AS (
  SELECT
    cc.cost_id,
    cc.supplier_code,
    cc.sku,
    cc.currency_code,
    cc.unit_cost_minor,
    cc.effective_from,
    cur.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM current_costs AS cc
  INNER JOIN currencies AS cur
    ON cc.currency_code = cur.currency_code
), in_usd AS (
  SELECT
    w.cost_id,
    w.supplier_code,
    w.sku,
    w.currency_code,
    w.unit_cost_minor,
    w.effective_from,
    ROUND(
      (
        CAST(ROUND(
          CAST((
            w.unit_cost_minor / NULLIF((
              CAST(POWER(10, w.minor_unit_exponent) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
            ), 0)
          ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
          6
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
      ) * fx.rate_to_usd,
      4
    ) AS unit_cost_usd
  FROM with_exponent AS w
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM fx_rates AS fx
    WHERE
      w.currency_code = fx.currency_code AND w.effective_from >= fx.rate_date
    ORDER BY
      fx.rate_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fx
), per_sku AS (
  SELECT
    u.sku,
    MIN_BY(u.cost_id, u.unit_cost_usd) AS cheapest_cost_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.supplier_code) AS supplier_count,
    MAX(u.unit_cost_usd) AS max_cost_usd
  FROM in_usd AS u
  GROUP BY
    u.sku
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    p.sku,
    u.supplier_code,
    u.currency_code,
    u.unit_cost_minor,
    u.unit_cost_usd,
    u.effective_from,
    p.supplier_count,
    p.max_cost_usd
  FROM per_sku AS p
  INNER JOIN in_usd AS u
    ON p.cheapest_cost_id = u.cost_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    r.sku,
    r.supplier_code,
    s.supplier_name,
    r.currency_code,
    CAST(r.unit_cost_minor AS INT) AS unit_cost_minor,
    CAST(r.unit_cost_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS unit_cost_usd,
    r.effective_from,
    CAST(r.supplier_count AS INT) AS supplier_count,
    s.payment_terms_days,
    CAST(ROUND(100 * (
      r.max_cost_usd - r.unit_cost_usd
    ) / NULLIF(r.unit_cost_usd, 0), 2) AS DECIMAL(9, 2)) AS cost_spread_pct
  FROM ranked AS r
  LEFT JOIN suppliers AS s
    ON r.supplier_code = s.supplier_code
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH app_events AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_app_events
), device_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.device_id,
    e.customer_id,
    e.platform,
    e.app_major_version,
    e.event_name,
    e.event_at_utc,
    IF(
      COALESCE(
        DATEDIFF(
          MINUTE,
          DATE_TRUNC(
            'MINUTE',
            LAG(e.event_at_utc) OVER (
              PARTITION BY e.device_id
              ORDER BY e.event_at_utc NULLS LAST, e.event_id NULLS LAST
            )
          ),
          DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', e.event_at_utc)
        ),
        999
      ) > 30,
      1,
      0
    ) AS starts_session
  FROM app_events AS e
  WHERE
    NOT e.device_id IS NULL AND NOT e.event_at_utc IS NULL
), numbered AS (
  SELECT
    d.device_id,
    d.customer_id,
    d.platform,
    d.app_major_version,
    d.event_name,
    d.event_at_utc,
    d.starts_session,
    SUM(d.starts_session) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.device_id
      ORDER BY d.event_at_utc NULLS LAST, d.event_id NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS session_number
  FROM device_events AS d
), sessions AS (
  SELECT
    n.device_id,
    MAX(n.customer_id) AS customer_id,
    ANY_VALUE(n.platform) AS platform,
    MAX(n.app_major_version) AS app_major_version,
    MIN(n.event_at_utc) AS session_start_utc,
    MAX(n.event_at_utc) AS session_end_utc,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT_IF(n.event_name = 'screen_view') AS screen_count,
    BOOL_OR(n.starts_session = 1 AND n.event_name = 'push_open') AS started_from_push
  FROM numbered AS n
  GROUP BY
    n.device_id,
    n.session_number
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      s.device_id || ':' || DATE_FORMAT(s.session_start_utc, 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')
    ) AS STRING) AS app_session_id,
    s.device_id,
    CAST(s.customer_id AS STRING) AS customer_id,
    CAST(s.platform AS STRING) AS platform,
    CAST(s.app_major_version AS INT) AS app_major_version,
    s.session_start_utc,
    s.session_end_utc,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(
      SECOND,
      DATE_TRUNC('SECOND', s.session_start_utc),
      DATE_TRUNC('SECOND', s.session_end_utc)
    ) AS INT) AS duration_seconds,
    CAST(s.event_count AS INT) AS event_count,
    CAST(s.screen_count AS INT) AS screen_count,
    CAST(s.started_from_push AS BOOLEAN) AS started_from_push
  FROM sessions AS s

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_web_sessions
), web_events AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_web_events
), checkout_steps AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_web_checkout_steps
), cart_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.anonymous_id,
    e.event_at_utc,
    e.event_type,
    FILTER(e.items, i -> NOT i:sku IS NULL AND COALESCE(CAST(i:quantity AS INT), 1) > 0) AS valid_items
  FROM web_events AS e
  WHERE
    e.event_type IN ('add_to_cart', 'remove_from_cart')
), session_cart AS (
  SELECT
    s.session_id,
    COLLECT_LIST(IF(c.event_type = 'add_to_cart', c.valid_items, NULL)) AS added_item_lists,
    SUM(
      IF(c.event_type = 'remove_from_cart', SIZE(CAST(c.valid_items AS ARRAY<VARIANT>)), 0)
    ) AS removed_sku_count,
    SUM(
      IF(c.event_type = 'add_to_cart', 1, -1) * AGGREGATE(
        TRANSFORM(CAST(c.valid_items AS ARRAY<VARIANT>), i -> COALESCE(CAST(i:quantity AS INT), 1)),
        0,
        (acc, q) -> acc + q
      )
    ) AS net_units,
    MAX(
      ARRAY_MAX(
        TRANSFORM(CAST(c.valid_items AS ARRAY<VARIANT>), i -> CAST(i:price_minor AS INT))
      )
    ) AS max_added_unit_minor
  FROM sessions AS s
  INNER JOIN cart_events AS c
    ON s.anonymous_id = c.anonymous_id
    AND c.event_at_utc BETWEEN s.session_start_utc AND s.session_end_utc
  GROUP BY
    s.session_id
), session_checkout AS (
  SELECT
    s.session_id,
    MAX(cs.step_number) AS max_step
  FROM sessions AS s
  INNER JOIN checkout_steps AS cs
    ON s.anonymous_id = cs.anonymous_id
    AND cs.first_reached_at_utc BETWEEN s.session_start_utc AND s.session_end_utc
  GROUP BY
    s.session_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    s.session_id,
    s.anonymous_id,
    s.session_start_utc,
    CAST(ARRAY_SORT(
      ARRAY_DISTINCT(
        TRANSFORM(
          CAST(FLATTEN(COALESCE(sc.added_item_lists, ARRAY())) AS ARRAY<VARIANT>),
          i -> UPPER(CAST(i:sku AS STRING))
        )
      )
    ) /* ARRAY_AGG and ARRAY_DISTINCT leave element order unspecified; sort for a stable result. */ AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS added_skus,
    CAST(COALESCE(sc.removed_sku_count, 0) AS INT) AS removed_sku_count,
    CAST(COALESCE(sc.net_units, 0) AS INT) AS net_units,
    CAST(sc.max_added_unit_minor AS INT) AS max_added_unit_minor,
    (
      COALESCE(ck.max_step, 0) >= 1
    ) AS reached_checkout,
    (
      COALESCE(ck.max_step, 0) >= 3
    ) AS reached_payment,
    s.has_order AS converted,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN s.has_order
      THEN 'order'
      WHEN COALESCE(ck.max_step, 0) >= 3
      THEN 'payment'
      WHEN COALESCE(ck.max_step, 0) >= 1
      THEN 'checkout'
      WHEN s.has_add_to_cart
      THEN 'cart'
      ELSE 'browse'
    END AS STRING) AS funnel_stage
  FROM sessions AS s
  LEFT JOIN session_cart AS sc
    ON s.session_id = sc.session_id
  LEFT JOIN session_checkout AS ck
    ON s.session_id = ck.session_id
)

FROM final

WITH web_identities AS (

    *
  FROM rel__stg_web_identifies
), app_events AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_app_events
), web_links AS (

    CAST(w.anonymous_id AS STRING) AS identifier,

    CAST(w.first_seen_at_utc AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS first_seen_at_utc
  FROM web_identities AS w
), app_links AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.customer_id AS STRING) AS customer_id,
    CAST(a.device_id AS STRING) AS identifier,
    CAST(a.platform AS STRING) AS platform,
    CAST(MIN(a.event_at_utc) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS first_seen_at_utc
  FROM app_events AS a
  WHERE
    NOT a.customer_id IS NULL AND NOT a.device_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    a.customer_id,
    a.device_id,
    a.platform
), all_links AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(wl.customer_id AS STRING) AS customer_id,
    CAST(wl.identifier AS STRING) AS identifier,
    CAST(wl.platform AS STRING) AS platform,
    CAST(wl.first_seen_at_utc AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS first_seen_at_utc
  FROM web_links AS wl
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(al.customer_id AS STRING) AS customer_id,
    CAST(al.identifier AS STRING) AS identifier,
    CAST(al.platform AS STRING) AS platform,
    CAST(al.first_seen_at_utc AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS first_seen_at_utc
  FROM app_links AS al
), per_platform AS (
  SELECT
    l.customer_id,
    l.platform,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(l.identifier)) AS identifiers,
    MIN(l.first_seen_at_utc) AS first_seen_at_utc
  FROM all_links AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.customer_id,
    l.platform
), final AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,
    CAST(SUM(IF(p.platform = 'web', SIZE(CAST(p.identifiers AS ARRAY<VARIANT>)), 0)) AS INT) AS web_visitor_count,
    CAST(SUM(IF(p.platform <> 'web', SIZE(CAST(p.identifiers AS ARRAY<VARIANT>)), 0)) AS INT) AS app_device_count,
    CAST(ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_LIST(p.platform)) AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS platforms,
    (
      SUM(SIZE(CAST(p.identifiers AS ARRAY<VARIANT>))) > 1
    ) AS is_multi_device,
    MIN(p.first_seen_at_utc) AS first_seen_at_utc,
    TO_VARIANT_OBJECT(
      MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(
        COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(p.platform, CAST(p.identifiers AS VARIANT))) FILTER(WHERE
          NOT p.platform IS NULL AND NOT CAST(p.identifiers AS VARIANT) IS NULL)
      )
    ) AS identity_graph
  FROM per_platform AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.customer_id
)

WITH email_events AS (

    *
  FROM rel__stg_email_events
), customers AS (

    *
  FROM rel__stg_customers
), campaigns AS (

    *

), email_accounts AS (

  FROM customers AS c
  WHERE
    NOT c.email_normalised IS NULL

), per_message AS (

    e.message_id,
    MAX(e.campaign_id) AS campaign_id,
    MAX(e.recipient_email) AS recipient_email,
    MIN(IF(e.event_type = 'sent', e.occurred_at, NULL)) AS sent_at,
    BOOL_OR(e.event_type = 'delivered') AS is_delivered,
    MAX(e.bounce_type) AS bounce_type,
    COUNT_IF(e.event_type = 'open' AND NOT COALESCE(e.is_machine_open, FALSE)) AS human_open_count,
    COUNT_IF(e.event_type = 'click') AS click_count,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(LOWER(CAST(PARSE_URL(e.clicked_url, 'HOST') AS STRING)))) AS clicked_domains,
    BOOL_OR(e.event_type = 'unsubscribe') AS unsubscribed,

    MIN(IF(e.event_type = 'click', e.occurred_at, NULL)) AS first_click_at
  FROM email_events AS e
  GROUP BY
    e.message_id
), with_context AS (
  SELECT
    p.message_id,
    p.campaign_id,
    p.recipient_email,
    p.sent_at,
    p.is_delivered,
    p.bounce_type,
    p.human_open_count,
    p.click_count,
    p.clicked_domains,
    p.unsubscribed,
    p.complained,
    p.first_click_at,
    a.customer_id,
    c.channel AS campaign_channel,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', p.sent_at) AS DATE) BETWEEN c.starts_on AND COALESCE(c.ends_on, CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE)) AS is_campaign_in_flight
  FROM per_message AS p
  LEFT JOIN email_accounts AS a
    ON p.recipient_email = a.email_normalised
  LEFT JOIN campaigns AS c
    ON p.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    p.message_id,
    CAST(p.campaign_id AS STRING) AS campaign_id,
    CAST(p.recipient_email AS STRING) AS recipient_email,
    p.sent_at,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.is_delivered, FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_delivered,
    CAST(p.bounce_type AS STRING) AS bounce_type,
    CAST(p.human_open_count AS INT) AS human_open_count,
    CAST(p.click_count AS INT) AS click_count,
    CAST(p.clicked_domains AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS clicked_domains,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.unsubscribed, FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS unsubscribed,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.complained, FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS complained,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', p.sent_at), DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', p.first_click_at)) AS INT) AS minutes_to_first_click,
    CAST(p.customer_id AS STRING) AS customer_id,
    CAST(p.campaign_channel AS STRING) AS campaign_channel,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.is_campaign_in_flight, FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_campaign_in_flight
  FROM with_context AS p

WITH assignments AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_experiment_assignments
), sessions AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_web_sessions
), assigned AS (
  SELECT
    a.assignment_id,
    a.experiment_key,
    a.variant_key,
    a.anonymous_id,
    a.assignment_surface,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', a.assigned_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS assigned_at_utc
  FROM assignments AS a
), after_assignment AS (
  SELECT
    x.assignment_id,
    COUNT(s.session_id) AS sessions_after,
    MIN(IF(s.has_order, s.session_start_utc, NULL)) AS first_order_session_utc
  FROM assigned AS x
  LEFT JOIN sessions AS s
    ON x.anonymous_id = s.anonymous_id AND s.session_start_utc >= x.assigned_at_utc
  GROUP BY
    x.assignment_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    x.assignment_id,
    x.experiment_key,
    x.variant_key,
    (
      x.variant_key IN ('control', 'a', 'baseline')
    ) AS is_control,
    x.anonymous_id,
    x.assigned_at_utc,
    CAST(COALESCE(f.sessions_after, 0) AS INT) AS sessions_after,
    (
      NOT f.first_order_session_utc IS NULL
    ) AS converted,
    CAST(ROUND(
      DATEDIFF(
        MINUTE,
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', x.assigned_at_utc),
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', f.first_order_session_utc)
      ) / 1440,
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS days_to_convert,
    x.assignment_surface
  FROM assigned AS x

WITH product_views AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_web_product_views
), visitor_views AS (
  SELECT
    v.anonymous_id,
    v.sku,
    v.viewed_minute_utc,
    DATEADD(HOUR, 1, v.viewed_minute_utc) AS window_end_utc
  FROM product_views AS v
), pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    a.anonymous_id,
    a.sku,
    b.sku AS co_viewed_sku
  FROM visitor_views AS a
  INNER JOIN visitor_views AS b
    ON a.anonymous_id = b.anonymous_id
    AND a.sku <> b.sku
    AND b.viewed_minute_utc BETWEEN a.viewed_minute_utc AND a.window_end_utc
), pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.sku,
    p.co_viewed_sku,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.anonymous_id) AS co_viewers
  FROM pairs AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.sku,
    p.co_viewed_sku
), sku_counts AS (
  SELECT
    v.sku,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.anonymous_id) AS sku_viewers
  FROM visitor_views AS v
  GROUP BY
    v.sku
), visitor_total AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.anonymous_id) AS total_viewers
  FROM visitor_views AS v
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      pc.sku || '>' || pc.co_viewed_sku
    ) AS STRING) AS sku_pair_key,
    pc.sku,
    pc.co_viewed_sku,
    CAST(pc.co_viewers AS INT) AS co_viewers,
    CAST(a.sku_viewers AS INT) AS sku_viewers,
    CAST(ROUND(pc.co_viewers / NULLIF(a.sku_viewers, 0), 6) AS DECIMAL(9, 6)) AS co_view_rate,
    CAST(ROUND(
      (
        pc.co_viewers / NULLIF(a.sku_viewers, 0)
      ) / NULLIF(b.sku_viewers / NULLIF(t.total_viewers, 0), 0),
      4
    ) AS DECIMAL(12, 4)) AS lift,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.sku ORDER BY pc.co_viewers DESC NULLS FIRST) AS INT) AS pair_rank
  FROM pair_counts AS pc
  INNER JOIN sku_counts AS a
    ON pc.sku = a.sku
  INNER JOIN sku_counts AS b
    ON pc.co_viewed_sku = b.sku
  CROSS JOIN visitor_total AS t
)

WITH search_log AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_search_queries
), web_searches AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_web_searches
), product_views AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_web_product_views
), all_searches AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(q.query_id AS STRING) AS search_key,
    CAST(q.anonymous_id AS STRING) AS anonymous_id,
    CAST(q.query_text AS STRING) AS search_term,
    CAST(q.results_count AS INT) AS result_count,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', q.searched_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS searched_at_utc,
    CAST(q.filter_category AS STRING) AS filter_category
  FROM search_log AS q
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(w.event_id AS STRING) AS search_key,
    CAST(w.anonymous_id AS STRING) AS anonymous_id,
    CAST(w.search_term AS STRING) AS search_term,
    CAST(w.result_count AS INT) AS result_count,
    CAST(w.searched_at_utc AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS searched_at_utc,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS filter_category
  FROM web_searches AS w
), search_windows AS (
  SELECT
    s.search_key,
    s.anonymous_id,
    s.searched_at_utc,
    DATEADD(MINUTE, 10, s.searched_at_utc) AS window_end_utc
  FROM all_searches AS s
), followed AS (
  SELECT
    w.search_key,
    COUNT(v.product_view_key) > 0 AS has_view
  FROM search_windows AS w
  LEFT JOIN product_views AS v
    ON w.anonymous_id = v.anonymous_id
    AND v.viewed_minute_utc BETWEEN w.searched_at_utc AND w.window_end_utc
  GROUP BY
    w.search_key
), by_term AS (
  SELECT
    s.search_term,
    COUNT(*) AS search_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.anonymous_id) AS searching_visitors,
    COUNT_IF(COALESCE(s.result_count, 0) = 0) AS zero_result_count,
    COUNT_IF(f.has_view) AS viewed_count,
    AVG(s.result_count) AS avg_results,
    MODE(s.filter_category) AS top_filter_category,
    MIN(s.searched_at_utc) AS first_searched_at_utc
  FROM all_searches AS s
  INNER JOIN followed AS f
    ON s.search_key = f.search_key
  WHERE
    NOT s.search_term IS NULL AND s.search_term <> ''
  GROUP BY
    s.search_term
), final AS (
  SELECT
    b.search_term,
    CAST(b.search_count AS INT) AS search_count,
    CAST(b.searching_visitors AS INT) AS searching_visitors,
    CAST(ROUND(b.zero_result_count / b.search_count, 4) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS zero_result_rate,
    CAST(ROUND(b.viewed_count / b.search_count, 4) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS view_after_search_rate,
    CAST(ROUND(b.avg_results, 2) AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS avg_results,
    CAST(b.top_filter_category AS STRING) AS top_filter_category,
    b.first_searched_at_utc
  FROM by_term AS b
)

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_web_sessions
), channel_mapping AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__channel_mapping
), parsed AS (
  SELECT
    s.session_id,
    s.anonymous_id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.session_start_utc,
    s.referrer_host,
    LOWER(CAST(PARSE_URL(s.landing_page_url, 'QUERY', 'utm_source') AS STRING)) AS utm_source,
    LOWER(
      COALESCE(
        CAST(PARSE_URL(s.landing_page_url, 'QUERY', 'utm_medium') AS STRING),
        TRY_ELEMENT_AT(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(s.landing_page_url, '[?&]utm_medium=([^&#]+)', 1), 1)
      )
    ) AS utm_medium,
    LOWER(
      TRY_ELEMENT_AT(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(s.landing_page_url, '[?&]utm_campaign=([^&#]+)', 1), 1)
    ) AS utm_campaign
  FROM sessions AS s
), exact_matches AS (
  SELECT
    p.session_id,
    MIN(m.channel_code) AS channel_code,
    BOOL_OR(m.is_paid) AS is_paid
  FROM parsed AS p
  INNER JOIN channel_mapping AS m
    ON p.utm_source = m.utm_source AND p.utm_medium = m.utm_medium
  GROUP BY
    p.session_id
), medium_matches AS (
  SELECT
    p.session_id,
    MIN(m.channel_code) AS channel_code,
    BOOL_OR(m.is_paid) AS is_paid
  FROM parsed AS p
  INNER JOIN channel_mapping AS m
    ON p.utm_medium = m.utm_medium
  WHERE
    m.utm_source = '-'
  GROUP BY
    p.session_id
), classified AS (
  SELECT
    p.session_id,
    p.anonymous_id,
    p.customer_id,
    p.session_start_utc,
    p.utm_source,
    p.utm_medium,
    p.utm_campaign,
    COALESCE(
      e.channel_code,
      mm.channel_code,
      IF(p.referrer_host IS NULL OR p.referrer_host LIKE '%duckshop%', 'DIRECT', 'REFERRAL')
    ) AS channel_code,
    COALESCE(e.is_paid, mm.is_paid, FALSE) AS is_paid
  FROM parsed AS p
  LEFT JOIN exact_matches AS e
    ON p.session_id = e.session_id
  LEFT JOIN medium_matches AS mm
    ON p.session_id = mm.session_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    c.session_id,
    c.anonymous_id,
    c.customer_id,
    c.session_start_utc,
    CAST(c.utm_source AS STRING) AS utm_source,
    CAST(c.utm_medium AS STRING) AS utm_medium,
    CAST(c.utm_campaign AS STRING) AS utm_campaign,
    CAST(c.channel_code AS STRING) AS channel_code,
    CAST(c.is_paid AS BOOLEAN) AS is_paid,
    CAST(FIRST_VALUE(c.channel_code) OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.anonymous_id
      ORDER BY c.session_start_utc NULLS LAST, c.session_id NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS STRING) AS first_touch_channel,
    CAST(LAST_VALUE(c.channel_code) OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.anonymous_id
      ORDER BY c.session_start_utc NULLS LAST, c.session_id NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS STRING) AS last_touch_channel,
    CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.anonymous_id
      ORDER BY c.session_start_utc NULLS LAST, c.session_id NULLS LAST
    ) AS INT) AS touch_number
  FROM classified AS c
)

WITH web_events AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_web_events
), human_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.anonymous_id,
    e.customer_id,
    e.event_type,
    e.event_at_utc,
    e.page_url,
    e.page_path,
    e.referrer_host,
    e.client_timezone
  FROM web_events AS e
  WHERE
    e.event_at_utc >= DATEADD(HOUR, -24, CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ))
    AND e.event_at_utc < DATEADD(HOUR, 24, CAST('2026-01-02 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ))
    AND NOT e.is_bot
    AND NOT e.anonymous_id IS NULL
), gaps AS (
  SELECT
    h.event_id,
    h.anonymous_id,
    h.customer_id,
    h.event_type,
    h.event_at_utc,
    h.page_url,
    h.page_path,
    h.referrer_host,
    h.client_timezone,
    IF(
      DATEDIFF(
        MINUTE,
        DATE_TRUNC(
          'MINUTE',
          LAG(h.event_at_utc) OVER (
            PARTITION BY h.anonymous_id
            ORDER BY h.event_at_utc NULLS LAST, h.event_id NULLS LAST
          )
        ),
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', h.event_at_utc)
      ) <= 30,
      0,
      1
    ) AS is_session_start
  FROM human_events AS h
), numbered AS (
  SELECT
    g.anonymous_id,
    g.customer_id,
    g.event_type,
    g.event_at_utc,
    g.page_url,
    g.page_path,
    g.referrer_host,
    g.client_timezone,
    SUM(g.is_session_start) OVER (
      PARTITION BY g.anonymous_id
      ORDER BY g.event_at_utc NULLS LAST, g.event_id NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS session_number
  FROM gaps AS g
), sessions AS (
  SELECT
    n.anonymous_id,
    MAX(n.customer_id) AS customer_id,
    MIN(n.event_at_utc) AS session_start_utc,
    MAX(n.event_at_utc) AS session_end_utc,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT_IF(n.event_type = 'page_view') AS page_view_count,
    MIN_BY(n.page_path, n.event_at_utc) AS landing_page_path,
    MAX_BY(n.page_path, n.event_at_utc) AS exit_page_path,
    MIN_BY(n.referrer_host, n.event_at_utc) AS referrer_host,
    MIN_BY(n.page_url, n.event_at_utc) AS landing_page_url,
    MIN_BY(n.client_timezone, n.event_at_utc) AS client_timezone,
    BOOL_OR(n.event_type = 'add_to_cart') AS has_add_to_cart,
    BOOL_OR(n.event_type = 'order_completed') AS has_order
  FROM numbered AS n
  GROUP BY
    n.anonymous_id,
    n.session_number
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      s.anonymous_id || ':' || DATE_FORMAT(s.session_start_utc, 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')
    ) AS STRING) AS session_id,
    s.anonymous_id,
    CAST(s.customer_id AS STRING) AS customer_id,
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', s.session_start_utc) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS session_day,
    s.session_start_utc,
    s.session_end_utc,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', COALESCE(s.client_timezone, 'UTC'), s.session_start_utc) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS session_start_visitor_local,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(
      SECOND,
      DATE_TRUNC('SECOND', s.session_start_utc),
      DATE_TRUNC('SECOND', s.session_end_utc)
    ) AS INT) AS duration_seconds,
    CAST(s.event_count AS INT) AS event_count,
    CAST(s.page_view_count AS INT) AS page_view_count,
    CAST(s.landing_page_path AS STRING) AS landing_page_path,
    CAST(s.exit_page_path AS STRING) AS exit_page_path,
    CAST(s.referrer_host AS STRING) AS referrer_host,
    CAST(s.landing_page_url AS STRING) AS landing_page_url,
    (
      s.page_view_count <= 1 AND s.event_count <= 1
    ) AS is_bounce,
    CAST(s.has_add_to_cart AS BOOLEAN) AS has_add_to_cart,
    CAST(s.has_order AS BOOLEAN) AS has_order
  FROM sessions AS s
  WHERE
    s.session_start_utc >= CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ)
    AND s.session_start_utc < CAST('2026-01-02 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ)
)

WITH consents AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_customer_consents
), current_consents AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.consent_type,
    c.is_granted,
    c.captured_at,
    c.is_legacy
  FROM consents AS c
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.customer_id, c.consent_type
      ORDER BY c.captured_at DESC NULLS FIRST, c.consent_id DESC NULLS FIRST
    ) = 1
), consent_matrix AS (
  SELECT
    cc.customer_id,
    cc.consent_type,
    cc.is_granted
  FROM current_consents AS cc
), pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,
    p.email_marketing,
    p.sms_marketing,
    p.personalisation,
    p.third_party_sharing
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM consent_matrix
    PIVOT(MAX(is_granted) FOR 
      consent_type IN (
        'EMAIL_MARKETING' AS `'EMAIL_MARKETING'`,
        'SMS_MARKETING' AS `'SMS_MARKETING'`,
        'PERSONALISATION' AS `'PERSONALISATION'`,
        'THIRD_PARTY_SHARING' AS `'THIRD_PARTY_SHARING'`
      )
    )
  ) AS p(customer_id, email_marketing, sms_marketing, personalisation, third_party_sharing)
), summary AS (
  SELECT
    cc.customer_id,
    TO_VARIANT_OBJECT(
      MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(
        COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(cc.consent_type, CAST(cc.is_granted AS VARIANT))) FILTER(WHERE
          NOT cc.consent_type IS NULL AND NOT CAST(cc.is_granted AS VARIANT) IS NULL)
      )
    ) AS consent_state,
    MAX(cc.captured_at) AS last_consent_change_at,
    BOOL_OR(cc.is_legacy) AS has_legacy_consent
  FROM current_consents AS cc
  GROUP BY
    cc.customer_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.email_marketing, FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS email_marketing,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.sms_marketing, FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS sms_marketing,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.personalisation, FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS personalisation,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.third_party_sharing, FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS third_party_sharing,
    CAST(s.consent_state AS VARIANT) AS consent_state,
    s.last_consent_change_at,
    CAST(s.has_legacy_consent AS BOOLEAN) AS has_legacy_consent
  FROM summary AS s
  LEFT JOIN pivoted AS p
    ON s.customer_id = p.customer_id
)

WITH customers AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_customers
), web_identities AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_web_identifies
), newsletter AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_newsletter_subscriptions
), tickets AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_tickets
), base AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.email_normalised,
    SPLIT_PART(c.email_normalised, '@', 2) AS email_domain,
    HASH(c.email_normalised) AS email_dedupe_key,
    c.phone_normalised,
    TRIM(
      CASE
        WHEN ' ' IS NULL OR c.first_name IS NULL OR c.last_name IS NULL
        THEN NULL
        ELSE CONCAT_WS(' ', c.first_name, c.last_name)
      END
    ) AS full_name
  FROM customers AS c
), anonymous_links AS (
  SELECT
    w.customer_id,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(w.anonymous_id)) AS anonymous_ids
  FROM web_identities AS w
  GROUP BY
    w.customer_id
), newsletter_links AS (
  SELECT
    b.customer_id,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(n.list_code)) AS newsletter_lists
  FROM base AS b
  INNER JOIN newsletter AS n
    ON b.email_normalised = n.email
  WHERE
    n.list_status = 'subscribed'
  GROUP BY
    b.customer_id
), ticket_links AS (
  SELECT
    b.customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_id) AS ticket_count
  FROM base AS b
  INNER JOIN tickets AS t
    ON b.email_normalised = t.customer_email
  GROUP BY
    b.customer_id
), shared_phone_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    a.customer_id,
    b.customer_id AS other_customer_id,
    CAST(ROUND(JARO_WINKLER_SIMILARITY(LOWER(a.full_name), LOWER(b.full_name)) * 100) AS INT) AS name_similarity
  FROM base AS a
  INNER JOIN base AS b
    ON a.phone_normalised = b.phone_normalised AND a.customer_id <> b.customer_id
), best_duplicate AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,
    MAX_BY(p.other_customer_id, p.name_similarity) AS other_customer_id,
    MAX(p.name_similarity) AS name_similarity
  FROM shared_phone_pairs AS p
  WHERE
    p.name_similarity >= 85
  GROUP BY
    p.customer_id
), email_collisions AS (
  SELECT
    b.email_dedupe_key,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_sharing_email
  FROM base AS b
  WHERE
    NOT b.email_normalised IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    b.email_dedupe_key
), final AS (
  SELECT
    b.customer_id,
    b.email_normalised,
    CAST(b.email_domain AS STRING) AS email_domain,
    CAST(b.email_dedupe_key AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS email_dedupe_key,
    b.phone_normalised,
    CAST(b.full_name AS STRING) AS full_name,
    CAST(COALESCE(a.anonymous_ids, ARRAY()) AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS anonymous_ids,
    CAST(SIZE(COALESCE(CAST(a.anonymous_ids AS ARRAY<VARIANT>), ARRAY())) AS INT) AS anonymous_id_count,
    CAST(COALESCE(n.newsletter_lists, ARRAY()) AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS newsletter_lists,
    CAST(COALESCE(t.ticket_count, 0) AS INT) AS ticket_count,
    CAST(d.other_customer_id AS STRING) AS duplicate_candidate_id,
    CAST(d.name_similarity AS INT) AS duplicate_name_similarity,
    CAST(COALESCE(e.accounts_sharing_email, 1) AS INT) AS accounts_sharing_email
  FROM base AS b
  LEFT JOIN anonymous_links AS a
    ON b.customer_id = a.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN newsletter_links AS n
    ON b.customer_id = n.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN ticket_links AS t
    ON b.customer_id = t.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN best_duplicate AS d
    ON b.customer_id = d.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN email_collisions AS e
    ON b.email_dedupe_key = e.email_dedupe_key
)

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
), valid_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.placed_at,
    o.placed_date_local,
    o.amount_usd,
    o.sales_channel
  FROM orders AS o
  WHERE
    NOT (
      order_status = 'CANCELLED'
    )
), sequenced AS (
  SELECT
    v.order_id,
    v.customer_id,
    v.placed_at,
    v.placed_date_local,
    v.amount_usd,
    v.sales_channel,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.customer_id ORDER BY v.placed_at NULLS LAST, v.order_id NULLS LAST) AS order_number,
    LAG(v.placed_date_local) OVER (PARTITION BY v.customer_id ORDER BY v.placed_at NULLS LAST, v.order_id NULLS LAST) AS previous_date,
    LAG(v.sales_channel) OVER (PARTITION BY v.customer_id ORDER BY v.placed_at NULLS LAST, v.order_id NULLS LAST) AS previous_sales_channel,
    SUM(v.amount_usd) OVER (
      PARTITION BY v.customer_id
      ORDER BY v.placed_at NULLS LAST, v.order_id NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS lifetime_revenue_usd,
    SUM(v.amount_usd) OVER (
      PARTITION BY v.customer_id
      ORDER BY v.placed_date_local NULLS LAST
      RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '89' DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS rolling_90d_revenue_usd,
    MIN(v.placed_date_local) OVER (PARTITION BY v.customer_id) AS first_order_date
  FROM valid_orders AS v
), final AS (
  SELECT
    s.order_id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.placed_at,
    s.placed_date_local,
    CAST(s.order_number AS INT) AS order_number,
    (
      s.order_number = 1
    ) AS is_first_order,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(s.placed_date_local, s.previous_date) AS INT) AS days_since_previous_order,
    s.amount_usd,
    CAST(s.lifetime_revenue_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS lifetime_revenue_usd,
    CAST(s.rolling_90d_revenue_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS rolling_90d_revenue_usd,
    CAST(s.previous_sales_channel AS STRING) AS previous_sales_channel,
    COALESCE(s.previous_sales_channel <> s.sales_channel, FALSE) AS is_channel_switch,
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', s.first_order_date) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM sequenced AS s
)

WITH order_sequence AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_customer_order_sequence
), as_of AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(o.placed_date_local) AS as_of_date
  FROM order_sequence AS o
), per_customer AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    MAX(o.placed_date_local) AS last_order_date,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    MAX(o.lifetime_revenue_usd) AS lifetime_revenue_usd
  FROM order_sequence AS o
  GROUP BY
    o.customer_id
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,
    p.last_order_date,
    DATEDIFF(a.as_of_date, p.last_order_date) AS days_since_last_order,
    p.order_count,
    p.lifetime_revenue_usd,
    6 - NTILE(5) OVER (
      ORDER BY DATEDIFF(a.as_of_date, p.last_order_date) NULLS LAST, p.customer_id NULLS LAST
    ) AS recency_score,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY p.order_count NULLS LAST, p.customer_id NULLS LAST) AS frequency_score,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY p.lifetime_revenue_usd NULLS LAST, p.customer_id NULLS LAST) AS monetary_score
  FROM per_customer AS p
  CROSS JOIN as_of AS a
), final AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    s.last_order_date,
    CAST(s.days_since_last_order AS INT) AS days_since_last_order,
    CAST(s.order_count AS INT) AS order_count,
    s.lifetime_revenue_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(s.lifetime_revenue_usd / NULLIF(s.order_count, 0), 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS average_order_usd,
    CAST(s.recency_score AS INT) AS recency_score,
    CAST(s.frequency_score AS INT) AS frequency_score,
    CAST(s.monetary_score AS INT) AS monetary_score,
    CAST((
      CAST(s.recency_score AS STRING) || CAST(s.frequency_score AS STRING) || CAST(s.monetary_score AS STRING)
    ) AS STRING) AS rfm_code,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN s.order_count = 1 AND s.recency_score >= 4
      THEN 'NEW'
      WHEN s.recency_score >= 4 AND s.frequency_score >= 4
      THEN 'CHAMPION'
      WHEN s.frequency_score >= 3 AND s.recency_score >= 3
      THEN 'LOYAL'
      WHEN s.recency_score >= 3
      THEN 'PROMISING'
      WHEN s.frequency_score >= 3
      THEN 'AT_RISK'
      ELSE 'HIBERNATING'
    END AS STRING) AS segment,
    (
      s.lifetime_revenue_usd >= 2500.00
    ) AS is_vip
  FROM scored AS s
)

WITH gift_cards AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_gift_cards
), transactions AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_gift_card_transactions
), fx_rates AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
), currencies AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__currencies
), movement AS (
  SELECT
    t.gift_card_id,
    SUM(IF(t.signed_amount_minor < 0, -t.signed_amount_minor, 0)) AS redeemed_minor,
    SUM(t.signed_amount_minor) AS net_movement_minor,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    MAX(t.occurred_at) AS last_used_at
  FROM transactions AS t
  GROUP BY
    t.gift_card_id
), balances AS (
  SELECT
    g.gift_card_id,
    g.currency_code,
    g.issued_at,
    g.expires_on,
    g.initial_amount_minor,
    COALESCE(m.redeemed_minor, 0) AS redeemed_minor,
    GREATEST(g.initial_amount_minor + COALESCE(m.net_movement_minor, 0), 0) AS balance_minor,
    COALESCE(m.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    m.last_used_at,
    c.minor_unit_exponent,
    CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE) AS valuation_date
  FROM gift_cards AS g
  INNER JOIN currencies AS c
    ON g.currency_code = c.currency_code
  LEFT JOIN movement AS m
    ON g.gift_card_id = m.gift_card_id
), valued AS (
  SELECT
    b.gift_card_id,
    b.currency_code,
    b.issued_at,
    b.expires_on,
    b.initial_amount_minor,
    b.redeemed_minor,
    b.balance_minor,
    b.transaction_count,
    b.last_used_at,
    b.minor_unit_exponent,
    b.valuation_date,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM balances AS b
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM fx_rates AS fx
    WHERE
      b.currency_code = fx.currency_code AND b.valuation_date >= fx.rate_date
    ORDER BY
      fx.rate_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fx
), final AS (
  SELECT
    v.gift_card_id,
    v.currency_code,
    v.issued_at,
    v.expires_on,
    CAST(ROUND(
      CAST((
        v.initial_amount_minor / NULLIF((
          CAST(POWER(10, v.minor_unit_exponent) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
        ), 0)
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
      3
    ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS initial_amount,
    CAST(ROUND(
      CAST((
        v.redeemed_minor / NULLIF((
          CAST(POWER(10, v.minor_unit_exponent) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
        ), 0)
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
      3
    ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS redeemed_amount,
    CAST(ROUND(
      CAST((
        v.balance_minor / NULLIF((
          CAST(POWER(10, v.minor_unit_exponent) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
        ), 0)
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
      3
    ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS balance_amount,
    CAST(ROUND(
      (
        CAST(ROUND(
          CAST((
            v.balance_minor / NULLIF((
              CAST(POWER(10, v.minor_unit_exponent) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
            ), 0)
          ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
          6
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
      ) * v.rate_to_usd,
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS balance_usd,
    CAST(v.transaction_count AS INT) AS transaction_count,
    v.last_used_at,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN v.balance_minor = 0
      THEN 'fully_redeemed'
      WHEN v.expires_on < v.valuation_date AND v.redeemed_minor = 0
      THEN 'expired_unused'
      WHEN v.expires_on < v.valuation_date
      THEN 'expired_partial'
      ELSE 'active'
    END AS STRING) AS liability_status
  FROM valued AS v
)

WITH ledger AS (

  FROM rel__stg_loyalty_ledger
), accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_loyalty_accounts
), postings AS (

    l.posted_at,
    l.points_delta,
    l.reason_code,
    l.expires_on,
    SUM(l.points_delta) OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.loyalty_account_id
      ORDER BY l.posted_at NULLS LAST, l.entry_id NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_points
  FROM ledger AS l
), expiry AS (
  SELECT
    p.entry_id,
    IF(p.points_delta > 0 AND p.expires_on < CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE), p.points_delta, 0) AS expiring_points
  FROM postings AS p
), final AS (
  SELECT
    p.entry_id,
    p.loyalty_account_id,
    a.customer_id,
    p.posted_at,
    p.points_delta,
    CAST(p.running_points AS INT) AS running_points,
    CAST(e.expiring_points AS INT) AS expiring_points,
    (
      e.expiring_points > 0
    ) AS is_expired,
    CAST(ROUND(p.running_points * 0.0100, 4) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS running_value_usd,
    p.reason_code,
    a.tier_code
  FROM postings AS p
  INNER JOIN expiry AS e
    ON p.entry_id = e.entry_id

    ON p.loyalty_account_id = a.loyalty_account_id

WITH accounts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_loyalty_accounts
), history AS (
  SELECT
    a.loyalty_account_id,
    a.customer_id,
    CAST(h.pos AS INT) AS change_sequence,
    UPPER(CAST(h.value:tier AS STRING)) AS tier_code,
    TRY_CAST(CAST(h.value:at AS STRING) AS TIMESTAMP) AS changed_at
  FROM accounts AS a, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(CAST(a.tier_history AS VARIANT)) AS h
), with_previous AS (
  SELECT
    h.loyalty_account_id,
    h.customer_id,
    h.change_sequence,
    h.tier_code,
    h.changed_at,
    LAG(h.tier_code) OVER (PARTITION BY h.loyalty_account_id ORDER BY h.change_sequence NULLS LAST) AS previous_tier_code,
    LAG(h.changed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY h.loyalty_account_id ORDER BY h.change_sequence NULLS LAST) AS previous_changed_at
  FROM history AS h
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      w.loyalty_account_id || ':' || CAST(w.change_sequence AS STRING)
    ) AS STRING) AS tier_change_key,
    w.loyalty_account_id,
    w.customer_id,
    w.change_sequence,
    CAST(w.tier_code AS STRING) AS tier_code,
    CAST(w.previous_tier_code AS STRING) AS previous_tier_code,
    w.changed_at,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN w.previous_tier_code IS NULL
      THEN 'enrol'
      WHEN DECODE(w.tier_code, 'DUCKLING', 1, 'DRAKE', 2, 'GOLDEN_DUCK', 3, 'PLATINUM_DUCK', 4, 0) > DECODE(w.previous_tier_code, 'DUCKLING', 1, 'DRAKE', 2, 'GOLDEN_DUCK', 3, 'PLATINUM_DUCK', 4, 0)
      THEN 'upgrade'
      WHEN w.tier_code = w.previous_tier_code
      THEN 'same'
      ELSE 'downgrade'
    END AS STRING) AS direction,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(w.changed_at, w.previous_changed_at) AS INT) AS days_in_previous_tier
  FROM with_previous AS w
)

WITH ledger AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_store_credit_ledger
), fx_rates AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
), currencies AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__currencies
), grouped AS (
  SELECT
    l.customer_id,
    l.currency_code,
    SUM(l.amount_minor) AS balance_minor,
    SUM(
      IF(
        l.amount_minor > 0
        AND l.expires_on BETWEEN CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE) AND DATEADD(DAY, 30, CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE)),
        l.amount_minor,
        0
      )
    ) AS expiring_30d_minor,
    MIN(l.posted_at) AS first_posted_at,
    MAX(l.posted_at) AS last_posted_at,
    COUNT(*) AS posting_count,
    SUM(IF(l.reason_code LIKE 'GOODWILL%', l.amount_minor, 0)) AS goodwill_minor,
    SUM(IF(l.amount_minor > 0, l.amount_minor, 0)) AS issued_minor
  FROM ledger AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.customer_id,
    l.currency_code
), valued AS (
  SELECT
    g.customer_id,
    g.currency_code,
    g.balance_minor,
    g.expiring_30d_minor,
    g.first_posted_at,
    g.last_posted_at,
    g.posting_count,
    g.goodwill_minor,
    g.issued_minor,
    CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE) AS valuation_date,
    c.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM grouped AS g
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS c
    ON g.currency_code = c.currency_code
), with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    v.customer_id,
    v.currency_code,
    v.balance_minor,
    v.expiring_30d_minor,
    v.first_posted_at,
    v.last_posted_at,
    v.posting_count,
    v.goodwill_minor,
    v.issued_minor,
    v.minor_unit_exponent,

    CAST(ARRAYS_OVERLAP(CAST(a.elements AS ARRAY<VARIANT>), ARRAY(PARSE_JSON('null'))) AS BOOLEAN) AS overlaps_json_null,
    CAST(ARRAY_CONTAINS(ARRAY(-7.00, 1.00, 'a'), a.attribute_value) AS BOOLEAN) AS in_decimal_array,

WITH texts AS (

    t.wall_clock_text,
    TRY_CAST(t.zoned_text AS TIMESTAMP) AS zoned,
    TRY_CAST(t.zoned_text AS TIMESTAMP) AS local_zoned
  FROM texts AS t
), final AS (
  SELECT
    p.text_id,
    p.zoned_text,
    p.zoned,
    p.local_zoned,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', p.zoned) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS zoned_utc,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', p.local_zoned) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS local_zoned_utc,
    TO_DATE(p.zoned) AS zoned_date,
    TO_DATE(p.local_zoned) AS local_zoned_date,
    CAST(YEAR(p.zoned) AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS zoned_year,
    CAST(YEAR(p.local_zoned) AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS local_zoned_year,
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', p.zoned) AS zoned_day_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', p.local_zoned) AS local_zoned_day_start,
    p.zoned = CAST(p.wall_clock_text AS TIMESTAMP) AS zoned_equals_wall_text,
    p.local_zoned = CAST(p.wall_clock_text AS TIMESTAMP) AS local_zoned_equals_wall_text,
    p.zoned > p.wall_clock AS zoned_after_wall_clock,
    p.local_zoned > p.wall_clock AS local_zoned_after_wall_clock,
    p.zoned >= CAST('2026-03-06' AS DATE) AS zoned_from_next_day,
    p.local_zoned >= CAST('2026-03-06' AS DATE) AS local_zoned_from_next_day,
    CAST(FIRST_VALUE(p.zoned) OVER (
      ORDER BY p.text_id NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS DATE) AS first_zoned_date,

WITH chargebacks AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_chargebacks
), payments AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_payments
), orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
), fx_rates AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
), currencies AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__currencies
), evidence AS (
  SELECT
    c.chargeback_id,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(LOWER(CAST(d.value:kind AS STRING)))) AS evidence_kinds,
    BOOL_OR(
      REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(CAST(d.value:kind AS STRING)), '.*(tracking|delivery|signature|pod).*')
    ) AS has_delivery_proof
  FROM chargebacks AS c, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(c.evidence:documents) AS d
  GROUP BY
    c.chargeback_id
), with_payment AS (
  SELECT
    c.chargeback_id,
    c.payment_id,
    p.order_id,
    p.payment_method,
    c.reason_code,
    c.reason_family,
    c.opened_at,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', c.opened_at) AS DATE) AS opened_date,
    c.closed_at,
    c.outcome,
    c.amount_minor,
    c.currency_code,
    p.amount_minor AS payment_amount_minor
  FROM chargebacks AS c
  LEFT JOIN payments AS p
    ON c.payment_id = p.payment_id
), with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    w.chargeback_id,
    w.payment_id,
    w.order_id,
    w.payment_method,
    w.reason_code,
    w.reason_family,
    w.opened_at,
    w.opened_date,
    w.closed_at,
    w.outcome,
    w.amount_minor,
    w.payment_amount_minor,
    cur.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM with_payment AS w
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS cur
    ON w.currency_code = cur.currency_code
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM fx_rates AS fx
    WHERE
      w.currency_code = fx.currency_code AND w.opened_date >= fx.rate_date
    ORDER BY
      fx.rate_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fx
), with_order AS (
  SELECT
    r.chargeback_id,
    r.payment_id,
    r.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    r.payment_method,
    r.reason_code,
    r.reason_family,
    r.opened_at,
    r.opened_date,
    DATEADD(
      DAY,
      COALESCE(
        CAST(MAP('consumer_dispute', 30, 'fraud', 20, 'processing', 45)[r.reason_family] AS INT),
        30
      ),
      r.opened_date
    ) AS response_due_on,
    r.closed_at,
    r.outcome,
    ROUND(
      (
        CAST(ROUND(
          CAST((
            r.amount_minor / NULLIF((
              CAST(POWER(10, COALESCE(r.minor_unit_exponent, 2)) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
            ), 0)
          ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
          6
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
      ) * r.rate_to_usd,
      2
    ) AS amount_usd,
    r.amount_minor / NULLIF(r.payment_amount_minor, 0) AS share_of_payment
  FROM with_rate AS r
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.order_id = o.order_id
), customer_history AS (
  SELECT
    w.chargeback_id,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY w.customer_id
      ORDER BY w.opened_at NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) - 1 AS prior_chargebacks_for_customer
  FROM with_order AS w
), final AS (
  SELECT
    w.chargeback_id,
    w.payment_id,
    w.order_id,
    w.customer_id,
    w.payment_method,
    w.reason_code,
    w.reason_family,
    w.opened_at,
    CAST(w.response_due_on AS DATE) AS response_due_on,
    w.outcome,
    CAST(w.amount_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS amount_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(w.share_of_payment, 6) AS DECIMAL(9, 6)) AS share_of_payment,
    CAST(COALESCE(e.evidence_kinds, ARRAY()) AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS evidence_kinds,
    CAST(COALESCE(e.has_delivery_proof, FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS has_delivery_proof,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(
      COALESCE(CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', w.closed_at) AS DATE), CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE)),
      w.opened_date
    ) AS INT) AS days_open,
    CAST((
      w.closed_at IS NULL AND w.response_due_on < CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE)
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_overdue,
    CAST(IF(w.outcome IN ('open', 'lost', 'pending'), w.amount_usd, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS at_risk_usd,
    CAST(h.prior_chargebacks_for_customer AS INT) AS prior_chargebacks_for_customer
  FROM with_order AS w
  INNER JOIN customer_history AS h
    ON w.chargeback_id = h.chargeback_id
  LEFT JOIN evidence AS e
    ON w.chargeback_id = e.chargeback_id
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH invoices AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_invoices
), tax_lines AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_invoice_tax_lines
), orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_orders_enriched
), currencies AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__currencies
), numbered AS (
  SELECT
    i.invoice_id,
    i.order_id,
    COALESCE(
      i.invoice_series,
      TRY_ELEMENT_AT(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(i.invoice_number, '^([A-Z]+)-', 1), 1),
      'NONE'
    ) AS invoice_series,
    TRY_CAST(TRY_ELEMENT_AT(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(i.invoice_number, '([0-9]+)$', 1), 1) AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS invoice_sequence,
    i.issued_at,
    i.currency_code,
    i.net_minor,
    i.tax_minor,
    i.gross_minor,
    i.tax_lines
  FROM invoices AS i
), sequenced AS (
  SELECT
    n.invoice_id,
    n.invoice_sequence - LAG(n.invoice_sequence) OVER (
      PARTITION BY n.invoice_series
      ORDER BY n.invoice_sequence NULLS LAST, n.invoice_id NULLS LAST
    ) - 1 AS sequence_gap
  FROM numbered AS n
), embedded AS (
  SELECT
    n.invoice_id,
    SUM(CAST(t.value:tax_minor AS INT)) AS embedded_tax_minor,
    COUNT(t.value) AS embedded_line_count
  FROM numbered AS n, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(CAST(n.tax_lines AS VARIANT)) AS t
  GROUP BY
    n.invoice_id
), loaded AS (
  SELECT
    l.invoice_id,
    SUM(l.tax_minor) AS loaded_tax_minor,
    COUNT(*) AS loaded_line_count,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(l.tax_code)) AS tax_codes
  FROM tax_lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.invoice_id
), order_tax AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.tax_amount_minor,
    o.currency_code,
    o.storefront_timezone
  FROM orders AS o
), joined AS (
  SELECT
    n.invoice_id,
    n.order_id,
    n.invoice_series,
    n.invoice_sequence,
    s.sequence_gap,
    n.issued_at,
    n.currency_code,
    n.net_minor,
    n.tax_minor,
    n.gross_minor,
    c.minor_unit_exponent,
    e.embedded_tax_minor,
    e.embedded_line_count,
    l.loaded_tax_minor,
    l.loaded_line_count,
    l.tax_codes,
    o.tax_amount_minor AS order_tax_minor,
    o.currency_code AS order_currency_code,
    o.storefront_timezone
  FROM numbered AS n
  INNER JOIN sequenced AS s
    ON n.invoice_id = s.invoice_id
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS c
    ON n.currency_code = c.currency_code
  LEFT JOIN embedded AS e
    ON n.invoice_id = e.invoice_id
  LEFT JOIN loaded AS l
    ON n.invoice_id = l.invoice_id
  LEFT JOIN order_tax AS o
    ON n.order_id = o.order_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    j.invoice_id,
    j.order_id,
    CAST(j.invoice_series AS STRING) AS invoice_series,
    CAST(j.invoice_sequence AS INT) AS invoice_sequence,
    CAST(NULLIF(j.sequence_gap, 0) AS INT) AS sequence_gap,
    j.issued_at,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(COALESCE(j.storefront_timezone, 'UTC'), j.issued_at) AS DATE) AS issued_date_local,
    j.currency_code,
    CAST(ROUND(
      CAST((
        j.net_minor / NULLIF((
          CAST(POWER(10, COALESCE(j.minor_unit_exponent, 2)) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
        ), 0)
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS net,
    CAST(ROUND(
      CAST((
        j.tax_minor / NULLIF((
          CAST(POWER(10, COALESCE(j.minor_unit_exponent, 2)) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
        ), 0)
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS tax,
    CAST(ROUND(
      CAST((
        j.gross_minor / NULLIF((
          CAST(POWER(10, COALESCE(j.minor_unit_exponent, 2)) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
        ), 0)
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS gross,
    CAST(j.embedded_tax_minor AS INT) AS embedded_tax_minor,
    CAST(j.loaded_tax_minor AS INT) AS loaded_tax_minor,
    j.order_tax_minor,
    CAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(j.embedded_line_count, 0), COALESCE(j.loaded_line_count, 0)) AS INT) AS tax_line_count,
    CAST(COALESCE(j.tax_codes, ARRAY()) AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS tax_codes,
    CAST((
      j.net_minor + j.tax_minor = j.gross_minor
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS header_balances,
    CAST(COALESCE(
      ABS(j.embedded_tax_minor - j.loaded_tax_minor) <= 1
      AND ABS(j.loaded_tax_minor - j.tax_minor) <= 1,
      FALSE
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS tax_lines_agree,
    CAST(COALESCE(ABS(j.tax_minor - j.order_tax_minor) <= 1, FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS matches_order_tax,
    CAST(EQUAL_NULL(j.currency_code, j.order_currency_code) AS BOOLEAN) AS invoice_currency_matches_order
  FROM joined AS j
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH entries AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_ledger_entries
), currencies AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__currencies
), spine_offsets AS (
  SELECT
    SEQUENCE(0, 729) AS day_offsets
), date_spine AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATEADD(DAY, CAST(d.value AS INT), CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS calendar_date
  FROM spine_offsets AS o, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(CAST(o.day_offsets AS VARIANT)) AS d
), posting_days AS (
  SELECT
    e.account_code,
    e.account_class,
    e.currency_code,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', e.posted_at) AS DATE) AS posted_date,
    e.signed_amount_minor
  FROM entries AS e
), daily_postings AS (
  SELECT
    p.account_code,
    p.currency_code,
    p.posted_date,
    SUM(IF(p.signed_amount_minor > 0, p.signed_amount_minor, 0)) AS debit_minor,
    SUM(IF(p.signed_amount_minor < 0, -p.signed_amount_minor, 0)) AS credit_minor,
    SUM(p.signed_amount_minor) AS net_minor,
    COUNT(*) AS posting_count
  FROM posting_days AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.account_code,
    p.currency_code,
    p.posted_date
), accounts AS (
  SELECT
    p.account_code,
    p.currency_code,
    MAX(p.account_class) AS account_class,
    MIN(p.posted_date) AS first_posted_date
  FROM posting_days AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.account_code,
    p.currency_code
), account_days AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_code,
    a.currency_code,
    a.account_class,
    d.calendar_date
  FROM accounts AS a
  INNER JOIN date_spine AS d
    ON d.calendar_date >= a.first_posted_date
  WHERE
    d.calendar_date <= CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE)
), filled AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_code,
    a.currency_code,
    a.account_class,
    a.calendar_date,
    COALESCE(p.debit_minor, 0) AS debit_minor,
    COALESCE(p.credit_minor, 0) AS credit_minor,
    COALESCE(p.net_minor, 0) AS net_minor,
    COALESCE(p.posting_count, 0) AS posting_count
  FROM account_days AS a
  LEFT JOIN daily_postings AS p
    ON a.account_code = p.account_code
    AND a.currency_code = p.currency_code
    AND a.calendar_date = p.posted_date
), balances AS (
  SELECT
    f.account_code,
    f.currency_code,
    f.account_class,
    f.calendar_date,
    f.debit_minor,
    f.credit_minor,
    f.posting_count,
    SUM(f.net_minor) OVER (
      PARTITION BY f.account_code, f.currency_code
      ORDER BY f.calendar_date NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS closing_balance_minor,
    SUM(f.net_minor) OVER (
      PARTITION BY f.account_code, f.currency_code, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', f.calendar_date)
      ORDER BY f.calendar_date NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS month_to_date_movement_minor
  FROM filled AS f
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      b.account_code || ':' || b.currency_code || ':' || DATE_FORMAT(b.calendar_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
    ) AS STRING) AS balance_key,
    b.account_code,
    CAST(b.account_class AS STRING) AS account_class,
    b.currency_code,
    b.calendar_date,
    CAST(b.debit_minor AS INT) AS debit_minor,
    CAST(b.credit_minor AS INT) AS credit_minor,
    CAST(b.posting_count AS INT) AS posting_count,
    CAST(b.closing_balance_minor AS INT) AS closing_balance_minor,
    CAST(ROUND(
      CAST((
        b.closing_balance_minor / NULLIF((
          CAST(POWER(10, COALESCE(c.minor_unit_exponent, 2)) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
        ), 0)
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS closing_balance,
    CAST(b.month_to_date_movement_minor AS INT) AS month_to_date_movement_minor,
    CAST((
      b.calendar_date = LAST_DAY(b.calendar_date)
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_month_end,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN b.account_class IN ('asset', 'expense')
      THEN b.closing_balance_minor >= 0
      ELSE b.closing_balance_minor <= 0
    END AS BOOLEAN) AS is_normal_side
  FROM balances AS b
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS c
