WITH payouts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_payouts
), payout_lines AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_payout_lines
), payments AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_payments
), reports AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_settlement_reports
), payout_sequence AS (
  SELECT
    p.payout_id,
    DATEDIFF(
      p.paid_out_on,
      LAG(p.paid_out_on) OVER (
        PARTITION BY p.provider_code, p.currency_code
        ORDER BY p.paid_out_on NULLS LAST, p.payout_id NULLS LAST
      )
    ) AS days_since_previous_payout,
    SIZE(COALESCE(CAST(p.lines AS ARRAY<VARIANT>), ARRAY())) AS embedded_line_count
  FROM payouts AS p
), line_totals AS (
  SELECT
    l.payout_id,
    SUM(
      IF(l.line_type = 'refund', -ABS(l.gross_minor), l.gross_minor) - COALESCE(l.fee_minor, 0)
    ) AS lines_net_minor,
    COUNT_IF(l.line_type = 'charge') AS charge_line_count,
    COUNT_IF(l.line_type = 'refund') AS refund_line_count,
    COUNT(*) AS loaded_line_count
  FROM payout_lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.payout_id
), orphan_payment_ids AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(l.payment_id AS STRING) AS payment_id
  FROM payout_lines AS l
  WHERE
    NOT l.payment_id IS NULL
  EXCEPT
  SELECT
    CAST(p.payment_id AS STRING) AS payment_id
  FROM payments AS p
), line_matches AS (
  SELECT
    l.payout_id,
    COUNT(o.payment_id) AS orphan_line_count,
    SUM(IF(o.payment_id IS NULL AND l.line_type = 'charge', p.amount_minor, 0)) AS matched_payment_minor
  FROM payout_lines AS l
  LEFT JOIN orphan_payment_ids AS o
    ON l.payment_id = o.payment_id
  LEFT JOIN payments AS p
    ON l.payment_id = p.payment_id
  GROUP BY
    l.payout_id
), daily_reports AS (
  SELECT
    r.provider_code,
    r.report_date,
    r.currency_code,
    r.report_id,
    r.gross_minor - COALESCE(r.fees_minor, 0) AS report_net_minor
  FROM reports AS r
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY r.provider_code, r.report_date, r.currency_code
      ORDER BY r.line_count DESC NULLS FIRST, r.report_id DESC NULLS FIRST
    ) = 1
), joined AS (
  SELECT
    p.payout_id,
    p.provider_code,
    p.currency_code,
    p.paid_out_on,
    p.net_minor AS payout_net_minor,
    COALESCE(t.lines_net_minor, 0) AS lines_net_minor,
    COALESCE(t.charge_line_count, 0) AS charge_line_count,
    COALESCE(t.refund_line_count, 0) AS refund_line_count,
    COALESCE(m.orphan_line_count, 0) AS orphan_line_count,
    s.embedded_line_count,
    COALESCE(t.loaded_line_count, 0) AS loaded_line_count,
    COALESCE(m.matched_payment_minor, 0) AS matched_payment_minor,
    r.report_id,
    r.report_net_minor,
    s.days_since_previous_payout
  FROM payouts AS p
  INNER JOIN payout_sequence AS s
    ON p.payout_id = s.payout_id
  LEFT JOIN line_totals AS t
    ON p.payout_id = t.payout_id
  LEFT JOIN line_matches AS m
    ON p.payout_id = m.payout_id
  LEFT JOIN daily_reports AS r
    ON p.provider_code = r.provider_code
    AND p.paid_out_on = r.report_date
    AND p.currency_code = r.currency_code
), checked AS (
  SELECT
    j.payout_id,
    j.provider_code,
    j.currency_code,
    j.paid_out_on,
    j.payout_net_minor,
    j.lines_net_minor,
    j.charge_line_count,
    j.refund_line_count,
    j.orphan_line_count,
    j.embedded_line_count,
    j.loaded_line_count,
    j.matched_payment_minor,
    j.report_id,
    j.report_net_minor,
    j.days_since_previous_payout,
    ABS(j.payout_net_minor - j.lines_net_minor) <= 5 AS lines_match_payout,
    COALESCE(ABS(j.payout_net_minor - j.report_net_minor) <= 5, FALSE) AS report_matches_payout
  FROM joined AS j
), final AS (
  SELECT
    c.payout_id,
    c.provider_code,
    c.currency_code,
    c.paid_out_on,
    CAST(c.payout_net_minor AS INT) AS payout_net_minor,
    CAST(c.lines_net_minor AS INT) AS lines_net_minor,
    CAST(c.charge_line_count AS INT) AS charge_line_count,
    CAST(c.refund_line_count AS INT) AS refund_line_count,
    CAST(c.orphan_line_count AS INT) AS orphan_line_count,
    CAST(c.embedded_line_count AS INT) AS embedded_line_count,
    CAST(c.loaded_line_count AS INT) AS loaded_line_count,
    CAST(c.matched_payment_minor AS INT) AS matched_payment_minor,
    c.report_id,
    CAST(c.report_net_minor AS INT) AS report_net_minor,
    CAST(c.lines_match_payout AS BOOLEAN) AS lines_match_payout,
    CAST(c.report_matches_payout AS BOOLEAN) AS report_matches_payout,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN c.lines_match_payout AND c.report_matches_payout AND c.orphan_line_count = 0
      THEN 'reconciled'
      WHEN c.report_id IS NULL
      THEN 'awaiting_report'
      WHEN c.orphan_line_count > 0
      THEN 'orphan_lines'
      WHEN NOT c.lines_match_payout
      THEN 'line_mismatch'
      ELSE 'report_mismatch'
    END AS STRING) AS reconciliation_status,
    CAST(c.days_since_previous_payout AS INT) AS days_since_previous_payout
  FROM checked AS c
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
), timelines AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_order_status_timeline
), refunds AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_refunds_usd
), subscription_days AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_subscription_mrr_daily
), customers AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_customers
), delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.region_code,
    o.amount_usd - COALESCE(o.tax_amount_usd, 0) AS recognisable_usd,
    t.first_delivered_at
  FROM orders AS o
  INNER JOIN timelines AS t
    ON o.order_id = t.order_id
  WHERE
    NOT t.first_delivered_at IS NULL
), order_regions AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.region_code
  FROM orders AS o
), subscription_regions AS (
  SELECT
    d.subscription_day_key,
    d.calendar_date,
    d.mrr_usd,
    c.region_code
  FROM subscription_days AS d
  LEFT JOIN customers AS c
    ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
), recognition_events AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
      COALESCE(
        CAST(MAP('APAC', 'Asia/Tokyo', 'EU', 'Europe/Berlin', 'MENA', 'Asia/Kuwait', 'US', 'America/New_York')[d.region_code] AS STRING),
        'UTC'
      ),
      d.first_delivered_at
    ) AS DATE) AS recognition_date,
    CAST(d.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('product' AS STRING) AS revenue_stream,
    CAST(d.recognisable_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS amount_usd,
    CAST(d.order_id AS STRING) AS document_id
  FROM delivered_orders AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(r.refunded_date AS DATE) AS recognition_date,
    CAST(o.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('refund' AS STRING) AS revenue_stream,
    CAST((
      -r.amount_usd
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS amount_usd,
    CAST(r.refund_id AS STRING) AS document_id
  FROM refunds AS r
  LEFT JOIN order_regions AS o
    ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(s.calendar_date AS DATE) AS recognition_date,
    CAST(s.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('subscription' AS STRING) AS revenue_stream,
    CAST((
      s.mrr_usd * 12 / 365
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS amount_usd,
    CAST(s.subscription_day_key AS STRING) AS document_id
  FROM subscription_regions AS s
), daily AS (
  SELECT
    e.recognition_date,
    COALESCE(e.region_code, 'UNKNOWN') AS region_code,
    e.revenue_stream,
    SUM(e.amount_usd) AS revenue_usd,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.document_id) AS document_count
  FROM recognition_events AS e
  WHERE
    e.recognition_date <= CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    e.recognition_date,
    COALESCE(e.region_code, 'UNKNOWN'),
    e.revenue_stream
), rolling AS (
  SELECT
    d.recognition_date,
    d.region_code,
    d.revenue_stream,
    d.revenue_usd,
    d.document_count,
    SUM(d.revenue_usd) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.region_code, d.revenue_stream, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', d.recognition_date)
      ORDER BY d.recognition_date NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS month_to_date_usd,
    SUM(d.revenue_usd) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.region_code, d.revenue_stream
      ORDER BY d.recognition_date NULLS LAST
      RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '6' DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS trailing_7d_usd,
    TRY_DIVIDE(
      d.revenue_usd,
      SUM(d.revenue_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY d.recognition_date, d.region_code)
    ) AS share_of_day
  FROM daily AS d
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      DATE_FORMAT(r.recognition_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') || ':' || r.region_code || ':' || r.revenue_stream
    ) AS STRING) AS recognition_key,
    r.recognition_date,
    CAST(r.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    r.revenue_stream,
    CAST(ROUND(r.revenue_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS revenue_usd,
    CAST(r.document_count AS INT) AS document_count,
    CAST(ROUND(r.month_to_date_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS month_to_date_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(r.trailing_7d_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS trailing_7d_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(r.share_of_day, 6) AS DECIMAL(9, 6)) AS share_of_day
  FROM rolling AS r
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH reports AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_settlement_reports
), payments AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_payments
), refunds AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_refunds
), raw_lines AS (
  SELECT
    r.report_id,
    r.provider_code,
    r.report_date,
    l.pos AS line_index,
    l.value AS line
  FROM reports AS r, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(r.report:lines) AS l
), typed_lines AS (
  SELECT
    l.report_id,
    l.provider_code,
    l.report_date,
    l.line_index,
    LOWER(
      COALESCE(CAST(l.line:type AS STRING), CAST(l.line:record_type AS STRING), 'unknown')
    ) AS line_type,
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.line:reference AS STRING)), '') AS structured_reference,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAST(l.line:description AS STRING), '(pay|pi|ch)_[A-Za-z0-9]{6,}') AS described_reference,
    COALESCE(
      CAST(l.line:gross_minor AS INT),
      TRY_CAST(CAST(l.line:gross AS STRING) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) * 100
    ) AS gross_minor,
    COALESCE(CAST(l.line:fee_minor AS INT), 0) AS fee_minor
  FROM raw_lines AS l
), referenced AS (
  SELECT
    t.report_id,
    t.provider_code,
    t.report_date,
    t.line_index,
    t.line_type,
    COALESCE(t.structured_reference, t.described_reference) AS payment_reference,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT t.structured_reference IS NULL
      THEN 'structured'
      WHEN NOT t.described_reference IS NULL
      THEN 'description'
      ELSE 'none'
    END AS reference_source,
    t.gross_minor,
    t.fee_minor
  FROM typed_lines AS t
), payment_refs AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(p.gateway_reference AS STRING) AS payment_reference,
    MIN(p.payment_id) AS payment_id,
    MIN(p.amount_minor) AS payment_amount_minor
  FROM payments AS p
  WHERE
    NOT p.gateway_reference IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(p.gateway_reference AS STRING)
), refund_refs AS (
  SELECT
    f.refund_id AS refund_reference,
    MIN(f.amount_minor) AS refund_amount_minor
  FROM refunds AS f
  GROUP BY
    f.refund_id
), matched AS (
  SELECT
    r.report_id,
    r.provider_code,
    r.report_date,
    r.line_index,
    r.line_type,
    r.payment_reference,
    r.reference_source,
    r.gross_minor,
    r.fee_minor,
    p.payment_id AS matched_payment_id,
    f.refund_reference AS matched_refund_id,
    COALESCE(p.payment_amount_minor, f.refund_amount_minor) AS matched_amount_minor
  FROM referenced AS r
  LEFT JOIN payment_refs AS p
    ON r.payment_reference = p.payment_reference
  LEFT JOIN refund_refs AS f
    ON r.payment_reference = f.refund_reference
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      m.report_id || ':' || LPAD(CAST(m.line_index AS STRING), 5, '0')
    ) AS STRING) AS settlement_line_key,
    m.report_id,
    m.provider_code,
    m.report_date,
    CAST((
      m.line_index + 1
    ) AS INT) AS line_number,
    CAST(m.line_type AS STRING) AS line_type,
    CAST(m.payment_reference AS STRING) AS payment_reference,
    CAST(m.reference_source AS STRING) AS reference_source,
    CAST(m.gross_minor AS INT) AS gross_minor,
    CAST(m.fee_minor AS INT) AS fee_minor,
    CAST((
      m.gross_minor - m.fee_minor
    ) AS INT) AS net_minor,
    CAST(m.matched_payment_id AS STRING) AS matched_payment_id,
    CAST(m.matched_refund_id AS STRING) AS matched_refund_id,
    CAST((
      NOT m.matched_payment_id IS NULL OR NOT m.matched_refund_id IS NULL
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_matched,
    CAST(COALESCE(ABS(m.gross_minor) = ABS(m.matched_amount_minor), FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS amount_matches,
    CAST(ROUND(m.fee_minor / NULLIF(ABS(m.gross_minor), 0), 6) AS DECIMAL(9, 6)) AS fee_rate
  FROM matched AS m
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH tax_lines AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_invoice_tax_lines
), invoices AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_invoices
), orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_orders_enriched
), tax_rates AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_tax_rates
), rate_windows AS (
  SELECT
    r.tax_rate_id,
    r.country_code,
    LOWER(r.tax_category) AS tax_category,
    r.rate_pct,
    r.valid_from,
    COALESCE(r.valid_to, CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE)) AS valid_to_effective
  FROM tax_rates AS r
), line_context AS (
  SELECT
    l.invoice_tax_line_key,
    l.invoice_id,
    i.order_id,
    UPPER(l.tax_code) AS tax_code,
    LOWER(
      COALESCE(
        TRY_ELEMENT_AT(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(l.tax_code, '^[A-Za-z]+[_-]([A-Za-z]+)', 1), 1),
        'standard'
      )
    ) AS tax_category,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', i.issued_at) AS DATE) AS issued_date,
    l.tax_rate_pct AS charged_rate_pct,
    l.taxable_minor,
    l.tax_minor AS charged_tax_minor
  FROM tax_lines AS l
  INNER JOIN invoices AS i
    ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
), with_country AS (
  SELECT
    c.invoice_tax_line_key,
    c.invoice_id,
    c.order_id,
    c.tax_code,
    c.tax_category,
    o.ship_to_country_code,
    c.issued_date,
    c.charged_rate_pct,
    c.taxable_minor,
    c.charged_tax_minor
  FROM line_context AS c
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON c.order_id = o.order_id
), candidate_rates AS (
  SELECT
    w.invoice_tax_line_key,
    MAX_BY(r.rate_pct, r.valid_from) AS published_rate_pct,
    COUNT(r.tax_rate_id) AS candidate_rate_count
  FROM with_country AS w
  INNER JOIN rate_windows AS r
    ON w.ship_to_country_code = r.country_code
    AND w.tax_category = r.tax_category
    AND w.issued_date >= r.valid_from
    AND w.issued_date < r.valid_to_effective
  GROUP BY
    w.invoice_tax_line_key
), expected AS (
  SELECT
    w.invoice_tax_line_key,
    w.invoice_id,
    w.order_id,
    w.tax_code,
    w.tax_category,
    w.ship_to_country_code,
    w.issued_date,
    w.charged_rate_pct,
    c.published_rate_pct,
    w.taxable_minor,
    w.charged_tax_minor,
    ROUND(w.taxable_minor * c.published_rate_pct / 100, 0) AS expected_tax_minor,
    COALESCE(c.candidate_rate_count, 0) AS candidate_rate_count
  FROM with_country AS w
  LEFT JOIN candidate_rates AS c
    ON w.invoice_tax_line_key = c.invoice_tax_line_key
), final AS (
  SELECT
    e.invoice_tax_line_key,
    e.invoice_id,
    e.order_id,
    CAST(e.tax_code AS STRING) AS tax_code,
    CAST(e.tax_category AS STRING) AS tax_category,
    e.ship_to_country_code,
    e.issued_date,
    e.charged_rate_pct,
    CAST(e.published_rate_pct AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS published_rate_pct,
    e.taxable_minor,
    e.charged_tax_minor,
    CAST(e.expected_tax_minor AS INT) AS expected_tax_minor,
    CAST((
      e.charged_tax_minor - e.expected_tax_minor
    ) AS INT) AS variance_minor,
    CAST((
      NOT e.published_rate_pct IS NULL
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS has_published_rate,
    CAST(COALESCE(e.charged_rate_pct <> e.published_rate_pct, FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_rate_mismatch,
    CAST(e.candidate_rate_count AS INT) AS candidate_rate_count
  FROM expected AS e
)

  *
FROM final

WITH webhooks AS (

), shipments AS (

    ) = 1
), final AS (
  SELECT
    f.carrier_update_key,

    f.status_code,
    f.status_at,
    f.received_at,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(

      DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', f.status_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ)),

WITH exceptions AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_delivery_exceptions
), shipments AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_shipments
), orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
), classified AS (
  SELECT
    e.exception_id,
    e.shipment_id,
    e.exception_code,
    e.occurred_at,
    e.resolved_at,
    e.resolution_type,
    e.compensation_minor,
    CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(e.exception_code, '^(ADDR|NOT_HOME|REFUSED|ACCESS).*')
      THEN 'customer'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(e.exception_code, '^(LOST|DAMAGED|DELAY|MISROUTE).*')
      THEN 'carrier'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(e.exception_code, '^(LABEL|PACK|WRONG_ITEM).*')
      THEN 'warehouse'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS responsibility
  FROM exceptions AS e
), final AS (
  SELECT
    c.exception_id,
    c.shipment_id,
    s.carrier_code,
    c.exception_code,
    CAST(c.responsibility AS STRING) AS responsibility,
    c.occurred_at,
    CAST(ROUND(
      DATEDIFF(MINUTE, DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', c.occurred_at), DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', c.resolved_at)) / 60,
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS hours_to_resolve,
    c.resolution_type,
    CAST(ROUND(
      c.compensation_minor / POWER(
        10,
        (
          CASE o.currency_code
            WHEN 'AUD'
            THEN 2
            WHEN 'EUR'
            THEN 2
            WHEN 'GBP'
            THEN 2
            WHEN 'JPY'
            THEN 0
            WHEN 'KWD'
            THEN 3
            WHEN 'USD'
            THEN 2
            ELSE 2
          END
        )
      ) * o.rate_to_usd,
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS compensation_usd,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.shipment_id ORDER BY c.occurred_at NULLS LAST) AS INT) AS exception_rank_in_shipment
  FROM classified AS c
  INNER JOIN shipments AS s
    ON c.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON s.order_id = o.order_id
)

WITH slots AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_delivery_slots
), warehouses AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
), countries AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__countries
), holidays AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__holiday_calendar
), warehouse_regions AS (
  SELECT
    w.warehouse_code,
    c.region_code
  FROM warehouses AS w
  INNER JOIN countries AS c
    ON w.country_code = c.country_code
), busiest_slots AS (
  SELECT
    s.warehouse_code,
    CAST(s.slot_start_local AS DATE) AS slot_date_local,
    s.slot_start_local AS busiest_slot_start_local
  FROM slots AS s
  WHERE
    s.capacity <> 0
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.warehouse_code, CAST(s.slot_start_local AS DATE)
      ORDER BY s.booked / s.capacity DESC NULLS FIRST, s.slot_start_local NULLS LAST, s.slot_id NULLS LAST
    ) = 1
), by_day AS (
  SELECT
    s.warehouse_code,
    CAST(s.slot_start_local AS DATE) AS slot_date_local,
    COUNT(*) AS slot_count,
    SUM(s.capacity) AS total_capacity,
    SUM(s.booked) AS total_booked,
    COUNT_IF(s.remaining_capacity = 0) AS full_slot_count
  FROM slots AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.warehouse_code,
    CAST(s.slot_start_local AS DATE)
), with_calendar AS (
  SELECT
    d.warehouse_code,
    d.slot_date_local,
    d.slot_count,
    d.total_capacity,
    d.total_booked,
    d.full_slot_count,
    b.busiest_slot_start_local,
    r.region_code,
    (
      NOT h.holiday_date IS NULL
    ) AS is_holiday,
    d.total_booked / NULLIF(d.total_capacity, 0) AS utilisation_raw
  FROM by_day AS d
  LEFT JOIN busiest_slots AS b
    ON d.warehouse_code = b.warehouse_code AND d.slot_date_local = b.slot_date_local
  LEFT JOIN warehouse_regions AS r
    ON d.warehouse_code = r.warehouse_code
  LEFT JOIN holidays AS h
    ON r.region_code = h.region_code AND d.slot_date_local = h.holiday_date
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      d.warehouse_code || '|' || DATE_FORMAT(d.slot_date_local, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
    ) AS STRING) AS slot_day_key,
    d.warehouse_code,
    d.slot_date_local,
    CAST(d.slot_count AS INT) AS slot_count,
    CAST(d.total_capacity AS INT) AS total_capacity,
    CAST(d.total_booked AS INT) AS total_booked,
    CAST(ROUND(d.utilisation_raw, 4) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS utilisation,
    CAST(d.full_slot_count AS INT) AS full_slot_count,
    CAST(d.busiest_slot_start_local AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS busiest_slot_start_local,
    (
      EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK_ISO FROM d.slot_date_local) >= 6
    ) AS is_weekend,
    CAST(IF(COALESCE(d.region_code IN ('EU', 'US', 'APAC', 'MENA'), FALSE), d.region_code, NULL) AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST(d.is_holiday AS BOOLEAN) AS is_holiday,
    CAST(ROUND(
      d.utilisation_raw - SUM(d.utilisation_raw) OVER (PARTITION BY d.warehouse_code, EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK_ISO FROM d.slot_date_local)) / COUNT(d.utilisation_raw) OVER (PARTITION BY d.warehouse_code, EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK_ISO FROM d.slot_date_local)),
      4
    ) /* The average as an exact decimal sum over a count, so rounding gives one answer. */ AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS utilisation_vs_weekday_avg
  FROM with_calendar AS d
)

WITH shipments AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_shipments
), orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_orders_enriched
), warehouses AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
), tracking AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_shipment_tracking_events
), countries AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__countries
), holidays AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__holiday_calendar
), spine_offsets AS (
  SELECT
    SEQUENCE(0, 729) AS day_offsets
), date_spine AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATEADD(DAY, CAST(d.value AS INT), CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS calendar_date
  FROM spine_offsets AS o, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(CAST(o.day_offsets AS VARIANT)) AS d
), local_times AS (
  SELECT
    s.shipment_id,
    s.order_id,
    s.warehouse_code,
    s.carrier_code,
    c.region_code,
    w.opening_minutes,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, o.placed_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS placed_at_local,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, s.shipped_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS shipped_at_local,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, o.placed_at) AS DATE) AS placed_date_local,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, s.shipped_at) AS DATE) AS shipped_date_local
  FROM shipments AS s
  INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON s.order_id = o.order_id
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON s.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  LEFT JOIN countries AS c
    ON w.country_code = c.country_code
  WHERE
    NOT s.shipped_at IS NULL
), window_days AS (
  SELECT
    l.shipment_id,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK_ISO FROM d.calendar_date) AS iso_weekday,
    h.holiday_date
  FROM local_times AS l
  INNER JOIN date_spine AS d
    ON d.calendar_date > l.placed_date_local AND d.calendar_date <= l.shipped_date_local
  LEFT JOIN holidays AS h
    ON l.region_code = h.region_code AND d.calendar_date = h.holiday_date
), business_days AS (
  SELECT
    wd.shipment_id,
    COUNT_IF(wd.iso_weekday <= 5 AND wd.holiday_date IS NULL) AS business_days_to_ship,
    COUNT_IF(NOT wd.holiday_date IS NULL) AS holidays_in_window
  FROM window_days AS wd
  GROUP BY
    wd.shipment_id
), delivery AS (
  SELECT
    t.shipment_id,
    MIN(t.event_at_utc) AS delivered_at_utc
  FROM tracking AS t
  WHERE
    t.is_delivery_event
  GROUP BY
    t.shipment_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    l.shipment_id,
    l.order_id,
    l.warehouse_code,
    l.carrier_code,
    l.placed_at_local,
    l.shipped_at_local,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(l.shipped_at_local, l.placed_at_local) AS INT) AS calendar_days_to_ship,
    CAST(COALESCE(b.business_days_to_ship, 0) AS INT) AS business_days_to_ship,
    CAST(COALESCE(b.holidays_in_window, 0) AS INT) AS holidays_in_window,
    CAST(IF(
      COALESCE(b.business_days_to_ship, 0) = 0,
      DATEDIFF(
        MINUTE,
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', l.placed_at_local),
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', l.shipped_at_local)
      ),
      COALESCE(b.business_days_to_ship, 0) * l.opening_minutes
    ) AS INT) AS dispatch_business_minutes,
    (
      IF(
        COALESCE(b.business_days_to_ship, 0) = 0,
        DATEDIFF(
          MINUTE,
          DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', l.placed_at_local),
          DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', l.shipped_at_local)
        ),
        COALESCE(b.business_days_to_ship, 0) * l.opening_minutes
      ) <= 480
    ) AS is_dispatch_on_time,
    dl.delivered_at_utc,
    CAST(ROUND(
      DATEDIFF(
        MINUTE,
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, 'UTC', l.shipped_at_local)),
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', dl.delivered_at_utc)
      ) / 60,
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS hours_to_deliver
  FROM local_times AS l
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON l.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  LEFT JOIN business_days AS b
    ON l.shipment_id = b.shipment_id
  LEFT JOIN delivery AS dl
    ON l.shipment_id = dl.shipment_id
)

WITH pick_tasks AS (

    ON w.country_code = c.country_code
), completed AS (
  SELECT
    t.picker_id,
    t.warehouse_code,
    t.started_at_local,
    CAST(t.started_at_local AS DATE) AS work_date_local,
    t.pick_seconds,
    t.units_picked

), daily AS (
  SELECT
    c.picker_id,
    c.warehouse_code,
    c.work_date_local,
    COUNT(*) AS task_count,
    SUM(c.units_picked) AS units_picked,
    SUM(c.pick_seconds) / 3600 AS active_hours,
    PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY
      c.pick_seconds NULLS LAST) AS p90_task_seconds,
    MIN(HOUR(c.started_at_local)) AS first_task_hour_local
  FROM completed AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.picker_id,
    c.warehouse_code,
    c.work_date_local
), with_context AS (
  SELECT
    d.picker_id,
    d.warehouse_code,
    d.work_date_local,
    d.task_count,
    d.units_picked,
    d.active_hours,
    d.p90_task_seconds,
    d.first_task_hour_local,
    60 * d.active_hours / NULLIF(w.opening_minutes, 0) AS shift_coverage,
    (
      NOT h.holiday_date IS NULL
    ) AS is_holiday
  FROM daily AS d
  LEFT JOIN warehouse_context AS w
    ON d.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  LEFT JOIN holidays AS h
    ON w.region_code = h.region_code AND d.work_date_local = h.holiday_date
), final AS (

    d.picker_id,
    d.warehouse_code,
    d.work_date_local,
    CAST(d.task_count AS INT) AS task_count,
    CAST(d.units_picked AS INT) AS units_picked,
    CAST(ROUND(d.active_hours, 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS active_hours,
    CAST(ROUND(d.units_picked / NULLIF(d.active_hours, 0), 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS units_per_hour,
    CAST(d.p90_task_seconds AS INT) AS p90_task_seconds,
    CAST(DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.warehouse_code, d.work_date_local
      ORDER BY d.units_picked / NULLIF(d.active_hours, 0) DESC
    ) AS INT) AS rank_in_warehouse,
    CAST(d.first_task_hour_local AS INT) AS first_task_hour_local,
    CAST(ROUND(d.shift_coverage, 4) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS shift_coverage,
    CAST(d.is_holiday AS BOOLEAN) AS is_holiday
  FROM with_context AS d
)

WITH returns AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_return_reasons
), raw_returns AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_returns
), inspections AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_return_inspections
), refunds AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_refunds_usd
), latest_inspection AS (
  SELECT
    i.return_id,
    i.grade,
    i.is_resellable,
    SIZE(CAST(i.defect_codes AS ARRAY<VARIANT>)) AS defect_count
  FROM inspections AS i
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY i.return_id
      ORDER BY i.inspected_at_local DESC NULLS FIRST, i.inspection_id DESC NULLS FIRST
    ) = 1
), order_refunds AS (
  SELECT
    f.order_id,
    SUM(f.amount_usd) AS refund_usd,
    MIN(f.refunded_at) AS first_refunded_at
  FROM refunds AS f
  WHERE
    f.reason_category <> 'fraud'
  GROUP BY
    f.order_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    r.return_id,
    r.order_id,
    r.sku,
    r.return_reason,
    li.grade,
    li.is_resellable,
    CAST(orf.refund_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS refund_usd,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(rr.received_at, rr.requested_at) AS INT) AS days_to_receive,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(orf.first_refunded_at, rr.requested_at) AS INT) AS days_to_refund,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN li.is_resellable
      THEN 'restocked'
      WHEN NOT li.grade IS NULL
      THEN 'written_off'
      WHEN NOT orf.refund_usd IS NULL
      THEN 'refunded_not_received'
      ELSE 'pending'
    END AS STRING) AS outcome,
    CAST(COALESCE(li.defect_count, 0) AS INT) AS defect_count
  FROM returns AS r
  INNER JOIN raw_returns AS rr
    ON r.return_id = rr.return_id
  LEFT JOIN latest_inspection AS li
    ON r.return_id = li.return_id

    ON r.order_id = orf.order_id

), orders AS (

), rate_cards AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_carrier_rate_cards
), package_lanes AS (
  SELECT
    p.package_id,
    p.shipment_id,
    s.carrier_code,
    s.service_level,
    w.country_code AS origin_country,
    o.ship_to_country_code AS destination_country,
    CAST(s.shipped_at AS DATE) AS shipped_date,
    GREATEST(p.weight_grams / 1000, COALESCE(p.volumetric_weight_kg, 0)) AS chargeable_weight_kg,
    IF(COALESCE(p.volumetric_weight_kg, 0) > p.weight_grams / 1000, 'volumetric', 'actual') AS weight_basis
  FROM packages AS p
  INNER JOIN shipments AS s
    ON p.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON s.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON s.order_id = o.order_id
), bands AS (
  SELECT
    r.carrier_code,
    r.service_level,
    r.origin_country,
    r.destination_country,
    r.currency_code,
    r.valid_from,
    r.valid_to,
    CAST(b.value:max_kg AS DECIMAL(10, 3)) AS band_max_kg,
    CAST(b.value:amount_minor AS INT) AS rate_minor
  FROM rate_cards AS r, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(CAST(r.bands AS VARIANT)) AS b
), matched AS (
  SELECT
    l.package_id,
    MIN(b.band_max_kg) AS band_max_kg,
    MIN_BY(b.rate_minor, b.band_max_kg) AS rate_minor,
    MIN_BY(b.currency_code, b.band_max_kg) AS rate_currency_code
  FROM package_lanes AS l
  INNER JOIN bands AS b
    ON l.carrier_code = b.carrier_code
    AND l.service_level = b.service_level
    AND l.origin_country = b.origin_country
    AND l.destination_country = b.destination_country
    AND l.shipped_date BETWEEN b.valid_from AND b.valid_to
    AND l.chargeable_weight_kg <= b.band_max_kg
  GROUP BY
    l.package_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    l.package_id,
    l.shipment_id,
    l.carrier_code,
    l.service_level,
    CAST(ROUND(l.chargeable_weight_kg, 3) AS DECIMAL(10, 3)) AS chargeable_weight_kg,
    CAST(l.weight_basis AS STRING) AS weight_basis,
    CAST(m.band_max_kg AS DECIMAL(10, 3)) AS band_max_kg,
    CAST(m.rate_minor AS INT) AS rate_minor,
    CAST(m.rate_currency_code AS STRING) AS rate_currency_code,
    (
      NOT m.rate_minor IS NULL
    ) AS has_rate
  FROM package_lanes AS l
  LEFT JOIN matched AS m
    ON l.package_id = m.package_id
)

WITH tracking_events AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_shipment_tracking_events
), webhook_events AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_carrier_webhook_events
), shipments AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_shipments
), warehouses AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
), combined AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.tracking_event_key AS STRING) AS tracking_event_key,
    CAST(t.shipment_id AS STRING) AS shipment_id,
    CAST(t.event_code AS STRING) AS event_code,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', t.event_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS event_at_utc,
    CAST(t.event_source AS STRING) AS event_origin
  FROM tracking_events AS t
  WHERE
    NOT t.event_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST((
      'W:' || w.carrier_update_key
    ) AS STRING) AS tracking_event_key,
    CAST(w.shipment_id AS STRING) AS shipment_id,
    CAST(w.status_code AS STRING) AS event_code,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', w.status_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS event_at_utc,
    CAST('webhook' AS STRING) AS event_origin
  FROM webhook_events AS w
  WHERE
    NOT w.status_at IS NULL
), deduplicated AS (
  SELECT
    c.tracking_event_key,
    c.shipment_id,
    c.event_code,
    c.event_at_utc,
    c.event_origin
  FROM combined AS c
  QUALIFY
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.shipment_id, c.event_code, DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', c.event_at_utc)
      ORDER BY c.event_origin NULLS LAST, c.tracking_event_key NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) = 1
), final AS (
  SELECT
    d.tracking_event_key,
    d.shipment_id,
    d.event_code,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(d.event_code, '^(DELIVERED|DLV|POD).*')
      THEN 'delivered'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(d.event_code, '^(OUT_FOR_DELIVERY|OFD).*')
      THEN 'out_for_delivery'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(d.event_code, '^EXCEPTION_.*|^(EXC|DELAY|DAMAGE).*')
      THEN 'exception'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(d.event_code, '^(PICKED_UP|PU|ACCEPTED).*')
      THEN 'collected'
      ELSE 'in_transit'
    END AS STRING) AS event_family,
    d.event_at_utc,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', w.iana_timezone, d.event_at_utc) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS event_at_warehouse_local,
    d.event_origin,
    (
      REGEXP_LIKE(d.event_code, '^(DELIVERED|DLV|POD).*')
    ) AS is_delivery_event
  FROM deduplicated AS d
  INNER JOIN shipments AS s
    ON d.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON s.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
)

WITH conversions AS (

), orders AS (

  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
), fx_rates AS (
  SELECT

), currencies AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__currencies
), ranked_claims AS (
  SELECT
    c.conversion_id,
    c.affiliate_code,
    c.order_id,
    c.commission_minor,
    c.currency_code,
    c.converted_at,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', c.converted_at) AS DATE) AS converted_date,

    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.order_id) AS claims_on_order
  FROM conversions AS c
), parsed_codes AS (
  SELECT
    r.conversion_id,
    UPPER(
      COALESCE(
        TRY_ELEMENT_AT(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(r.affiliate_code, '^([A-Za-z]{2,5})[-_]', 1), 1),
        'DIRECT'
      )
    ) AS affiliate_network,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_SUBSTR(r.sub_id, '^[a-zA-Z]+'), '[^a-z]', '')) AS sub_channel
  FROM ranked_claims AS r
), with_exponent AS (
  SELECT
    r.conversion_id,
    r.affiliate_code,
    r.order_id,
    r.commission_minor,
    r.currency_code,
    r.converted_at,
    r.converted_date,
    r.click_to_conversion_hours,
    r.claim_rank,
    r.claims_on_order,
    cur.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM ranked_claims AS r
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS cur
    ON r.currency_code = cur.currency_code
), with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    w.conversion_id,
    w.affiliate_code,
    w.order_id,
    w.commission_minor,
    w.converted_at,
    w.click_to_conversion_hours,
    w.claim_rank,
    w.claims_on_order,
    w.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM with_exponent AS w
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM fx_rates AS fx
    WHERE
      w.currency_code = fx.currency_code AND w.converted_date >= fx.rate_date
    ORDER BY
      fx.rate_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fx
), with_order AS (
  SELECT
    w.conversion_id,
    w.affiliate_code,
    p.affiliate_network,
    p.sub_channel,
    w.order_id,
    w.converted_at,
    w.click_to_conversion_hours,
    CAST(ROUND(
      CAST((
        w.commission_minor / NULLIF((
          CAST(POWER(10, COALESCE(w.minor_unit_exponent, 2)) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
        ), 0)
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
      6
    ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS commission,
    w.rate_to_usd,
    w.claim_rank,
    w.claims_on_order,
    o.amount_usd AS order_amount_usd,
    o.order_status
  FROM with_rate AS w
  INNER JOIN parsed_codes AS p
    ON w.conversion_id = p.conversion_id
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON w.order_id = o.order_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    o.conversion_id,
    o.affiliate_code,
    CAST(o.affiliate_network AS STRING) AS affiliate_network,
    CAST(NULLIF(o.sub_channel, '') AS STRING) AS sub_channel,
    o.order_id,
    o.converted_at,
    o.click_to_conversion_hours,
    CAST(o.commission AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS commission,
    CAST(ROUND(o.commission * o.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS commission_usd,
    o.order_amount_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(o.commission * o.rate_to_usd / NULLIF(o.order_amount_usd, 0), 6) AS DECIMAL(9, 6)) AS commission_rate,
    CAST(o.claims_on_order AS INT) AS claims_on_order,
    CAST((
      o.claim_rank = 1
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_last_click,
    CAST(COALESCE(o.order_status IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED'), FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_reversible,
    CAST(IF(
      o.claim_rank = 1
      AND COALESCE(NOT o.order_status IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED'), FALSE),
      ROUND(o.commission * o.rate_to_usd, 2),
      0
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS payable_commission_usd
  FROM with_order AS o
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH campaigns AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_campaigns
), spend AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_campaign_spend_usd
), sessions AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_session_attribution
), orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
), emails AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_email_engagement
), fx_rates AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
), currencies AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__currencies
), campaign_keys AS (
  SELECT
    c.campaign_id,
    LOWER(c.campaign_id) AS utm_campaign_key,
    c.campaign_name,
    c.channel,
    c.objective,
    c.starts_on,
    c.ends_on,
    c.budget_minor,
    c.currency_code,
    c.target_regions
  FROM campaigns AS c
), budget_rate AS (
  SELECT
    k.campaign_id,
    ROUND(
      (
        CAST(ROUND(
          CAST((
            k.budget_minor / NULLIF((
              CAST(POWER(10, cur.minor_unit_exponent) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
            ), 0)
          ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
          6
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
      ) * fx.rate_to_usd,
      2
    ) AS budget_usd
  FROM campaign_keys AS k
  INNER JOIN currencies AS cur
    ON k.currency_code = cur.currency_code
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM fx_rates AS fx
    WHERE
      k.currency_code = fx.currency_code AND k.starts_on >= fx.rate_date
    ORDER BY
      fx.rate_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fx
), target_regions AS (
  SELECT
    k.campaign_id,
    COUNT(r.value) AS target_region_count,
    ARRAY_SORT(
      COLLECT_LIST(
        IF(
          COALESCE((
            CAST(r.value AS STRING)
          ) IN ('EU', 'US', 'APAC', 'MENA'), FALSE),
          NULL,
          CAST(r.value AS STRING)
        )
      )
    ) AS unsupported_target_regions
  FROM campaign_keys AS k, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(CAST(k.target_regions AS VARIANT)) AS r
  GROUP BY
    k.campaign_id
), touches AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(s.campaign_id AS STRING) AS campaign_id,
    CAST('paid' AS STRING) AS touch_type,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.clicks, 0) AS INT) AS touch_count
  FROM spend AS s
  WHERE
    NOT s.campaign_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(e.campaign_id AS STRING) AS campaign_id,
    CAST('email' AS STRING) AS touch_type,
    CAST(e.click_count AS INT) AS touch_count
  FROM emails AS e
  WHERE
    NOT e.campaign_id IS NULL AND e.click_count > 0
), touch_totals AS (
  SELECT
    t.campaign_id,
    SUM(IF(t.touch_type = 'paid', t.touch_count, 0)) AS paid_clicks,
    SUM(IF(t.touch_type = 'email', t.touch_count, 0)) AS email_clicks
  FROM touches AS t
  GROUP BY
    t.campaign_id
), spend_totals AS (
  SELECT
    s.campaign_id,
    SUM(s.spend_usd) AS spend_usd
  FROM spend AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.campaign_id
), session_totals AS (
  SELECT
    s.utm_campaign,
    COUNT(*) AS attributed_sessions
  FROM sessions AS s
  WHERE
    NOT s.utm_campaign IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    s.utm_campaign
), order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    o.utm_campaign,
    COUNT(*) AS attributed_orders,
    SUM(o.amount_usd) AS attributed_revenue_usd
  FROM orders AS o
  WHERE
    NOT o.utm_campaign IS NULL AND NOT o.order_status IN ('CANCELLED', 'PENDING')
  GROUP BY
    o.utm_campaign
), combined AS (
  SELECT
    k.campaign_id,
    k.campaign_name,
    k.channel,
    k.objective,
    k.starts_on,
    k.ends_on,
    b.budget_usd,
    COALESCE(sp.spend_usd, 0) AS spend_usd,
    COALESCE(t.paid_clicks, 0) AS paid_clicks,
    COALESCE(t.email_clicks, 0) AS email_clicks,
    COALESCE(st.attributed_sessions, 0) AS attributed_sessions,
    COALESCE(ot.attributed_orders, 0) AS attributed_orders,
    COALESCE(ot.attributed_revenue_usd, 0) AS attributed_revenue_usd,
    COALESCE(tr.target_region_count, 0) AS target_region_count,
    COALESCE(tr.unsupported_target_regions, ARRAY()) AS unsupported_target_regions
  FROM campaign_keys AS k
  LEFT JOIN budget_rate AS b
    ON k.campaign_id = b.campaign_id
  LEFT JOIN spend_totals AS sp
    ON k.campaign_id = sp.campaign_id
  LEFT JOIN touch_totals AS t
    ON k.campaign_id = t.campaign_id
  LEFT JOIN session_totals AS st
    ON k.utm_campaign_key = st.utm_campaign
  LEFT JOIN order_totals AS ot
    ON k.utm_campaign_key = ot.utm_campaign
  LEFT JOIN target_regions AS tr
    ON k.campaign_id = tr.campaign_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    c.campaign_id,
    c.campaign_name,
    c.channel,
    c.objective,
    c.starts_on,
    c.ends_on,
    CAST(c.budget_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS budget_usd,
    CAST(c.spend_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS spend_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(100 * c.spend_usd / NULLIF(c.budget_usd, 0), 2) AS DECIMAL(9, 2)) AS budget_used_pct,
    CAST(c.paid_clicks AS INT) AS paid_clicks,
    CAST(c.email_clicks AS INT) AS email_clicks,
    CAST(c.attributed_sessions AS INT) AS attributed_sessions,
    CAST(c.attributed_orders AS INT) AS attributed_orders,
    CAST(c.attributed_revenue_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS attributed_revenue_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(c.attributed_revenue_usd / NULLIF(c.spend_usd, 0), 4) AS DECIMAL(12, 4)) AS return_on_ad_spend,
    CAST(c.target_region_count AS INT) AS target_region_count,
    CAST(c.unsupported_target_regions AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS unsupported_target_regions,
    CAST(DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.channel ORDER BY c.spend_usd DESC NULLS FIRST) AS INT) AS spend_rank_in_channel
  FROM combined AS c
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH spend AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_campaign_spend
), campaigns AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_campaigns
), fx_rates AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
), report_headers AS (
  SELECT
    s.spend_id,
    s.spend_date,
    s.channel,
    s.campaign_id,
    s.currency_code,
    s.platform_account_id
  FROM spend AS s
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.spend_id ORDER BY s.spend_metric_key NULLS LAST) = 1
), metric_values AS (
  SELECT
    s.spend_id,
    MAX(IF(s.metric_name = 'spend', s.metric_value, NULL)) AS spend_amount,
    MAX(IF(s.metric_name = 'impressions', s.metric_value, NULL)) AS impressions,
    MAX(IF(s.metric_name IN ('clicks', 'link_clicks'), s.metric_value, NULL)) AS clicks,
    MAX(
      IF(
        REGEXP_LIKE(s.metric_name, '^(conversions|purchases)(_[0-9]+d)?$'),
        s.metric_value,
        NULL
      )
    ) AS conversions,
    COUNT(*) AS metric_count,
    ARRAY_SORT(
      COLLECT_SET(
        IF(
          REGEXP_LIKE(
            s.metric_name,
            '^(spend|impressions|clicks|link_clicks|conversions|purchases)(_[0-9]+d)?$'
          ),
          NULL,
          s.metric_name
        )
      )
    ) AS unknown_metrics
  FROM spend AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.spend_id
), reports AS (
  SELECT
    h.spend_id,
    h.spend_date,
    h.channel,
    h.campaign_id,
    h.currency_code,
    h.platform_account_id,
    m.spend_amount,
    m.impressions,
    m.clicks,
    m.conversions,
    m.metric_count,
    m.unknown_metrics
  FROM report_headers AS h
  INNER JOIN metric_values AS m
    ON h.spend_id = m.spend_id
), with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    r.spend_id,
    r.spend_date,
    r.channel,
    r.campaign_id,
    r.currency_code,
    r.platform_account_id,
    r.spend_amount,
    r.impressions,
    r.clicks,
    r.conversions,
    r.metric_count,
    r.unknown_metrics,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM reports AS r
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM fx_rates AS fx
    WHERE
      r.currency_code = fx.currency_code AND r.spend_date >= fx.rate_date
    ORDER BY
      fx.rate_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fx
), with_campaign AS (
  SELECT
    w.spend_id,
    w.campaign_id,
    c.campaign_name,
    COALESCE(w.channel, c.channel) AS channel,
    w.platform_account_id,
    w.spend_date,
    w.currency_code,
    w.spend_amount,
    w.spend_amount * w.rate_to_usd AS spend_usd_unrounded,
    w.impressions,
    w.clicks,
    w.conversions,
    w.metric_count,
    w.unknown_metrics,
    COALESCE(
      w.spend_date BETWEEN c.starts_on AND COALESCE(c.ends_on, CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE)),
      FALSE
    ) AS is_in_flight
  FROM with_rate AS w
  LEFT JOIN campaigns AS c
    ON w.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    c.spend_id,
    c.campaign_id,
    CAST(c.campaign_name AS STRING) AS campaign_name,
    CAST(c.channel AS STRING) AS channel,
    c.platform_account_id,
    c.spend_date,
    c.currency_code,
    CAST(c.spend_amount AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS spend_amount,
    CAST(ROUND(c.spend_usd_unrounded, 2, 'HALF_TO_EVEN') AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS spend_usd,
    CAST(c.impressions AS INT) AS impressions,
    CAST(c.clicks AS INT) AS clicks,
    CAST(c.conversions AS INT) AS conversions,
    CAST(ROUND(c.clicks / NULLIF(c.impressions, 0), 6) AS DECIMAL(9, 6)) AS click_through_rate,
    CAST(ROUND(c.spend_usd_unrounded / NULLIF(c.clicks, 0), 4) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS cost_per_click_usd,
    CAST(c.metric_count AS INT) AS metric_count,
    CAST(c.unknown_metrics AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS unknown_metrics,
    CAST(c.is_in_flight AS BOOLEAN) AS is_in_flight
  FROM with_campaign AS c
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH posts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_influencer_posts
), orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
), post_codes AS (
  SELECT
    p.post_id,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(p.creator_handle, '^@+|\\s+', '')) AS creator_handle,
    LOWER(p.platform) AS platform,
    p.posted_at,
    UPPER(p.promo_code) AS promo_code,
    p.impressions,
    COALESCE(p.likes, 0) + COALESCE(CAST(p.metrics:comments AS INT), 0) + COALESCE(CAST(p.metrics:shares AS INT), 0) AS engagements,
    CAST(p.metrics:saves AS INT) AS saves,
    REGEXP_LIKE(
      COALESCE(CAST(p.metrics:link_url AS STRING), ''),
      '^https?://[^ ]+[?&]utm_source=.*'
    ) AS has_tracking_link
  FROM posts AS p
  WHERE
    NOT p.promo_code IS NULL
), promo_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    UPPER(o.promo_code) AS promo_code,
    o.placed_at,
    o.amount_usd,
    o.discount_amount_usd
  FROM orders AS o
  WHERE
    NOT o.promo_code IS NULL AND o.order_status <> 'CANCELLED'
), credited AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.placed_at,
    o.amount_usd,
    o.discount_amount_usd,
    p.post_id,
    p.posted_at
  FROM promo_orders AS o
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM post_codes AS p
    WHERE
      o.promo_code = p.promo_code AND o.placed_at >= p.posted_at
    ORDER BY
      p.posted_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS p
), in_window AS (
  SELECT
    c.post_id,
    c.order_id,
    c.customer_id,
    c.amount_usd,
    c.discount_amount_usd,
    DATEDIFF(MINUTE, DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', c.posted_at), DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', c.placed_at)) / 60 AS hours_after_post
  FROM credited AS c
  WHERE
    NOT c.post_id IS NULL AND DATEDIFF(c.placed_at, c.posted_at) <= 14
), per_post AS (
  SELECT
    w.post_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w.order_id) AS credited_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w.customer_id) AS credited_customers,
    SUM(w.amount_usd) AS credited_revenue_usd,
    SUM(w.discount_amount_usd) AS discount_given_usd,
    MIN(w.hours_after_post) AS first_order_hours_after_post
  FROM in_window AS w
  GROUP BY
    w.post_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    p.post_id,
    CAST(p.creator_handle AS STRING) AS creator_handle,
    CAST(p.platform AS STRING) AS platform,
    p.posted_at,
    CAST(p.promo_code AS STRING) AS promo_code,
    p.impressions,
    CAST(p.engagements AS INT) AS engagements,
    CAST(p.saves AS INT) AS saves,
    CAST(p.has_tracking_link AS BOOLEAN) AS has_tracking_link,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.credited_orders, 0) AS INT) AS credited_orders,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.credited_customers, 0) AS INT) AS credited_customers,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.credited_revenue_usd, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS credited_revenue_usd,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.discount_given_usd, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS discount_given_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(s.first_order_hours_after_post, 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS first_order_hours_after_post,
    CAST(ROUND(1000 * COALESCE(s.credited_orders, 0) / NULLIF(p.impressions, 0), 4) AS DECIMAL(12, 4)) AS orders_per_thousand_impressions
  FROM post_codes AS p
  LEFT JOIN per_post AS s
    ON p.post_id = s.post_id
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH subscriptions AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_newsletter_subscriptions
), customers AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_customers
), latest_per_list AS (
  SELECT
    s.email,
    s.list_code,
    s.list_status,
    s.subscribed_at,
    s.unsubscribed_at,
    s.is_double_opt_in
  FROM subscriptions AS s
  WHERE
    NOT s.email IS NULL
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.email, s.list_code
      ORDER BY COALESCE(s.unsubscribed_at, s.subscribed_at) DESC, s.list_subscription_id DESC NULLS FIRST
    ) = 1
), first_signup AS (
  SELECT
    s.email,
    s.signup_form AS first_signup_form
  FROM subscriptions AS s
  WHERE
    NOT s.email IS NULL
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.email
      ORDER BY s.subscribed_at NULLS LAST, s.list_subscription_id NULLS LAST
    ) = 1
), by_email AS (
  SELECT
    l.email,
    TO_VARIANT_OBJECT(
      MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(
        COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(l.list_code, CAST(l.list_status AS VARIANT))) FILTER(WHERE
          NOT l.list_code IS NULL AND NOT CAST(l.list_status AS VARIANT) IS NULL)
      )
    ) AS list_status_by_list,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_LIST(IF(l.list_status = 'subscribed', l.list_code, NULL))) AS subscribed_lists,
    COUNT_IF(l.list_status = 'subscribed') AS subscribed_list_count,
    MIN(l.subscribed_at) AS first_subscribed_at,
    MAX(l.unsubscribed_at) AS last_unsubscribed_at,
    BOOL_AND(l.list_status IN ('unsubscribed', 'cleaned')) AS is_globally_unsubscribed,
    BOOL_OR(COALESCE(l.is_double_opt_in, FALSE)) AS has_double_opt_in
  FROM latest_per_list AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.email
), customer_emails AS (
  SELECT
    c.email_normalised AS email,
    MIN(c.customer_id) AS customer_id
  FROM customers AS c
  WHERE
    NOT c.email_normalised IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    c.email_normalised
), prospect_emails AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(b.email AS STRING) AS email
  FROM by_email AS b
  EXCEPT
  SELECT
    CAST(c.email AS STRING) AS email
  FROM customer_emails AS c
), final AS (
  SELECT
    b.email,
    CAST(SPLIT_PART(b.email, '@', 2) AS STRING) AS email_domain,
    CAST(REGEXP_LIKE(b.email, '^(info|admin|sales|support|hello|contact|noreply|no-reply)@.*') AS BOOLEAN) AS is_role_address,
    c.customer_id,
    CAST((
      NOT p.email IS NULL
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_prospect,
    CAST(b.list_status_by_list AS VARIANT) AS list_status_by_list,
    CAST(b.subscribed_lists AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS subscribed_lists,
    CAST(b.subscribed_list_count AS INT) AS subscribed_list_count,
    b.first_subscribed_at,
    b.last_unsubscribed_at,
    CAST(b.is_globally_unsubscribed AS BOOLEAN) AS is_globally_unsubscribed,
    CAST(b.has_double_opt_in AS BOOLEAN) AS has_double_opt_in,
    CAST(f.first_signup_form AS STRING) AS first_signup_form
  FROM by_email AS b
  LEFT JOIN customer_emails AS c
    ON b.email = c.email
  LEFT JOIN prospect_emails AS p
    ON b.email = p.email
  LEFT JOIN first_signup AS f
    ON b.email = f.email
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH invites AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_referral_invites
), identities AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_customer_identity
), order_sequence AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_customer_order_sequence
), fx_rates AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
), currencies AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__currencies
), sequenced_invites AS (
  SELECT
    i.invite_id,
    i.referrer_customer_id,
    i.invitee_email,
    TRY_ELEMENT_AT(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(i.invitee_email, '@(.+)$', 1), 1) AS invitee_email_domain,
    i.sent_at,
    i.accepted_at,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', i.sent_at) AS DATE) AS sent_date,
    i.reward_amount_minor,
    i.reward_currency_code,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY i.referrer_customer_id
      ORDER BY i.sent_at NULLS LAST, i.invite_id NULLS LAST
    ) AS invite_sequence_for_referrer
  FROM invites AS i
), email_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    d.email_normalised,
    MIN_BY(d.customer_id, d.customer_id) AS customer_id
  FROM identities AS d
  WHERE
    NOT d.email_normalised IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    d.email_normalised
), first_orders AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    MIN_BY(s.order_id, s.placed_at) AS first_order_id,
    MIN(s.placed_at) AS first_order_at,
    MIN_BY(s.amount_usd, s.placed_at) AS first_order_usd
  FROM order_sequence AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.customer_id
), referrer_orders AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    COUNT(*) AS lifetime_orders
  FROM order_sequence AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.customer_id
), reward_rates AS (
  SELECT
    v.invite_id,
    (
      CAST(ROUND(
        CAST((
          v.reward_amount_minor / NULLIF((
            CAST(POWER(10, cur.minor_unit_exponent) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
          ), 0)
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
        6
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
    ) * fx.rate_to_usd AS reward_usd
  FROM sequenced_invites AS v
  INNER JOIN currencies AS cur
    ON v.reward_currency_code = cur.currency_code
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM fx_rates AS fx
    WHERE
      v.reward_currency_code = fx.currency_code AND v.sent_date >= fx.rate_date
    ORDER BY
      fx.rate_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fx
), matched AS (
  SELECT
    v.invite_id,
    v.referrer_customer_id,
    a.customer_id AS invitee_customer_id,
    v.invitee_email_domain,
    v.sent_at,
    v.accepted_at,
    v.invite_sequence_for_referrer,
    f.first_order_id,
    f.first_order_at,
    f.first_order_usd,
    r.reward_usd,
    COALESCE(ro.lifetime_orders, 0) AS referrer_lifetime_orders
  FROM sequenced_invites AS v
  LEFT JOIN email_accounts AS a
    ON v.invitee_email = a.email_normalised
  LEFT JOIN first_orders AS f
    ON a.customer_id = f.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN reward_rates AS r
    ON v.invite_id = r.invite_id
  LEFT JOIN referrer_orders AS ro
    ON v.referrer_customer_id = ro.customer_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    m.invite_id,
    m.referrer_customer_id,
    CAST(m.invitee_customer_id AS STRING) AS invitee_customer_id,
    CAST(m.invitee_email_domain AS STRING) AS invitee_email_domain,
    m.sent_at,
    m.accepted_at,
    CAST(ROUND(
      DATEDIFF(MINUTE, DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', m.sent_at), DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', m.accepted_at)) / 60,
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS hours_to_accept,
    CAST(m.first_order_id AS STRING) AS first_order_id,
    CAST(m.first_order_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS first_order_usd,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(m.first_order_at, m.sent_at) AS INT) AS days_to_first_order,
    CAST(EQUAL_NULL(m.invitee_customer_id, m.referrer_customer_id) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_self_referral,
    CAST(COALESCE(
      m.first_order_at >= m.sent_at
      AND DATEDIFF(m.first_order_at, m.sent_at) <= 30
      AND m.first_order_usd >= 20.0
      AND NOT EQUAL_NULL(m.invitee_customer_id, m.referrer_customer_id),
      FALSE
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_qualified,
    CAST(ROUND(m.reward_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS reward_usd,
    CAST(m.invite_sequence_for_referrer AS INT) AS invite_sequence_for_referrer,
    CAST(m.referrer_lifetime_orders AS INT) AS referrer_lifetime_orders
  FROM matched AS m
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH responses AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_survey_responses
), latest_responses AS (
  SELECT
    r.response_id,
    r.survey_code,
    r.customer_id,
    r.submitted_at,
    r.nps_score,
    r.answers
  FROM responses AS r
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY r.customer_id, r.survey_code
      ORDER BY r.submitted_at DESC, r.response_id DESC NULLS FIRST
    ) = 1
), answers AS (
  SELECT
    r.response_id,
    r.survey_code,
    r.customer_id,
    r.submitted_at,
    r.nps_score,
    a.key AS raw_question_key,
    a.value AS answer_value,
    SCHEMA_OF_VARIANT(a.value) AS value_type
  FROM latest_responses AS r, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(CAST(r.answers AS VARIANT)) AS a
), typed AS (
  SELECT
    a.response_id,
    a.survey_code,
    a.customer_id,
    a.submitted_at,
    a.nps_score,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(a.raw_question_key), '[^A-Za-z0-9]+', '_')) AS question_key,
    CASE a.value_type
      WHEN 'NULL_VALUE'
      THEN 'null'
      WHEN 'INTEGER'
      THEN 'number'
      WHEN 'DECIMAL'
      THEN 'number'
      WHEN 'DOUBLE'
      THEN 'number'
      WHEN 'BOOLEAN'
      THEN 'flag'
      WHEN 'ARRAY'
      THEN 'choices'
      WHEN 'VARCHAR'
      THEN IF(TRY_CAST(CAST(a.answer_value AS STRING) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) IS NULL, 'text', 'number')
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS answer_kind,
    a.answer_value
  FROM answers AS a
), cleaned AS (
  SELECT
    t.response_id,
    t.survey_code,
    t.customer_id,
    t.submitted_at,
    t.nps_score,
    t.question_key,
    t.answer_kind,
    IF(
      t.answer_kind = 'number',
      TRY_CAST(CAST(t.answer_value AS STRING) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)),
      NULL
    ) AS answer_number,
    IF(t.answer_kind = 'flag', CAST(t.answer_value AS BOOLEAN), NULL) AS answer_flag,
    IF(
      t.answer_kind = 'text',
      REGEXP_REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.answer_value AS STRING)), ''), '\\s{2,}', ' '),
      NULL
    ) AS answer_text,
    IF(t.answer_kind = 'choices', CAST(t.answer_value AS ARRAY<VARIANT>), NULL) AS answer_choices
  FROM typed AS t
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      c.response_id || ':' || c.question_key
    ) AS STRING) AS answer_key,
    c.response_id,
    c.survey_code,
    c.customer_id,
    c.submitted_at,
    CAST(c.question_key AS STRING) AS question_key,
    CAST(c.answer_kind AS STRING) AS answer_kind,
    CAST(c.answer_number AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS answer_number,
    CAST(c.answer_flag AS BOOLEAN) AS answer_flag,
    CAST(c.answer_text AS STRING) AS answer_text,
    CAST(c.answer_choices AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS answer_choices,
    CAST((
      c.answer_kind <> 'null'
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_answered,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN c.nps_score IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      WHEN c.nps_score >= 9
      THEN 'promoter'
      WHEN c.nps_score >= 7
      THEN 'passive'
      ELSE 'detractor'
    END AS STRING) AS nps_group,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.response_id ORDER BY c.question_key NULLS LAST) AS INT) AS question_position
  FROM cleaned AS c
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH movements AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_stock_movements
), receipts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_po_receipts
), transfers AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_stock_transfers
), warehouses AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
), movement_entries AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      'M:' || m.movement_id
    ) AS STRING) AS ledger_entry_key,
    CAST(m.sku AS STRING) AS sku,
    CAST(m.warehouse_code AS STRING) AS warehouse_code,
    CAST('movement' AS STRING) AS entry_source,
    CAST(m.qty_delta AS INT) AS qty_delta,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, 'UTC', m.moved_at_local) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS occurred_at_utc,
    CAST(m.moved_at_local AS DATE) AS occurred_date_local
  FROM movements AS m
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON m.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  WHERE
    m.reference_type <> 'PO'
), receipt_entries AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      'R:' || r.receipt_id
    ) AS STRING) AS ledger_entry_key,
    CAST(r.sku AS STRING) AS sku,
    CAST(r.warehouse_code AS STRING) AS warehouse_code,
    CAST('receipt' AS STRING) AS entry_source,
    CAST(r.sellable_qty AS INT) AS qty_delta,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, 'UTC', r.received_at_local) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS occurred_at_utc,
    CAST(r.received_at_local AS DATE) AS occurred_date_local
  FROM receipts AS r
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON r.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
), transfer_out_entries AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      'TO:' || t.transfer_id
    ) AS STRING) AS ledger_entry_key,
    CAST(t.sku AS STRING) AS sku,
    CAST(t.from_warehouse_code AS STRING) AS warehouse_code,
    CAST('transfer_out' AS STRING) AS entry_source,
    CAST((
      -t.qty
    ) AS INT) AS qty_delta,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', t.shipped_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS occurred_at_utc,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, t.shipped_at) AS DATE) AS occurred_date_local
  FROM transfers AS t
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON t.from_warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  WHERE
    NOT t.shipped_at IS NULL
), transfer_in_entries AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      'TI:' || t.transfer_id
    ) AS STRING) AS ledger_entry_key,
    CAST(t.sku AS STRING) AS sku,
    CAST(t.to_warehouse_code AS STRING) AS warehouse_code,
    CAST('transfer_in' AS STRING) AS entry_source,
    CAST(t.qty AS INT) AS qty_delta,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', t.arrived_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS occurred_at_utc,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, t.arrived_at) AS DATE) AS occurred_date_local
  FROM transfers AS t
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON t.to_warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  WHERE
    NOT t.arrived_at IS NULL
), all_entries AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(me.ledger_entry_key AS STRING) AS ledger_entry_key,
    CAST(me.sku AS STRING) AS sku,
    CAST(me.warehouse_code AS STRING) AS warehouse_code,
    CAST(me.entry_source AS STRING) AS entry_source,
    CAST(me.qty_delta AS INT) AS qty_delta,
    CAST(me.occurred_at_utc AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS occurred_at_utc,
    CAST(me.occurred_date_local AS DATE) AS occurred_date_local
  FROM movement_entries AS me
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(re.ledger_entry_key AS STRING) AS ledger_entry_key,
    CAST(re.sku AS STRING) AS sku,
    CAST(re.warehouse_code AS STRING) AS warehouse_code,
    CAST(re.entry_source AS STRING) AS entry_source,
    CAST(re.qty_delta AS INT) AS qty_delta,
    CAST(re.occurred_at_utc AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS occurred_at_utc,
    CAST(re.occurred_date_local AS DATE) AS occurred_date_local
  FROM receipt_entries AS re
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(toe.ledger_entry_key AS STRING) AS ledger_entry_key,
    CAST(toe.sku AS STRING) AS sku,
    CAST(toe.warehouse_code AS STRING) AS warehouse_code,
    CAST(toe.entry_source AS STRING) AS entry_source,
    CAST(toe.qty_delta AS INT) AS qty_delta,
    CAST(toe.occurred_at_utc AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS occurred_at_utc,
    CAST(toe.occurred_date_local AS DATE) AS occurred_date_local
  FROM transfer_out_entries AS toe
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(tie.ledger_entry_key AS STRING) AS ledger_entry_key,
    CAST(tie.sku AS STRING) AS sku,
    CAST(tie.warehouse_code AS STRING) AS warehouse_code,
    CAST(tie.entry_source AS STRING) AS entry_source,
    CAST(tie.qty_delta AS INT) AS qty_delta,
    CAST(tie.occurred_at_utc AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS occurred_at_utc,
    CAST(tie.occurred_date_local AS DATE) AS occurred_date_local
  FROM transfer_in_entries AS tie
), final AS (
  SELECT
    a.ledger_entry_key,
    a.sku,
    a.warehouse_code,
    a.entry_source,
    a.qty_delta,
    a.occurred_at_utc,
    a.occurred_date_local,
    CAST(SUM(a.qty_delta) OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.sku, a.warehouse_code
      ORDER BY a.occurred_at_utc NULLS LAST, a.ledger_entry_key NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS INT) AS running_on_hand,
    CAST(COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.sku, a.warehouse_code
      ORDER BY a.occurred_at_utc NULLS LAST, a.ledger_entry_key NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS INT) AS entry_sequence,
    (
      SUM(a.qty_delta) OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.sku, a.warehouse_code
        ORDER BY a.occurred_at_utc NULLS LAST, a.ledger_entry_key NULLS LAST
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) < 0
    ) AS is_negative_balance
  FROM all_entries AS a
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH stock_days AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_stock_on_hand_daily
), costs AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_supplier_cost_current
), valued AS (
  SELECT
    s.warehouse_code,
    s.calendar_date,
    s.sku,
    s.on_hand_qty,
    s.is_stocked_out,
    s.on_hand_qty * c.unit_cost_usd AS stock_value_usd,
    IF(c.unit_cost_usd IS NULL, s.on_hand_qty, 0) AS unvalued_units
  FROM stock_days AS s
  LEFT JOIN costs AS c
    ON s.sku = c.sku
), daily AS (
  SELECT
    v.warehouse_code,
    v.calendar_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.sku) AS sku_count,
    SUM(GREATEST(v.on_hand_qty, 0)) AS units_on_hand,
    SUM(GREATEST(v.stock_value_usd, 0)) AS stock_value_usd,
    SUM(v.unvalued_units) AS unvalued_units,
    COUNT_IF(v.is_stocked_out) AS stocked_out_skus
  FROM valued AS v
  GROUP BY
    v.warehouse_code,
    v.calendar_date
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      d.warehouse_code || '|' || DATE_FORMAT(d.calendar_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
    ) AS STRING) AS valuation_key,
    d.warehouse_code,
    d.calendar_date,
    CAST(d.sku_count AS INT) AS sku_count,
    CAST(d.units_on_hand AS INT) AS units_on_hand,
    CAST(ROUND(d.stock_value_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS stock_value_usd,
    CAST(d.unvalued_units AS INT) AS unvalued_units,
    CAST(d.stocked_out_skus AS INT) AS stocked_out_skus,
    CAST(ROUND(
      d.stock_value_usd - LAG(d.stock_value_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY d.warehouse_code ORDER BY d.calendar_date NULLS LAST),
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS value_change_usd
  FROM daily AS d
)

  *
FROM final

WITH po_lines AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_purchase_order_lines
), purchase_orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_purchase_orders
), receipts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_po_receipts
), warehouses AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
), receipt_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.po_id,
    r.sku,
    SUM(r.received_qty) AS received_qty,
    SUM(r.damaged_qty) AS damaged_qty,
    MIN(r.received_at_local) AS first_received_at_local,
    COUNT(*) AS receipt_count,
    ARRAY_DISTINCT(FLATTEN(COLLECT_LIST(r.discrepancy_codes))) AS discrepancy_codes
  FROM receipts AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.po_id,
    r.sku
), expected_local AS (
  SELECT
    p.po_id,
    p.supplier_code,
    p.warehouse_code,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, p.expected_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS expected_at_local
  FROM purchase_orders AS p
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON p.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
), final AS (
  SELECT
    l.po_line_key,
    l.po_id,
    e.supplier_code,
    e.warehouse_code,
    l.sku,
    l.ordered_qty,
    CAST(COALESCE(r.received_qty, 0) AS INT) AS received_qty,
    CAST(COALESCE(r.damaged_qty, 0) AS INT) AS damaged_qty,
    CAST(GREATEST(l.ordered_qty - COALESCE(r.received_qty, 0), 0) AS INT) AS outstanding_qty,
    CAST(ROUND(LEAST(COALESCE(r.received_qty, 0) / NULLIF(l.ordered_qty, 0), 1), 4) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS fill_rate,
    r.first_received_at_local,
    CAST(GREATEST(DATEDIFF(r.first_received_at_local, e.expected_at_local), 0) AS INT) AS days_late,
    CAST(COALESCE(r.receipt_count, 0) AS INT) AS receipt_count,
    CAST(COALESCE(r.discrepancy_codes, ARRAY()) AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS discrepancy_codes
  FROM po_lines AS l
  INNER JOIN expected_local AS e
    ON l.po_id = e.po_id
  LEFT JOIN receipt_totals AS r
    ON l.po_id = r.po_id AND l.sku = r.sku
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH reservations AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_stock_reservations
), ledger AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_inventory_ledger
), latest_balance AS (
  SELECT
    l.sku,
    l.warehouse_code,
    l.running_on_hand
  FROM ledger AS l
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.sku, l.warehouse_code
      ORDER BY l.entry_sequence DESC NULLS FIRST, l.ledger_entry_key DESC NULLS FIRST
    ) = 1
), open_holds AS (
  SELECT
    r.sku,
    r.warehouse_code,
    COUNT(*) AS open_reservations,
    SUM(IF(r.is_backorder, 0, r.qty)) AS reserved_qty,
    SUM(IF(r.is_backorder, r.qty, 0)) AS backordered_qty,
    MIN(r.reserved_at) AS oldest_reserved_at
  FROM reservations AS r
  WHERE
    r.is_open
  GROUP BY
    r.sku,
    r.warehouse_code
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      o.sku || '|' || o.warehouse_code
    ) AS STRING) AS stock_key,
    o.sku,
    o.warehouse_code,
    CAST(o.open_reservations AS INT) AS open_reservations,
    CAST(o.reserved_qty AS INT) AS reserved_qty,
    CAST(o.backordered_qty AS INT) AS backordered_qty,
    CAST(COALESCE(b.running_on_hand, 0) AS INT) AS on_hand_qty,
    CAST((
      COALESCE(b.running_on_hand, 0) - o.reserved_qty
    ) AS INT) AS available_to_promise,
    o.oldest_reserved_at
  FROM open_holds AS o
  LEFT JOIN latest_balance AS b
    ON o.sku = b.sku AND o.warehouse_code = b.warehouse_code
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_stock_counts
), ledger AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_inventory_ledger
), warehouses AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
), counts_utc AS (
  SELECT
    c.count_id,
    c.sku,
    c.warehouse_code,
    c.counted_at_local,
    c.counted_qty,
    c.is_blind_count,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, 'UTC', c.counted_at_local) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS counted_at_utc
  FROM counts AS c
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON c.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
), with_expected AS (
  SELECT
    c.count_id,
    c.sku,
    c.warehouse_code,
    c.counted_at_local,
    c.counted_qty,
    c.is_blind_count,
    COALESCE(l.running_on_hand, 0) AS expected_qty
  FROM counts_utc AS c
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM ledger AS l
    WHERE
      c.sku = l.sku
      AND c.warehouse_code = l.warehouse_code
      AND c.counted_at_utc >= l.occurred_at_utc
    ORDER BY
      l.occurred_at_utc DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS l
), final AS (
  SELECT
    e.count_id,
    e.sku,
    e.warehouse_code,
    e.counted_at_local,
    e.counted_qty,
    CAST(e.expected_qty AS INT) AS expected_qty,
    CAST((
      e.counted_qty - e.expected_qty
    ) AS INT) AS variance_qty,
    CAST(ROUND((
      e.counted_qty - e.expected_qty
    ) / NULLIF(e.expected_qty, 0), 4) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS variance_pct,
    (
      ABS(e.counted_qty - e.expected_qty) > 2
      AND ABS(e.counted_qty - e.expected_qty) > 0.05 * GREATEST(e.expected_qty, 1)
    ) AS is_out_of_tolerance,
    e.is_blind_count,
    CAST(COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY e.sku, e.warehouse_code, CAST(e.counted_at_local AS DATE)
      ORDER BY e.counted_at_local NULLS LAST, e.count_id NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS INT) AS recount_sequence
  FROM with_expected AS e
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH ledger AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_inventory_ledger
), counts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_stock_counts
), warehouses AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
), spine_offsets AS (
  SELECT
    SEQUENCE(0, 729) AS day_offsets
), date_spine AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATEADD(DAY, CAST(d.value AS INT), CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS calendar_date
  FROM spine_offsets AS o, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(CAST(o.day_offsets AS VARIANT)) AS d
), stock_keys AS (
  SELECT
    l.sku,
    l.warehouse_code,
    MIN(l.occurred_date_local) AS first_date
  FROM ledger AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.sku,
    l.warehouse_code
), key_days AS (
  SELECT
    k.sku,
    k.warehouse_code,
    d.calendar_date,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, 'UTC', CAST(DATEADD(DAY, 1, d.calendar_date) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ)) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS day_end_utc,
    CAST(DATEADD(DAY, 1, d.calendar_date) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS day_end_local
  FROM stock_keys AS k
  INNER JOIN date_spine AS d
    ON d.calendar_date >= k.first_date
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON k.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  WHERE
    d.calendar_date <= CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE)
), with_balance AS (
  SELECT
    kd.sku,
    kd.warehouse_code,
    kd.calendar_date,
    kd.day_end_local,
    l.running_on_hand
  FROM key_days AS kd
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM ledger AS l
    WHERE
      kd.sku = l.sku
      AND kd.warehouse_code = l.warehouse_code
      AND kd.day_end_utc > l.occurred_at_utc
    ORDER BY
      l.occurred_at_utc DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS l
), with_count AS (
  SELECT
    b.sku,
    b.warehouse_code,
    b.calendar_date,
    b.running_on_hand,
    c.counted_qty,
    c.counted_at_local
  FROM with_balance AS b
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM counts AS c
    WHERE
      b.sku = c.sku
      AND b.warehouse_code = c.warehouse_code
      AND b.day_end_local > c.counted_at_local
    ORDER BY
      c.counted_at_local DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS c
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      c.sku || '|' || c.warehouse_code || '|' || DATE_FORMAT(c.calendar_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
    ) AS STRING) AS stock_day_key,
    c.sku,
    c.warehouse_code,
    c.calendar_date,
    MAKE_DATE(YEAR(c.calendar_date), MONTH(c.calendar_date), 1) AS month_start,
    CAST(COALESCE(c.running_on_hand, 0) AS INT) AS on_hand_qty,
    CAST(c.counted_qty AS INT) AS last_counted_qty,
    CAST(c.counted_at_local AS DATE) AS last_counted_date,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(c.calendar_date, CAST(c.counted_at_local AS DATE)) AS INT) AS days_since_count,
    (
      COALESCE(c.running_on_hand, 0) <= 0
    ) AS is_stocked_out
  FROM with_count AS c
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_stock_transfers
), lane_history AS (
  SELECT
    t.from_warehouse_code,
    t.to_warehouse_code,
    MEDIAN(t.transit_hours) AS lane_median_transit_hours
  FROM transfers AS t
  WHERE
    NOT t.arrived_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    t.from_warehouse_code,
    t.to_warehouse_code
), final AS (
  SELECT
    t.transfer_id,
    t.sku,
    t.from_warehouse_code,
    t.to_warehouse_code,
    t.qty,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN NOT t.arrived_at IS NULL
      THEN 'arrived'
      WHEN NOT t.shipped_at IS NULL
      THEN 'in_transit'
      ELSE 'planned'
    END AS STRING) AS transfer_state,
    t.shipped_at,
    CAST(DATEADD(
      MINUTE,
      CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(h.lane_median_transit_hours, 48) * 60) AS INT),
      t.shipped_at
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS expected_arrival_at,
    CAST(h.lane_median_transit_hours AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS lane_median_transit_hours,
    (
      t.arrived_at IS NULL
      AND DATEADD(
        MINUTE,
        CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(h.lane_median_transit_hours, 48) * 60) AS INT),
        t.shipped_at
      ) < CAST('2026-03-31' AS TIMESTAMP)
    ) AS is_overdue
  FROM transfers AS t
  LEFT JOIN lane_history AS h
    ON t.from_warehouse_code = h.from_warehouse_code
    AND t.to_warehouse_code = h.to_warehouse_code

WITH purchase_orders AS (

    CAST(ROUND(COUNT_IF(r.max_days_late = 0) / COUNT(*), 4) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS on_time_rate,

WITH carts AS (

), cart_items AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_cart_items
), orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_orders
), item_totals AS (
  SELECT
    i.cart_id,
    COUNT(*) AS item_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(i.quantity, 1)) AS units,
    SUM(COALESCE(i.quantity, 1) * COALESCE(i.unit_amount_minor, 0)) AS cart_value_minor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT UDF__SKU_FAMILY(i.sku)) AS distinct_sku_families
  FROM cart_items AS i
  GROUP BY
    i.cart_id
), cart_activity AS (
  SELECT
    c.cart_id,
    c.customer_id,
    c.storefront_code,
    c.cart_status,
    COALESCE(c.updated_at, c.created_at) AS last_activity_at
  FROM carts AS c
), customer_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.placed_at
  FROM orders AS o
  WHERE
    NOT o.customer_id IS NULL
), matches AS (
  SELECT
    a.cart_id,
    co.order_id,
    co.placed_at
  FROM cart_activity AS a
  INNER JOIN customer_orders AS co
    ON a.customer_id = co.customer_id AND co.placed_at >= a.last_activity_at
  WHERE
    DATEDIFF(HOUR, DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', a.last_activity_at), DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', co.placed_at)) <= 24
), first_match AS (
  SELECT
    m.cart_id,
    MIN_BY(m.order_id, m.placed_at) AS converted_order_id,
    MIN(m.placed_at) AS converted_at
  FROM matches AS m
  GROUP BY
    m.cart_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    a.cart_id,
    a.customer_id,
    a.storefront_code,
    a.cart_status,
    CAST(COALESCE(t.item_count, 0) AS INT) AS item_count,
    CAST(COALESCE(t.units, 0) AS INT) AS units,
    CAST(COALESCE(t.cart_value_minor, 0) AS INT) AS cart_value_minor,
    a.last_activity_at,
    CAST(f.converted_order_id AS STRING) AS converted_order_id,
    (
      NOT f.converted_order_id IS NULL OR a.cart_status = 'ordered'
    ) AS is_converted,
    (
      f.converted_order_id IS NULL
      AND NOT a.cart_status IN ('ordered', 'merged')
      AND COALESCE(t.item_count, 0) > 0
    ) AS is_abandoned,
    CAST(ROUND(
      DATEDIFF(
        MINUTE,
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', a.last_activity_at),
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', f.converted_at)
      ) / 60,
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS hours_to_convert,
    CAST(COALESCE(t.distinct_sku_families, 0) AS INT) AS distinct_sku_families
  FROM cart_activity AS a
  LEFT JOIN item_totals AS t
    ON a.cart_id = t.cart_id
  LEFT JOIN first_match AS f
    ON a.cart_id = f.cart_id

WITH order_lines AS (

), line_discounts AS (

    *

), promotions AS (

    *

), discounts_with_promotion AS (
  SELECT
    d.order_line_id,
    d.discount_kind,
    COALESCE(d.discount_amount_minor, 0) AS discount_amount_minor,
    p.promo_code,
    COALESCE(p.is_stackable, FALSE) AS is_stackable
  FROM line_discounts AS d
  LEFT JOIN promotions AS p
    ON d.discount_code = p.promo_code
), kind_totals AS (
  SELECT
    dp.order_line_id,
    dp.discount_kind,
    SUM(dp.discount_amount_minor) AS kind_amount_minor
  FROM discounts_with_promotion AS dp
  GROUP BY
    dp.order_line_id,
    dp.discount_kind
), kind_objects AS (
  SELECT
    k.order_line_id,
    TO_VARIANT_OBJECT(
      MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(
        COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(k.discount_kind, CAST(k.kind_amount_minor AS VARIANT))) FILTER(WHERE
          NOT k.discount_kind IS NULL AND NOT CAST(k.kind_amount_minor AS VARIANT) IS NULL)
      )
    ) AS discount_by_kind,
    SUM(k.kind_amount_minor) AS discount_amount_minor
  FROM kind_totals AS k
  GROUP BY
    k.order_line_id
), promotion_sets AS (
  SELECT
    dp.order_line_id,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(dp.promo_code)) AS promo_codes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dp.promo_code) AS promotion_count,
    BOOL_AND(dp.is_stackable) AS all_stackable
  FROM discounts_with_promotion AS dp
  WHERE
    NOT dp.promo_code IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    dp.order_line_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    l.order_line_id,
    l.order_id,
    l.sku,
    l.quantity,
    l.gross_amount_minor,
    CAST(LEAST(COALESCE(k.discount_amount_minor, 0), l.gross_amount_minor) AS INT) AS discount_amount_minor,
    CAST((
      l.gross_amount_minor - LEAST(COALESCE(k.discount_amount_minor, 0), l.gross_amount_minor)
    ) AS INT) AS net_amount_minor,
    l.tax_amount_minor,
    CAST(COALESCE(k.discount_by_kind, PARSE_JSON('{}')) AS VARIANT) AS discount_by_kind,
    CAST(COALESCE(ps.promo_codes, ARRAY()) AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS promo_codes,
    (
      COALESCE(ps.promotion_count, 0) > 1 AND COALESCE(ps.all_stackable, FALSE)
    ) AS has_stacked_promotions,
    CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(k.discount_amount_minor, 0) / NULLIF(l.gross_amount_minor, 0), 6) AS DECIMAL(9, 6)) AS discount_share
  FROM order_lines AS l
  LEFT JOIN kind_objects AS k
    ON l.order_line_id = k.order_line_id
  LEFT JOIN promotion_sets AS ps
    ON l.order_line_id = ps.order_line_id
)

WITH lines AS (

), orders AS (

), price_lists AS (

), variants AS (

), line_context AS (
  SELECT

    l.quantity,
    r.unit_amount_minor,
