    o.placed_at,
    o.sales_channel
  FROM lines AS l
  INNER JOIN raw_lines AS r
    ON l.order_line_id = r.order_line_id
  INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON l.order_id = o.order_id
), candidate_prices AS (
  SELECT
    c.order_line_id,
    p.list_amount_minor,
    p.valid_from
  FROM line_context AS c
  INNER JOIN price_lists AS p
    ON c.sku = p.sku
    AND c.currency_code = p.currency_code
    AND c.placed_at >= p.valid_from
    AND (
      c.placed_at < p.valid_to OR p.valid_to IS NULL
    )
  WHERE
    c.quantity >= p.min_quantity
    AND (
      SIZE(CAST(p.channel_restrictions AS ARRAY<VARIANT>)) = 0
      OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(CAST(p.channel_restrictions AS ARRAY<VARIANT>), CAST(c.sales_channel AS VARIANT))
    )
), applied_prices AS (
  SELECT
    cp.order_line_id,
    MAX_BY(cp.list_amount_minor, cp.valid_from) AS list_amount_minor
  FROM candidate_prices AS cp
  GROUP BY
    cp.order_line_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    c.order_line_id,
    c.order_id,
    c.sku,
    CAST(UDF__SKU_FAMILY(c.sku) AS STRING) AS sku_family,
    v.product_id,
    c.quantity,
    c.unit_amount_minor,
    CAST(a.list_amount_minor AS INT) AS list_amount_minor,
    CAST(ROUND(100 * (
      1 - c.unit_amount_minor / NULLIF(a.list_amount_minor, 0)
    ), 4) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS markdown_pct,
    c.gross_amount_minor,
    c.net_amount_minor,
    c.discount_amount_minor,
    c.tax_amount_minor,
    CAST((
      c.quantity * COALESCE(v.weight_kg, 0)
    ) AS DECIMAL(12, 3)) AS line_weight_kg,
    (
      NOT a.list_amount_minor IS NULL
    ) AS has_list_price
  FROM line_context AS c
  LEFT JOIN applied_prices AS a
    ON c.order_line_id = a.order_line_id
  LEFT JOIN variants AS v

)

WITH attempts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_payment_attempts
), refunds AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_refunds
), chargebacks AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_chargebacks
), gift_card_transactions AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_gift_card_transactions
), successful AS (
  SELECT
    a.order_id,
    CASE
      WHEN a.payment_method IN ('card', 'credit_card', 'debit_card')
      THEN 'CARD'
      WHEN a.payment_method IN ('wallet', 'phone_wallet', 'browser_wallet', 'account_wallet')
      THEN 'WALLET'
      WHEN a.payment_method IN ('bank_transfer', 'sepa', 'bank_redirect')
      THEN 'BANK'
      ELSE 'OTHER'
    END AS method_group,
    a.amount_minor
  FROM attempts AS a
  WHERE
    a.is_successful
), captured_by_method AS (
  SELECT
    p.order_id,
    COALESCE(p.card, 0) AS card_captured_minor,
    COALESCE(p.wallet, 0) AS wallet_captured_minor,
    COALESCE(p.bank, 0) AS bank_transfer_captured_minor,
    COALESCE(p.other, 0) AS other_captured_minor
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM successful
    PIVOT(SUM(amount_minor) FOR 
      method_group IN (
        'CARD' AS `'CARD'`,
        'WALLET' AS `'WALLET'`,
        'BANK' AS `'BANK'`,
        'OTHER' AS `'OTHER'`
      )
    )
  ) AS p(order_id, card, wallet, bank, other)
), attempt_stats AS (
  SELECT
    a.order_id,
    COUNT_IF(NOT a.is_successful) AS failed_attempts,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(a.payment_method)) AS tender_methods
  FROM attempts AS a
  GROUP BY
    a.order_id
), payment_orders AS (
  SELECT
    a.payment_id,
    a.order_id
  FROM attempts AS a
), refunded AS (
  SELECT
    po.order_id,
    SUM(r.amount_minor) AS refunded_minor
  FROM refunds AS r
  INNER JOIN payment_orders AS po
    ON r.payment_id = po.payment_id
  GROUP BY
    po.order_id
), charged_back AS (
  SELECT
    po.order_id,
    SUM(c.amount_minor) AS chargeback_minor
  FROM chargebacks AS c
  INNER JOIN payment_orders AS po
    ON c.payment_id = po.payment_id
  WHERE
    c.outcome <> 'won'
  GROUP BY
    po.order_id
), gift_card_tender AS (
  SELECT
    g.order_id,
    -SUM(g.signed_amount_minor) AS gift_card_tender_minor
  FROM gift_card_transactions AS g
  WHERE
    g.transaction_type IN ('REDEEM', 'REVERSAL') AND NOT g.order_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    g.order_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    s.order_id,
    CAST(COALESCE(m.card_captured_minor, 0) AS INT) AS card_captured_minor,
    CAST(COALESCE(m.wallet_captured_minor, 0) AS INT) AS wallet_captured_minor,
    CAST(COALESCE(m.bank_transfer_captured_minor, 0) AS INT) AS bank_transfer_captured_minor,
    CAST(COALESCE(m.other_captured_minor, 0) AS INT) AS other_captured_minor,
    CAST((
      COALESCE(m.card_captured_minor, 0) + COALESCE(m.wallet_captured_minor, 0) + COALESCE(m.bank_transfer_captured_minor, 0) + COALESCE(m.other_captured_minor, 0)
    ) AS INT) AS captured_minor,
    CAST(COALESCE(r.refunded_minor, 0) AS INT) AS refunded_minor,
    CAST(COALESCE(cb.chargeback_minor, 0) AS INT) AS chargeback_minor,
    CAST(COALESCE(g.gift_card_tender_minor, 0) AS INT) AS gift_card_tender_minor,
    CAST((
      COALESCE(m.card_captured_minor, 0) + COALESCE(m.wallet_captured_minor, 0) + COALESCE(m.bank_transfer_captured_minor, 0) + COALESCE(m.other_captured_minor, 0) + COALESCE(g.gift_card_tender_minor, 0) - COALESCE(r.refunded_minor, 0) - COALESCE(cb.chargeback_minor, 0)
    ) AS INT) AS net_collected_minor,
    CAST(s.failed_attempts AS INT) AS failed_attempts,
    CAST(s.tender_methods AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS tender_methods
  FROM attempt_stats AS s
  LEFT JOIN captured_by_method AS m
    ON s.order_id = m.order_id
  LEFT JOIN refunded AS r
    ON s.order_id = r.order_id
  LEFT JOIN charged_back AS cb
    ON s.order_id = cb.order_id
  LEFT JOIN gift_card_tender AS g
    ON s.order_id = g.order_id
)

WITH status_events AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_order_status_events
), orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_orders
), ranked_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.order_id,
    e.to_status,
    e.changed_at,
    CAST(MAP('cancelled', 7, 'delivered', 5, 'packed', 3, 'paid', 2, 'pending', 1, 'returned', 6, 'shipped', 4)[e.to_status] AS INT) AS status_rank,
    LEAD(e.changed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY e.order_id ORDER BY e.changed_at NULLS LAST, e.event_id NULLS LAST) AS next_changed_at
  FROM status_events AS e
), with_previous AS (
  SELECT
    r.event_id,
    r.order_id,
    r.to_status,
    r.changed_at,
    r.status_rank,
    r.next_changed_at,
    LAG(r.status_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY r.order_id ORDER BY r.changed_at NULLS LAST, r.event_id NULLS LAST) AS previous_rank
  FROM ranked_events AS r
), durations AS (
  SELECT
    w.order_id,
    w.to_status,
    SUM(
      DATEDIFF(
        MINUTE,
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', w.changed_at),
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', COALESCE(w.next_changed_at, w.changed_at))
      )
    ) AS minutes_in_status
  FROM with_previous AS w
  GROUP BY
    w.order_id,
    w.to_status
), longest AS (
  SELECT
    d.order_id,
    MAX_BY(d.to_status, d.minutes_in_status) AS longest_status
  FROM durations AS d
  GROUP BY
    d.order_id
), milestones AS (
  SELECT
    w.order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transition_count,
    MIN(IF(w.to_status = 'paid', w.changed_at, NULL)) AS first_paid_at,
    MIN(IF(w.to_status = 'shipped', w.changed_at, NULL)) AS first_shipped_at,
    MIN(IF(w.to_status = 'delivered', w.changed_at, NULL)) AS first_delivered_at,
    MAX(IF(w.to_status = 'cancelled', w.changed_at, NULL)) AS cancelled_at,
    LISTAGG(w.to_status, ' > ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY
      w.changed_at NULLS LAST,
      w.event_id NULLS LAST) AS status_path,
    BOOL_OR(w.status_rank < w.previous_rank AND NOT w.to_status IN ('cancelled', 'returned')) AS has_regression,
    MAX_BY(w.to_status, w.changed_at) AS last_status
  FROM with_previous AS w
  GROUP BY
    w.order_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    m.order_id,
    CAST(m.transition_count AS INT) AS transition_count,
    m.first_paid_at,
    m.first_shipped_at,
    m.first_delivered_at,
    m.cancelled_at,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', o.placed_at), DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', m.first_paid_at)) AS INT) AS minutes_to_pay,
    CAST(ROUND(
      DATEDIFF(
        MINUTE,
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', m.first_paid_at),
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', m.first_shipped_at)
      ) / 60,
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS hours_paid_to_shipped,
    CAST(m.status_path AS STRING) AS status_path,
    COALESCE(m.has_regression, FALSE) AS has_regression,
    CAST(m.last_status AS STRING) AS last_status,
    CAST(l.longest_status AS STRING) AS longest_status
  FROM milestones AS m
  INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON m.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN longest AS l
    ON m.order_id = l.order_id
)

), storefronts AS (

), final AS (

    CAST(COALESCE(t.line_count, 0) AS INT) AS line_count,
    CAST(COALESCE(t.units, 0) AS INT) AS units,
    CAST(COALESCE(t.gross_amount_minor, 0) AS INT) AS gross_amount_minor,

    CAST(COALESCE(c.captured_amount_minor, 0) AS INT) AS captured_amount_minor,
    CAST(GREATEST(

    ) AS INT) AS outstanding_amount_minor,
    r.promo_code,

    NOT REGEXP_LIKE(COALESCE(cu.email_normalised, ''), '.*@example\\.(org|net)$') AS is_first_party_customer,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(t.units, 0) <= 1
      THEN 'SINGLE'
      WHEN t.units < 6
      THEN 'SMALL'
      ELSE 'LARGE'

    CAST(NULLIF(LOWER(o.utm_source), '') AS STRING) AS utm_source,

    CAST(NULLIF(LOWER(o.utm_campaign), '') AS STRING) AS utm_campaign,
    CAST(COALESCE(t.total_weight_kg, 0) AS DECIMAL(12, 3)) AS total_weight_kg
  FROM orders AS o
  LEFT JOIN line_totals AS t
    ON o.order_id = t.order_id
  LEFT JOIN captured AS c
    ON o.order_id = c.order_id
  LEFT JOIN first_redemption AS r
    ON o.order_id = r.order_id
  LEFT JOIN shipping AS sh
    ON o.order_id = sh.order_id
  LEFT JOIN storefronts AS s
    ON o.storefront_code = s.storefront_code
  LEFT JOIN customers AS cu
    ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id
)

WITH payments AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_payments
), chargebacks AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_chargebacks
), sequenced AS (
  SELECT
    p.payment_id,
    p.order_id,
    p.payment_method,
    p.amount_minor,
    p.currency_code,
    p.authorised_at,
    p.gateway_status,
    p.gateway_error_code,
    p.gateway_response,
    p.risk_score,
    p.three_ds_outcome,
    p.card_bin,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.order_id
      ORDER BY p.authorised_at NULLS LAST, p.payment_id NULLS LAST
    ) AS attempt_number,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.order_id) AS attempt_count,
    LAG(p.authorised_at) OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.order_id
      ORDER BY p.authorised_at NULLS LAST, p.payment_id NULLS LAST
    ) AS previous_authorised_at
  FROM payments AS p
), decline_reasons AS (
  SELECT
    s.payment_id,
    LOWER(COALESCE(CAST(s.gateway_response:status.message AS STRING), '')) AS decline_message
  FROM sequenced AS s
  WHERE
    NOT s.gateway_status IN ('captured', 'settled', 'authorised')
), classified AS (
  SELECT
    d.payment_id,
    CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(d.decline_message, '.*(insufficient|nsf|limit exceeded).*')
      THEN 'INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(d.decline_message, '.*(fraud|stolen|lost card|pickup).*')
      THEN 'SUSPECTED_FRAUD'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(d.decline_message, '.*(3ds|authentication|challenge).*')
      THEN 'AUTHENTICATION'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(d.decline_message, '.*(timeout|unavailable|error [0-9]{3}).*')
      THEN 'TECHNICAL'
      ELSE 'OTHER'
    END AS decline_family
  FROM decline_reasons AS d
), chargeback_flags AS (
  SELECT
    c.payment_id,
    COUNT(*) AS chargeback_count
  FROM chargebacks AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.payment_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    s.payment_id,
    s.order_id,
    CAST(s.attempt_number AS INT) AS attempt_number,
    CAST(s.attempt_count AS INT) AS attempt_count,
    (
      s.attempt_number = s.attempt_count
    ) AS is_final_attempt,
    s.payment_method,
    CAST(s.amount_minor AS INT) AS amount_minor,
    s.currency_code,
    s.authorised_at,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(
      SECOND,
      DATE_TRUNC('SECOND', s.previous_authorised_at),
      DATE_TRUNC('SECOND', s.authorised_at)
    ) AS INT) AS seconds_since_previous_attempt,
    s.gateway_status,
    (
      s.gateway_status IN ('captured', 'settled', 'authorised')
    ) AS is_successful,
    CAST(COALESCE(c.decline_family, 'NONE') AS STRING) AS decline_family,
    s.gateway_error_code,
    s.risk_score,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN s.risk_score IS NULL
      THEN 'unscored'
      WHEN s.risk_score >= 75
      THEN 'high'
      WHEN s.risk_score >= 40
      THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'low'
    END AS STRING) AS risk_band,
    s.three_ds_outcome,
    CAST(LUHN_VALID(s.card_bin) AS BOOLEAN) AS card_bin_valid,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(s.card_bin, '^(?:^4[0-9]*)$')
      THEN 'network_a'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(s.card_bin, '^(?:^(5[1-5]|2[2-7])[0-9]*)$')
      THEN 'network_b'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(s.card_bin, '^(?:^3[47][0-9]*)$')
      THEN 'network_c'
      WHEN s.card_bin IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS STRING) AS card_scheme,
    (
      COALESCE(cb.chargeback_count, 0) > 0
    ) AS had_chargeback
  FROM sequenced AS s
  LEFT JOIN classified AS c
    ON s.payment_id = c.payment_id
  LEFT JOIN chargeback_flags AS cb
    ON s.payment_id = cb.payment_id
)

WITH promotions AS (

), promo_totals AS (

    COUNT(DISTINCT ro.order_id) AS redemption_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ro.customer_id) AS redeeming_customers,
    SUM(ro.amount_usd) AS revenue_usd,
    SUM(ro.discount_amount_usd) AS discount_usd,
    AVG(ro.amount_usd) AS avg_order_usd
  FROM redeemed_orders AS ro
  GROUP BY
    ro.promo_code

  SELECT

  WHERE

), final AS (

    p.promo_code,

      CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() BETWEEN p.starts_at AND COALESCE(p.ends_at, CAST('9999-12-31' AS TIMESTAMP))
    ) AS is_active_now,
    CAST(COALESCE(pt.redemption_count, 0) AS INT) AS redemption_count,
    CAST(COALESCE(pt.redeeming_customers, 0) AS INT) AS redeeming_customers,
    CAST(COALESCE(pt.revenue_usd, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS revenue_usd,
    CAST(COALESCE(pt.discount_usd, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS discount_usd,
    CAST((
      CAST((
        pt.discount_usd / NULLIF((
          pt.revenue_usd + pt.discount_usd
        ), 0)
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
    ) AS DECIMAL(9, 6)) AS discount_rate,
    CAST(ROUND(pt.avg_order_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS avg_order_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(b.baseline_avg_order_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS baseline_avg_order_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(100 * (
      pt.avg_order_usd / NULLIF(b.baseline_avg_order_usd, 0) - 1
    ), 2) AS DECIMAL(9, 2)) AS basket_uplift_pct,
    CAST(tt.top_tier_threshold_minor AS INT) AS top_tier_threshold_minor,
    CAST(SIZE(CAST(p.eligible_regions AS ARRAY<VARIANT>)) AS INT) AS eligible_region_count
  FROM promotions AS p
  LEFT JOIN promo_totals AS pt
    ON p.promo_code = pt.promo_code

WITH subscriptions AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_subscriptions
), events AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_subscription_events
), state_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.subscription_id,
    e.event_id,
    e.occurred_at,
    CASE e.event_type
      WHEN 'PAUSE'
      THEN 'paused'
      WHEN 'CANCEL'
      THEN 'cancelled'
      ELSE 'active'
    END AS state
  FROM events AS e
  WHERE
    e.event_type IN ('PAUSE', 'RESUME', 'CANCEL')
), changes AS (
  SELECT
    s.subscription_id,
    s.event_id,
    s.occurred_at,
    s.state,
    LAG(s.state, 1, 'active') OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.subscription_id
      ORDER BY s.occurred_at NULLS LAST, s.event_id NULLS LAST
    ) AS previous_state
  FROM state_events AS s
), islands AS (
  SELECT
    c.subscription_id,
    c.occurred_at,
    c.state,
    SUM(IF(c.previous_state <> c.state, 1, 0)) OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.subscription_id
      ORDER BY c.occurred_at NULLS LAST, c.event_id NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS island_number
  FROM changes AS c
), event_periods AS (
  SELECT
    i.subscription_id,
    i.island_number,
    ANY_VALUE(i.state) AS period_state,
    MIN(i.occurred_at) AS period_start
  FROM islands AS i
  WHERE
    i.island_number >= 1
  GROUP BY
    i.subscription_id,
    i.island_number
), bounded AS (
  SELECT
    p.subscription_id,
    p.island_number + 1 AS period_number,
    p.period_state,
    p.period_start,
    LEAD(p.period_start) OVER (PARTITION BY p.subscription_id ORDER BY p.island_number NULLS LAST) AS period_end
  FROM event_periods AS p
), first_change AS (
  SELECT
    p.subscription_id,
    MIN(p.period_start) AS first_change_at
  FROM event_periods AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.subscription_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      s.subscription_id || '#1'
    ) AS STRING) AS subscription_period_key,
    CAST(s.subscription_id AS STRING) AS subscription_id,
    CAST(s.customer_id AS STRING) AS customer_id,
    CAST(1 AS INT) AS period_number,
    CAST('active' AS STRING) AS period_state,
    CAST(s.started_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS period_start,
    CAST(COALESCE(f.first_change_at, s.cancelled_at) AS TIMESTAMP) AS period_end,
    CAST(ROUND(
      DATEDIFF(
        HOUR,
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', s.started_at),
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', COALESCE(f.first_change_at, s.cancelled_at))
      ) / 24,
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS period_days,
    CAST(s.billing_amount_minor AS INT) AS billing_amount_minor,
    CAST(s.billing_currency_code AS STRING) AS billing_currency_code,
    CAST(s.interval_days AS INT) AS interval_days
  FROM subscriptions AS s
  LEFT JOIN first_change AS f
    ON s.subscription_id = f.subscription_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST((
      b.subscription_id || '#' || CAST(b.period_number AS STRING)
    ) AS STRING) AS subscription_period_key,
    CAST(b.subscription_id AS STRING) AS subscription_id,
    CAST(s.customer_id AS STRING) AS customer_id,
    CAST(b.period_number AS INT) AS period_number,
    CAST(b.period_state AS STRING) AS period_state,
    CAST(b.period_start AS TIMESTAMP) AS period_start,
    CAST(COALESCE(b.period_end, IF(b.period_state = 'cancelled', b.period_start, s.cancelled_at)) AS TIMESTAMP) AS period_end,
    CAST(ROUND(
      DATEDIFF(
        HOUR,
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', b.period_start),
        DATE_TRUNC(
          'HOUR',
          COALESCE(b.period_end, IF(b.period_state = 'cancelled', b.period_start, s.cancelled_at))
        )
      ) / 24,
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS period_days,
    CAST(s.billing_amount_minor AS INT) AS billing_amount_minor,
    CAST(s.billing_currency_code AS STRING) AS billing_currency_code,
    CAST(s.interval_days AS INT) AS interval_days
  FROM bounded AS b
  INNER JOIN subscriptions AS s
    ON b.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
)

WITH settlements AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_settlements
), orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_partner_orders_unified
), order_lines AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_order_lines
), listings AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_listings
), fx_rates AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
), currencies AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__currencies
), listing_terms AS (
  SELECT
    l.partner_code,
    l.sku,
    l.commission_pct
  FROM listings AS l
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.partner_code, l.sku
      ORDER BY l.listed_at DESC, l.listing_id DESC NULLS FIRST
    ) = 1
), line_context AS (
  SELECT
    o.partner_code,
    o.placed_date,
    o.partner_order_key,
    l.sku,
    l.quantity * l.unit_amount_minor AS line_amount_minor
  FROM order_lines AS l
  INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON l.partner_order_key = o.partner_order_key
), line_commission AS (
  SELECT
    c.partner_code,
    c.placed_date,
    c.partner_order_key,
    c.line_amount_minor * t.commission_pct / 100 AS expected_commission_minor,
    (
      t.commission_pct IS NULL
    ) AS has_no_listing
  FROM line_context AS c
  LEFT JOIN listing_terms AS t
    ON c.partner_code = t.partner_code AND c.sku = t.sku
), period_lines AS (
  SELECT
    s.settlement_id,
    SUM(c.expected_commission_minor) AS expected_commission_minor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.partner_order_key) AS period_order_count,
    COUNT_IF(c.has_no_listing) AS lines_without_listing
  FROM settlements AS s
  INNER JOIN line_commission AS c
    ON s.partner_code = c.partner_code
    AND c.placed_date BETWEEN s.period_start AND s.period_end
  GROUP BY
    s.settlement_id
), with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    s.settlement_id,
    s.partner_code,
    s.period_start,
    s.period_end,
    s.currency_code,
    s.gross_sales_minor,
    s.commission_minor,
    s.other_fees_minor,
    s.net_payable_minor,
    cur.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM settlements AS s
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS cur
    ON s.currency_code = cur.currency_code
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM fx_rates AS fx
    WHERE
      s.currency_code = fx.currency_code AND s.period_end >= fx.rate_date
    ORDER BY
      fx.rate_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fx
), converted AS (
  SELECT
    w.settlement_id,
    w.partner_code,
    w.period_start,
    w.period_end,
    w.currency_code,
    w.gross_sales_minor,
    w.commission_minor,
    w.other_fees_minor,
    w.net_payable_minor,
    (
      CAST(ROUND(
        CAST((
          w.gross_sales_minor / NULLIF((
            CAST(POWER(10, COALESCE(w.minor_unit_exponent, 2)) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
          ), 0)
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
        6
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
    ) * w.rate_to_usd AS gross_sales_usd,
    (
      CAST(ROUND(
        CAST((
          w.commission_minor / NULLIF((
            CAST(POWER(10, COALESCE(w.minor_unit_exponent, 2)) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
          ), 0)
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
        6
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
    ) * w.rate_to_usd AS stated_commission_usd,
    (
      CAST(ROUND(
        CAST((
          p.expected_commission_minor / NULLIF((
            CAST(POWER(10, COALESCE(w.minor_unit_exponent, 2)) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
          ), 0)
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
        6
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
    ) * w.rate_to_usd AS expected_commission_usd,
    (
      CAST(ROUND(
        CAST((
          w.other_fees_minor / NULLIF((
            CAST(POWER(10, COALESCE(w.minor_unit_exponent, 2)) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
          ), 0)
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
        6
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
    ) * w.rate_to_usd AS other_fees_usd,
    (
      CAST(ROUND(
        CAST((
          w.net_payable_minor / NULLIF((
            CAST(POWER(10, COALESCE(w.minor_unit_exponent, 2)) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
          ), 0)
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
        6
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
    ) * w.rate_to_usd AS net_payable_usd,
    COALESCE(p.period_order_count, 0) AS period_order_count,
    COALESCE(p.lines_without_listing, 0) AS lines_without_listing
  FROM with_rate AS w
  LEFT JOIN period_lines AS p
    ON w.settlement_id = p.settlement_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    c.settlement_id,
    c.partner_code,
    c.period_start,
    c.period_end,
    CAST((
      DATEDIFF(c.period_end, c.period_start) + 1
    ) AS INT) AS period_days,
    c.currency_code,
    CAST(ROUND(c.gross_sales_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS gross_sales_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(c.stated_commission_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS stated_commission_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(c.expected_commission_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS expected_commission_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(c.other_fees_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS other_fees_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(c.net_payable_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS net_payable_usd,
    CAST(c.period_order_count AS INT) AS period_order_count,
    CAST(c.lines_without_listing AS INT) AS lines_without_listing,
    CAST(ROUND(100 * c.commission_minor / NULLIF(c.gross_sales_minor, 0), 4) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS effective_commission_pct,
    CAST(ROUND(
      100 * (
        c.stated_commission_usd - c.expected_commission_usd
      ) / NULLIF(c.expected_commission_usd, 0),
      4
    ) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS commission_variance_pct,
    CAST(COALESCE(
      ABS(
        100 * (
          c.stated_commission_usd - c.expected_commission_usd
        ) / NULLIF(c.expected_commission_usd, 0)
      ) <= 0.5,
      FALSE
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_within_tolerance,
    CAST((
      c.gross_sales_minor - c.commission_minor - COALESCE(c.other_fees_minor, 0) = c.net_payable_minor
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS statement_balances
  FROM converted AS c
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH listings AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_listings
), catalogue AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_product_catalogue
), reservations AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_reservations_open
), price_history AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_price_history
), partner_orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_partner_orders_unified
), order_lines AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_order_lines
), normalised AS (
  SELECT
    l.listing_id,
    l.partner_code,
    l.sku,
    CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(l.listing_status, '^(live|active|published|on_?sale)$')
      THEN 'live'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(l.listing_status, '^(paused|inactive|suspended|out_?of_?stock)$')
      THEN 'paused'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(l.listing_status, '^(rejected|blocked|error.*)$')
      THEN 'rejected'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(l.listing_status, '^(draft|pending.*|in_?review)$')
      THEN 'draft'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(l.listing_status, '^(ended|closed|deleted|archived)$')
      THEN 'ended'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS listing_state,
    l.listed_at,
    l.commission_pct,
    l.fulfilled_by_partner,
    JSON_OBJECT_KEYS(TO_JSON(COALESCE(l.terms, PARSE_JSON('{}')))) AS term_keys,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY l.sku) AS partners_listing_sku
  FROM listings AS l
), current_prices AS (
  SELECT
    p.sku,
    p.currency_code,
    p.list_amount_minor
  FROM price_history AS p
  WHERE
    p.effective_valid_to IS NULL OR p.effective_valid_to > CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE)
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.sku
      ORDER BY IF(p.currency_code = 'USD', 0, 1) NULLS LAST, p.valid_from DESC NULLS FIRST, p.price_list_id NULLS LAST
    ) = 1
), stock AS (
  SELECT
    r.sku,
    SUM(GREATEST(r.available_to_promise, 0)) AS available_to_promise
  FROM reservations AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.sku
), recent_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.partner_order_key,
    o.partner_code
  FROM partner_orders AS o
  WHERE
    o.placed_date > DATEADD(DAY, -30, CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE))
), recent_sales AS (
  SELECT
    o.partner_code,
    l.sku,
    SUM(l.quantity) AS units_sold_30d
  FROM order_lines AS l
  INNER JOIN recent_orders AS o
    ON l.partner_order_key = o.partner_order_key
  GROUP BY
    o.partner_code,
    l.sku
), joined AS (
  SELECT
    n.listing_id,
    n.partner_code,
    n.sku,
    n.listing_state,
    n.listed_at,
    c.title AS product_title,
    c.brand_name,
    c.is_active AS is_catalogue_active,
    p.list_amount_minor AS current_list_price_minor,
    p.currency_code AS list_price_currency_code,
    COALESCE(s.available_to_promise, 0) AS available_to_promise,
    n.commission_pct,
    n.fulfilled_by_partner,
    n.term_keys,
    COALESCE(rs.units_sold_30d, 0) AS units_sold_30d,
    n.partners_listing_sku
  FROM normalised AS n
  LEFT JOIN catalogue AS c
    ON n.sku = c.sku
  LEFT JOIN current_prices AS p
    ON n.sku = p.sku
  LEFT JOIN stock AS s
    ON n.sku = s.sku
  LEFT JOIN recent_sales AS rs
    ON n.partner_code = rs.partner_code AND n.sku = rs.sku
), final AS (
  SELECT
    j.listing_id,
    j.partner_code,
    j.sku,
    CAST(j.listing_state AS STRING) AS listing_state,
    j.listed_at,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE), j.listed_at) AS INT) AS days_listed,
    CAST(j.product_title AS STRING) AS product_title,
    CAST(j.brand_name AS STRING) AS brand_name,
    CAST(j.is_catalogue_active AS BOOLEAN) AS is_catalogue_active,
    CAST(j.current_list_price_minor AS INT) AS current_list_price_minor,
    CAST(j.list_price_currency_code AS STRING) AS list_price_currency_code,
    CAST(j.available_to_promise AS INT) AS available_to_promise,
    j.commission_pct,
    j.fulfilled_by_partner,
    IF(j.fulfilled_by_partner, 'partner', 'home_delivery') AS fulfilment_method,
    CAST(j.term_keys AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS term_keys,
    CAST(j.units_sold_30d AS INT) AS units_sold_30d,
    CAST(j.partners_listing_sku AS INT) AS partners_listing_sku,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN j.listing_state <> 'live'
      THEN 'not_live'
      WHEN j.product_title IS NULL
      THEN 'unknown_sku'
      WHEN NOT COALESCE(j.is_catalogue_active, FALSE)
      THEN 'discontinued'
      WHEN NOT j.fulfilled_by_partner AND j.available_to_promise <= 0
      THEN 'unfulfillable'
      WHEN j.current_list_price_minor IS NULL
      THEN 'unpriced'
      ELSE 'healthy'
    END AS STRING) AS listing_health
  FROM joined AS j
)

  *
FROM final

WITH orders_v1 AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_orders_v1
), orders_v2 AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_orders_v2
), order_lines AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_order_lines
), identities AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_customer_identity
), fx_rates AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
), currencies AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__currencies
), headers AS (
  SELECT
    CAST('stg_partner_orders_v1' AS STRING) AS source_relation,
    partner_order_key,
    partner_code,
    external_order_id,
    currency_code
  FROM rel__stg_partner_orders_v1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST('stg_partner_orders_v2' AS STRING) AS source_relation,
    partner_order_key,
    partner_code,
    external_order_id,
    currency_code
  FROM rel__stg_partner_orders_v2
), v1_details AS (
  SELECT
    o.partner_order_key,
    1 AS payload_version,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', o.placed_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS placed_at_utc,
    ROUND(o.order_total * POWER(10, c.minor_unit_exponent)) AS order_total_minor,
    o.buyer_email,
    SHA2(o.buyer_email, 256) AS buyer_email_hash
  FROM orders_v1 AS o
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS c
    ON o.currency_code = c.currency_code
), v2_details AS (
  SELECT
    o.partner_order_key,
    2 AS payload_version,
    o.placed_at_utc,
    o.order_total_minor,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS buyer_email,
    o.buyer_email_hash
  FROM orders_v2 AS o
), details AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(d.partner_order_key AS STRING) AS partner_order_key,
    CAST(d.payload_version AS INT) AS payload_version,
    CAST(d.placed_at_utc AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS placed_at_utc,
    CAST(d.order_total_minor AS INT) AS order_total_minor,
    CAST(d.buyer_email AS STRING) AS buyer_email,
    CAST(d.buyer_email_hash AS STRING) AS buyer_email_hash
  FROM v1_details AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(d.partner_order_key AS STRING) AS partner_order_key,
    CAST(d.payload_version AS INT) AS payload_version,
    CAST(d.placed_at_utc AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS placed_at_utc,
    CAST(d.order_total_minor AS INT) AS order_total_minor,
    CAST(d.buyer_email AS STRING) AS buyer_email,
    CAST(d.buyer_email_hash AS STRING) AS buyer_email_hash
  FROM v2_details AS d
), line_totals AS (
  SELECT
    l.partner_order_key,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    SUM(l.quantity) AS units,
    SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_amount_minor) AS lines_total_minor
  FROM order_lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.partner_order_key
), identity_hashes AS (
  SELECT
    SHA2(i.email_normalised, 256) AS email_hash,
    MIN(i.customer_id) AS customer_id
  FROM identities AS i
  WHERE
    NOT i.email_normalised IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    SHA2(i.email_normalised, 256)
), combined AS (
  SELECT
    h.partner_order_key,
    h.source_relation,
    d.payload_version,
    h.partner_code,
    h.external_order_id,
    h.currency_code,
    d.placed_at_utc,
    CAST(d.placed_at_utc AS DATE) AS placed_date,
    d.order_total_minor,
    COALESCE(t.line_count, 0) AS line_count,
    COALESCE(t.units, 0) AS units,
    COALESCE(t.lines_total_minor, 0) AS lines_total_minor,
    i.customer_id,
    c.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM headers AS h
  INNER JOIN details AS d
    ON h.partner_order_key = d.partner_order_key
  LEFT JOIN line_totals AS t
    ON h.partner_order_key = t.partner_order_key
  LEFT JOIN identity_hashes AS i
    ON d.buyer_email_hash = i.email_hash
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS c
    ON h.currency_code = c.currency_code
), with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    c.partner_order_key,
    c.source_relation,
    c.payload_version,
    c.partner_code,
    c.external_order_id,
    c.currency_code,
    c.placed_at_utc,
    c.placed_date,
    c.order_total_minor,
    c.line_count,
    c.units,
    c.lines_total_minor,
    c.customer_id,
    c.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM combined AS c
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM fx_rates AS fx
    WHERE
      c.currency_code = fx.currency_code AND c.placed_date >= fx.rate_date
    ORDER BY
      fx.rate_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fx
), final AS (
  SELECT
    w.partner_order_key,
    CAST(w.source_relation AS STRING) AS source_relation,
    w.payload_version,
    CAST(w.partner_code AS STRING) AS partner_code,
    CAST(w.external_order_id AS STRING) AS external_order_id,
    CAST(w.currency_code AS STRING) AS currency_code,
    w.placed_at_utc,
    CAST(w.placed_date AS DATE) AS placed_date,
    w.order_total_minor,
    CAST(ROUND(
      (
        CAST(ROUND(
          CAST((
            w.order_total_minor / NULLIF((
              CAST(POWER(10, COALESCE(w.minor_unit_exponent, 2)) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
            ), 0)
          ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
          6
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
      ) * w.rate_to_usd,
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS order_total_usd,
    CAST(w.line_count AS INT) AS line_count,
    CAST(w.units AS INT) AS units,
    CAST(w.lines_total_minor AS INT) AS lines_total_minor,
    CAST((
      w.lines_total_minor = w.order_total_minor
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS lines_match_total,
    CAST(w.customer_id AS STRING) AS customer_id,
    CAST((
      NOT w.customer_id IS NULL
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_known_customer,
    CAST(COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY w.partner_code
      ORDER BY w.placed_at_utc NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS INT) AS order_rank_for_partner
  FROM with_rate AS w
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH shifts AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_agent_shifts
), agents AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_agents
), calls AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_call_records
), first_responses AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_ticket_first_response
), shifts_utc AS (
  SELECT
    s.shift_id,
    s.agent_id,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(s.iana_timezone, 'UTC', s.shift_start_local) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS shift_start_utc,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE(s.iana_timezone, 'UTC', s.shift_end_local) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS shift_end_utc,
    s.scheduled_minutes - s.break_minutes AS productive_minutes,
    (
      CAST(s.shift_end_local AS DATE) > CAST(s.shift_start_local AS DATE)
    ) AS is_overnight
  FROM shifts AS s
), calls_in_shift AS (
  SELECT
    su.shift_id,
    COUNT(c.call_id) AS calls_handled,
    SUM(c.duration_seconds) / 60 AS call_minutes
  FROM shifts_utc AS su
  INNER JOIN calls AS c
    ON su.agent_id = c.agent_id
  WHERE
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', c.started_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) BETWEEN su.shift_start_utc AND su.shift_end_utc
  GROUP BY
    su.shift_id
), responses_in_shift AS (
  SELECT
    su.shift_id,
    COUNT(f.ticket_id) AS tickets_first_responded
  FROM shifts_utc AS su
  INNER JOIN first_responses AS f
    ON su.agent_id = f.first_responder_id
    AND f.first_response_at_utc >= su.shift_start_utc
    AND f.first_response_at_utc < su.shift_end_utc
  GROUP BY
    su.shift_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    su.shift_id,
    su.agent_id,
    a.team_code,
    su.shift_start_utc,
    su.shift_end_utc,
    CAST(su.productive_minutes AS INT) AS productive_minutes,
    CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(c.call_minutes, 0), 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS call_minutes,
    CAST(COALESCE(c.calls_handled, 0) AS INT) AS calls_handled,
    CAST(COALESCE(r.tickets_first_responded, 0) AS INT) AS tickets_first_responded,
    CAST(ROUND(
      (
        COALESCE(c.call_minutes, 0) + 6 * COALESCE(r.tickets_first_responded, 0)
      ) / NULLIF(su.productive_minutes, 0),
      4
    ) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS utilisation,
    su.is_overnight
  FROM shifts_utc AS su
  LEFT JOIN agents AS a
    ON su.agent_id = a.agent_id
  LEFT JOIN calls_in_shift AS c
    ON su.shift_id = c.shift_id
  LEFT JOIN responses_in_shift AS r

WITH calls AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_call_records
), call_paths AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__support__call_records
), latest_paths AS (
  SELECT
    p.call_id,
    p.ivr_path
  FROM call_paths AS p
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.call_id ORDER BY p._seq DESC NULLS FIRST) = 1
), steps AS (
  SELECT
    l.call_id,
    s.pos AS step_index,
    LOWER(CAST(s.value AS STRING)) AS menu_node
  FROM latest_paths AS l, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(CAST(l.ivr_path AS VARIANT)) AS s
), step_summary AS (
  SELECT
    s.call_id,
    MIN_BY(s.menu_node, s.step_index) AS first_menu_choice,
    MAX_BY(s.menu_node, s.step_index) AS final_menu_node,
    COUNT(*) AS menu_steps,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT s.menu_node) AS repeated_menu_visits
  FROM steps AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.call_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    c.call_id,
    c.ticket_id,
    c.agent_id,
    CAST(s.first_menu_choice AS STRING) AS first_menu_choice,
    CAST(s.final_menu_node AS STRING) AS final_menu_node,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.menu_steps, 0) AS INT) AS menu_steps,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.repeated_menu_visits, 0) AS INT) AS repeated_menu_visits,
    (
      c.agent_id IS NULL
      AND NOT COALESCE(s.final_menu_node, '') IN ('self_service_complete', 'callback_booked')
    ) AS abandoned_in_ivr,
    CAST(CASE c.caller_country_prefix
      WHEN '1'
      THEN 'US'
      WHEN '81'
      THEN 'APAC'
      WHEN '61'
      THEN 'APAC'
      WHEN '965'
      THEN 'MENA'
      ELSE 'EU'
    END AS STRING) AS caller_region,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN c.duration_seconds < 60
      THEN 'under_1m'
      WHEN c.duration_seconds < 300
      THEN '1_to_5m'
      WHEN c.duration_seconds < 900
      THEN '5_to_15m'
      ELSE 'over_15m'
    END AS STRING) AS duration_bucket
  FROM calls AS c
  LEFT JOIN step_summary AS s
    ON c.call_id = s.call_id

WITH messages AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_chat_messages
), chats AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_chat_transcripts
), with_previous AS (
  SELECT
    m.chat_id,
    m.message_index,
    m.sender_role,
    m.sent_at,
    LOWER(m.message_text_masked) AS message_text,
    LAG(m.sender_role) OVER (PARTITION BY m.chat_id ORDER BY m.message_index NULLS LAST) AS previous_role,
    LAG(m.sent_at) OVER (PARTITION BY m.chat_id ORDER BY m.message_index NULLS LAST) AS previous_sent_at
  FROM messages AS m
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    w.chat_id,
    w.message_index,
    w.sender_role,
    w.message_text,
    IF(
      w.sender_role = 'customer',
      REGEXP_COUNT(w.message_text, '(thanks|thank you|great|perfect|helpful|appreciate|sorted)') - REGEXP_COUNT(
        w.message_text,
        '(angry|terrible|worst|refund|cancel|broken|never again|ridiculous)'
      ),
      0
    ) AS message_sentiment,
    IF(
      w.sender_role = 'agent' AND w.previous_role = 'customer',
      DATEDIFF(SECOND, DATE_TRUNC('SECOND', w.previous_sent_at), DATE_TRUNC('SECOND', w.sent_at)),
      NULL
    ) AS agent_reply_seconds
  FROM with_previous AS w
), per_chat AS (
  SELECT
    s.chat_id,
    COUNT_IF(s.sender_role = 'customer') AS customer_message_count,
    COUNT_IF(s.sender_role = 'agent') AS agent_message_count,
    SUM(s.message_sentiment) AS sentiment_score,
    MEDIAN(s.agent_reply_seconds) AS median_agent_reply_seconds,
    REGEXP_LIKE(MAX_BY(s.message_text, s.message_index), '.*(thanks|thank you|cheers).*') AS ends_with_thanks
  FROM scored AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.chat_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    c.chat_id,
    c.ticket_id,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.customer_message_count, 0) AS INT) AS customer_message_count,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.agent_message_count, 0) AS INT) AS agent_message_count,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.sentiment_score, 0) AS INT) AS sentiment_score,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(p.sentiment_score, 0) < 0
      THEN 'negative'
      WHEN COALESCE(p.sentiment_score, 0) > 0
      THEN 'positive'
      ELSE 'neutral'
    END AS STRING) AS sentiment_label,
    CAST(p.median_agent_reply_seconds AS INT) AS median_agent_reply_seconds,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.ends_with_thanks, FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS ends_with_thanks,
    CAST(ROUND(
      DATEDIFF(SECOND, DATE_TRUNC('SECOND', c.started_at), DATE_TRUNC('SECOND', c.ended_at)) / 60,
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS chat_minutes
  FROM chats AS c
  LEFT JOIN per_chat AS p
    ON c.chat_id = p.chat_id
)

WITH tickets AS (

), identities AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_customer_identity
), csat AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_csat_responses
), latest_csat AS (
  SELECT
    c.ticket_id,
    c.score
  FROM csat AS c
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.ticket_id
      ORDER BY c.responded_at DESC NULLS FIRST, c.response_id DESC NULLS FIRST
    ) = 1
), email_owners AS (
  SELECT
    i.email_normalised,
    MIN(i.customer_id) AS customer_id
  FROM identities AS i
  WHERE
    NOT i.email_normalised IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    i.email_normalised
), linked AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    i.customer_id,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', t.created_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS created_at_utc,
    t.contact_reason,
    lc.score AS csat_score
  FROM tickets AS t
  LEFT JOIN email_owners AS i
    ON t.customer_email = i.email_normalised
  LEFT JOIN latest_csat AS lc
    ON t.ticket_id = lc.ticket_id
), sequenced AS (
  SELECT
    l.ticket_id,
    l.customer_id,
    l.created_at_utc,
    l.contact_reason,
    l.csat_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.customer_id
      ORDER BY l.created_at_utc NULLS LAST, l.ticket_id NULLS LAST
    ) AS ticket_number_for_customer,
    LAG(l.created_at_utc) OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.customer_id
      ORDER BY l.created_at_utc NULLS LAST, l.ticket_id NULLS LAST
    ) AS previous_created_at_utc,
    AVG(l.csat_score) OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.customer_id
      ORDER BY l.created_at_utc NULLS LAST, l.ticket_id NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS rolling_csat_avg
  FROM linked AS l
), final AS (
  SELECT
    s.ticket_id,
    s.customer_id,
    CAST(IF(s.customer_id IS NULL, NULL, s.ticket_number_for_customer) AS INT) AS ticket_number_for_customer,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(s.created_at_utc, s.previous_created_at_utc) AS INT) AS days_since_previous_ticket,
    s.csat_score,
    CAST(ROUND(s.rolling_csat_avg, 3) AS DECIMAL(6, 3)) AS rolling_csat_avg,
    COALESCE(
      DATEDIFF(
        HOUR,
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', s.previous_created_at_utc),
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', s.created_at_utc)
      ) <= 168,
      FALSE
    ) AS is_repeat_contact_7d,
    s.contact_reason
  FROM sequenced AS s
)

WITH first_responses AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_ticket_first_response
), holidays AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__holiday_calendar
), spine_offsets AS (
  SELECT
    SEQUENCE(0, 729) AS day_offsets
), date_spine AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATEADD(DAY, CAST(d.value AS INT), CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS calendar_date
  FROM spine_offsets AS o, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(CAST(o.day_offsets AS VARIANT)) AS d
), local_times AS (
  SELECT
    f.ticket_id,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', 'Europe/Berlin', f.created_at_utc) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS created_local,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', 'Europe/Berlin', f.first_response_at_utc) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS response_local
  FROM first_responses AS f
), local_dates AS (
  SELECT
    l.ticket_id,
    l.created_local,
    l.response_local,
    CAST(l.created_local AS DATE) AS created_date,
    CAST(l.response_local AS DATE) AS response_date
  FROM local_times AS l
  WHERE
    NOT l.response_local IS NULL
), eu_holidays AS (
  SELECT
    h.holiday_date
  FROM holidays AS h
  WHERE
    h.region_code = 'EU'
), working_days AS (
  SELECT
    d.calendar_date
  FROM date_spine AS d
  LEFT JOIN eu_holidays AS h
    ON d.calendar_date = h.holiday_date
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK_ISO FROM d.calendar_date) <= 5 AND h.holiday_date IS NULL
), day_windows AS (
  SELECT
    ld.ticket_id,
    GREATEST(
      ld.created_local,
      MAKE_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(YEAR(w.calendar_date), MONTH(w.calendar_date), DAY(w.calendar_date), 8, 0, 0)
    ) AS window_start,
    LEAST(
      ld.response_local,
      MAKE_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(YEAR(w.calendar_date), MONTH(w.calendar_date), DAY(w.calendar_date), 20, 0, 0)
    ) AS window_end
  FROM local_dates AS ld
  INNER JOIN working_days AS w
    ON w.calendar_date >= ld.created_date AND w.calendar_date <= ld.response_date
), business_minutes AS (
  SELECT
    dw.ticket_id,
    SUM(
      GREATEST(
        DATEDIFF(MINUTE, DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', dw.window_start), DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', dw.window_end)),
        0
      )
    ) AS business_minutes_to_response
  FROM day_windows AS dw
  GROUP BY
    dw.ticket_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    l.ticket_id,
    l.created_local AS created_at_support_local,
    l.response_local AS first_response_at_support_local,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(
      MINUTE,
      DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', l.created_local),
      DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', l.response_local)
    ) AS INT) AS calendar_minutes_to_response,
    CAST(COALESCE(b.business_minutes_to_response, 0) AS INT) AS business_minutes_to_response,
    (
      NOT HOUR(l.created_local) BETWEEN 8 AND 20 - 1
      OR EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK_ISO FROM l.created_local) > 5
    ) AS created_outside_hours
  FROM local_times AS l
  LEFT JOIN business_minutes AS b
    ON l.ticket_id = b.ticket_id
)

WITH tickets AS (

    *
  FROM rel__stg_tickets
), comments AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_ticket_comments
), tickets_utc AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', CAST(t.created_at AS TIMESTAMP)) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS created_at_utc
  FROM tickets AS t
), comments_utc AS (
  SELECT
    c.ticket_id,
    c.author_type,
    c.author_id,
    c.is_public,
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', c.created_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS created_at_utc
  FROM comments AS c
), response_windows AS (
  SELECT
    c.ticket_id,
    c.author_type,
    c.author_id,
    c.created_at_utc,
    MIN(IF(c.author_type = 'agent' AND c.is_public, c.created_at_utc, NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.ticket_id) AS first_response_at_utc
  FROM comments_utc AS c
), first_responses AS (
  SELECT
    r.ticket_id,
    MIN(r.first_response_at_utc) AS first_response_at_utc,
    MIN_BY(
      IF(r.author_type = 'agent', r.author_id, NULL),
      IF(r.author_type = 'agent', r.created_at_utc, NULL)
    ) AS first_responder_id,
    MIN(
      IF(
        r.author_type = 'customer' AND r.created_at_utc > r.first_response_at_utc,
        r.created_at_utc,
        NULL
      )
    ) AS first_customer_reply_at_utc,
    COUNT_IF(r.author_type = 'system') > 0 AS has_auto_reply
  FROM response_windows AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.ticket_id
), agent_burst AS (
  SELECT
    r.ticket_id,
    COUNT(*) AS agent_responses_before_customer_reply
  FROM response_windows AS r
  INNER JOIN first_responses AS f
    ON r.ticket_id = f.ticket_id
  WHERE
    r.author_type = 'agent'
    AND r.created_at_utc < COALESCE(f.first_customer_reply_at_utc, CAST('9999-12-31' AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ))
  GROUP BY
    r.ticket_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    t.created_at_utc,
    f.first_response_at_utc,
    CAST(f.first_responder_id AS STRING) AS first_responder_id,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(
      MINUTE,
      DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', t.created_at_utc),
      DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', f.first_response_at_utc)
    ) AS INT) AS minutes_to_first_response,
    f.first_customer_reply_at_utc,
    CAST(COALESCE(a.agent_responses_before_customer_reply, 0) AS INT) AS agent_responses_before_customer_reply,
    CAST(COALESCE(f.has_auto_reply, FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS has_auto_reply
  FROM tickets_utc AS t
  LEFT JOIN first_responses AS f
    ON t.ticket_id = f.ticket_id
  LEFT JOIN agent_burst AS a
    ON t.ticket_id = a.ticket_id
)

WITH tickets AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_tickets
), policies AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_sla_policies
), first_responses AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_ticket_first_response
), business_hours AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_ticket_business_hours
), matched AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    t.priority,
    t.channel,
    t.solved_at,
    p.policy_id,
    p.first_response_minutes,
    p.resolution_minutes,
    p.business_hours_only
  FROM tickets AS t
  LEFT JOIN policies AS p
    ON t.priority = p.priority AND t.channel = p.channel
), measured AS (
  SELECT
    m.ticket_id,
    m.priority,
    m.channel,
    m.policy_id,
    m.first_response_minutes,
    m.resolution_minutes,
    IF(m.business_hours_only, bh.business_minutes_to_response, fr.minutes_to_first_response) AS first_response_minutes_used,
    DATEDIFF(
      MINUTE,
      DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', fr.created_at_utc),
      DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', m.solved_at) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ))
    ) AS resolution_minutes_used,
    IF(
      m.solved_at IS NULL,
      DATEDIFF(
        MINUTE,
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', fr.created_at_utc),
        DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ))
      ),
      NULL
    ) AS open_minutes_now
  FROM matched AS m
  INNER JOIN first_responses AS fr
    ON m.ticket_id = fr.ticket_id
  LEFT JOIN business_hours AS bh
    ON m.ticket_id = bh.ticket_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    x.ticket_id,
    x.priority,
    x.channel,
    x.policy_id,
    CAST(x.first_response_minutes AS INT) AS first_response_target_minutes,
    CAST(x.first_response_minutes_used AS INT) AS first_response_minutes_used,
    COALESCE(x.first_response_minutes_used > x.first_response_minutes, FALSE) AS is_first_response_breached,
    CAST(x.resolution_minutes AS INT) AS resolution_target_minutes,
    CAST(x.resolution_minutes_used AS INT) AS resolution_minutes_used,
    COALESCE(x.resolution_minutes_used > x.resolution_minutes, FALSE) AS is_resolution_breached,
    CAST((
      IF(COALESCE(x.first_response_minutes_used > x.first_response_minutes, FALSE), 1, 0) + IF(COALESCE(x.resolution_minutes_used > x.resolution_minutes, FALSE), 1, 0)
    ) AS INT) AS breach_count,
    CAST(x.open_minutes_now AS INT) AS open_minutes_now
  FROM measured AS x
)

WITH comments AS (
  SELECT
    *

), tickets AS (

    *

), ordered_comments AS (
  SELECT
    c.ticket_id,

    c.author_id,
    c.is_public,
    c.created_at,
    c.attachment_count,
    c.contains_order_reference,
    LAG(c.author_type) OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.ticket_id
      ORDER BY c.created_at NULLS LAST, c.comment_id NULLS LAST
    ) AS previous_author_type
  FROM comments AS c
), thread_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.ticket_id,
    COUNT(*) AS comment_count,
    COUNT_IF(o.is_public) AS public_comment_count,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(IF(o.author_type = 'agent', o.author_id, NULL))) AS agent_participants,
    TRANSFORM(
      ARRAY_SORT(
        COLLECT_LIST(NAMED_STRUCT('k0', o.created_at, 'k1', o.comment_id, 'v', o.author_type)) FILTER(WHERE
          NOT o.author_type IS NULL)
      ),
      s -> s.v
    ) AS author_sequence,
    COUNT_IF(NOT o.previous_author_type IS NULL AND o.previous_author_type <> o.author_type) AS handoff_count,
    SUM(o.attachment_count) AS total_attachments,
    MAX(o.created_at) AS last_comment_at,
    MAX_BY(o.author_type, o.created_at) AS last_author_type,
    BOOL_OR(o.contains_order_reference) AS mentions_order,
    COUNT_IF(o.author_type = 'agent') AS agent_comments,
    COUNT_IF(o.author_type = 'customer') AS customer_comments,
    COUNT_IF(o.author_type = 'system') AS system_comments
  FROM ordered_comments AS o
  GROUP BY
    o.ticket_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.comment_count, 0) AS INT) AS comment_count,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.public_comment_count, 0) AS INT) AS public_comment_count,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.agent_participants, ARRAY()) AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS agent_participants,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.author_sequence, ARRAY()) AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS author_sequence,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.handoff_count, 0) AS INT) AS handoff_count,
    TO_VARIANT_OBJECT(
      NAMED_STRUCT(
        'agent',
        s.agent_comments,
        'customer',
        s.customer_comments,
        'system',
        NULLIF(s.system_comments, 0)
      )
    ) AS author_breakdown,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.total_attachments, 0) AS INT) AS total_attachments,
    s.last_comment_at,
    CAST(s.last_author_type AS STRING) AS last_author_type,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.mentions_order, FALSE) AS BOOLEAN) AS mentions_order
  FROM tickets AS t
  LEFT JOIN thread_stats AS s
    ON t.ticket_id = s.ticket_id
)

WITH exposures AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_experiment_exposures
), variants AS (
  SELECT
    e.experiment_key,
    e.variant_key,
    BOOL_OR(e.is_control) AS is_control,
    COUNT(*) AS exposed,
    COUNT_IF(e.converted) AS converted,
    MEDIAN(e.days_to_convert) AS median_days_to_convert
  FROM exposures AS e
  GROUP BY
    e.experiment_key,
    e.variant_key
), controls AS (
  SELECT
    v.experiment_key,
    SUM(v.exposed) AS control_exposed,
    SUM(v.converted) AS control_converted
  FROM variants AS v
  WHERE
    v.is_control
  GROUP BY
    v.experiment_key
), compared AS (
  SELECT
    v.experiment_key,
    v.variant_key,
    v.is_control,
    v.exposed,
    v.converted,
    v.median_days_to_convert,
    v.converted / NULLIF(v.exposed, 0) AS rate,
    c.control_converted / NULLIF(c.control_exposed, 0) AS control_rate,
    (
      v.converted + c.control_converted
    ) / NULLIF(v.exposed + c.control_exposed, 0) AS pooled_rate,
    c.control_exposed
  FROM variants AS v
  LEFT JOIN controls AS c
    ON v.experiment_key = c.experiment_key
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      c.experiment_key || ':' || c.variant_key
    ) AS STRING) AS experiment_variant_key,
    c.experiment_key,
    c.variant_key,
    CAST(c.is_control AS BOOLEAN) AS is_control,
    CAST(c.exposed AS INT) AS exposed,
    CAST(c.converted AS INT) AS converted,
    CAST(ROUND(c.rate, 6) AS DECIMAL(9, 6)) AS conversion_rate,
    CAST(ROUND(c.rate - c.control_rate, 6) AS DECIMAL(9, 6)) AS lift_vs_control,
    CAST(ROUND(
      (
        c.rate - c.control_rate
      ) / NULLIF(
        SQRT(
          c.pooled_rate * (
            1 - c.pooled_rate
          ) * (
            1 / NULLIF(c.exposed, 0) + 1 / NULLIF(c.control_exposed, 0)
          )
        ),
        0
      ),
      4
    ) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS z_score,
    CAST(ROUND(c.median_days_to_convert, 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS median_days_to_convert
  FROM compared AS c
)

      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', s.placed_date_local))
    ) AS months_since_first_order,
    s.amount_usd
  FROM order_sequence AS s
), cohort_sizes AS (
  SELECT
    a.cohort_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS cohort_size
  FROM activity AS a
  GROUP BY
    a.cohort_month
), cells AS (
  SELECT
    a.cohort_month,
    a.months_since_first_order,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS active_customers,
    SUM(a.amount_usd) AS revenue_usd
  FROM activity AS a
  GROUP BY
    a.cohort_month,
    a.months_since_first_order
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      DATE_FORMAT(c.cohort_month, 'yyyy-MM') || '+' || CAST(c.months_since_first_order AS STRING)
    ) AS STRING) AS cohort_cell_key,
    c.cohort_month,
    CAST(c.months_since_first_order AS INT) AS months_since_first_order,
    CAST(z.cohort_size AS INT) AS cohort_size,
    CAST(c.active_customers AS INT) AS active_customers,
    CAST(ROUND(c.active_customers / NULLIF(z.cohort_size, 0), 4) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS retention_rate,
    CAST(c.revenue_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS revenue_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(
      SUM(c.revenue_usd) OVER (
        PARTITION BY c.cohort_month
        ORDER BY c.months_since_first_order NULLS LAST
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) / NULLIF(z.cohort_size, 0),
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS cumulative_revenue_per_customer_usd
  FROM cells AS c
  INNER JOIN cohort_sizes AS z
    ON c.cohort_month = z.cohort_month
)

WITH channels AS (
  SELECT
    v.channel
  FROM VALUES
    ('web'),
    ('app'),
    ('partner'),
    ('phone') AS v(channel)
), lines AS (
  SELECT
    e.entry_id,
    e.channel,
    e.quantity,
    e.reason_code
  FROM rel__stg_edge_ledger_entries AS e
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(c.channel AS STRING) AS channel,
    CAST(COUNT(l.entry_id) AS INT) AS lines,
    CAST(COUNT(l.reason_code) AS INT) AS reasons,
    CAST(COUNT_IF(l.reason_code = 'REFUND') AS INT) AS refunded_lines,
    CAST(BOOL_OR(l.reason_code = 'REFUND') AS BOOLEAN) AS any_refund,
    CAST(SUM(l.quantity) AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS total_quantity,
    CAST(MAX(l.reason_code) AS STRING) AS max_reason,
    CAST(LISTAGG(l.reason_code, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY
      l.entry_id NULLS LAST) AS STRING) AS reason_list,
    CAST(TRANSFORM(
      ARRAY_SORT(
        COLLECT_LIST(NAMED_STRUCT('k0', l.entry_id, 'v', l.reason_code)) FILTER(WHERE
          NOT l.reason_code IS NULL)
      ),
      s -> s.v
    ) AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS reason_array,
    TO_VARIANT_OBJECT(
      MAP_FROM_ENTRIES(
        COLLECT_LIST(STRUCT(l.entry_id, CAST(l.reason_code AS VARIANT))) FILTER(WHERE
          NOT l.entry_id IS NULL AND NOT CAST(l.reason_code AS VARIANT) IS NULL)
      )
    ) AS reasons_by_entry
  FROM channels AS c
  LEFT JOIN lines AS l
    ON c.channel = l.channel
  GROUP BY
    c.channel
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH callback_times AS (

), final AS (

    CAST(COUNT(*) AS INT) AS callbacks,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT c.event_at) AS INT) AS distinct_instants,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(c.event_at, 'XXX')) AS INT) AS distinct_offsets,
    MIN(t.event_at_utc) AS first_event_utc
  FROM callback_times AS t
  INNER JOIN callbacks AS c
    ON t.callback_id = c.callback_id
  WHERE
    NOT t.event_local_date IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    t.event_local_date
)

WITH lines AS (

), allocated AS (
  SELECT
    l.sku,
    l.warehouse_code,
    SUM(l.quantity) AS allocated_units
  FROM lines AS l
  WHERE
    UPPER(l.status) = 'ALLOCATED'
  GROUP BY
    l.sku,
    l.warehouse_code
), counted AS (
  SELECT
    l.sku,
    l.warehouse_code,
    SUM(l.quantity) AS counted_units
  FROM lines AS l
  WHERE
    UPPER(l.status) = 'COUNTED'
  GROUP BY
    l.sku,
    l.warehouse_code
), final AS (
  SELECT
    sku,
    warehouse_code,
    CAST(a.allocated_units AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS allocated_units,
    CAST(c.counted_units AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS counted_units,
    CAST((
      COALESCE(c.counted_units, 0) - COALESCE(a.allocated_units, 0)
    ) AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS variance_units
  FROM allocated AS a
  FULL OUTER JOIN counted AS c
    USING (sku, warehouse_code)
)

WITH orders AS (

), warehouses AS (

), campaign_spend AS (
  SELECT
    *

), inventory AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__fct_inventory_daily
), recognition AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_revenue_recognition_daily
), partner_orders AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__fct_partner_orders
), chargebacks AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_chargeback_exposure
), calendar AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__dim_date
), reporting_window AS (
  SELECT
    c.calendar_date
  FROM calendar AS c
  WHERE
    c.calendar_date <= CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE)
    AND c.calendar_date > DATEADD(DAY, -120, CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE))
), completed_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.placed_date_local AS kpi_date,
    COALESCE(o.region_code, 'GLOBAL') AS region_code,
    o.amount_usd,
    o.is_first_order
  FROM orders AS o
  WHERE
    NOT o.order_status IN ('CANCELLED', 'PENDING')
), order_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    c.kpi_date,
    c.region_code,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    SUM(c.amount_usd) AS revenue_usd,
    AVG(c.amount_usd) AS average_order_usd,
    COUNT_IF(c.is_first_order) AS new_customers
  FROM completed_orders AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.kpi_date,
    c.region_code
), order_regions AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    COALESCE(o.region_code, 'GLOBAL') AS region_code
  FROM orders AS o
), refund_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    r.refunded_date AS kpi_date,
    COALESCE(o.region_code, 'GLOBAL') AS region_code,
    SUM(r.amount_usd) AS refund_usd,
    COUNT(*) AS refund_count
  FROM refunds AS r
  LEFT JOIN order_regions AS o
    ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
), session_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(s.session_start_utc AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    COUNT(*) AS sessions,
    AVG(IF(s.converted, 1, 0)) AS conversion_rate,
    AVG(IF(s.is_bounce, 1, 0)) AS bounce_rate
  FROM web_sessions AS s
  GROUP BY
    1
), ticket_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.created_at_utc AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    COUNT(*) AS tickets,
    AVG(IF(t.is_first_response_breached, 1, 0)) AS first_response_breach_rate,
    AVG(t.csat_score) AS average_csat
  FROM tickets AS t
  WHERE
    NOT t.created_at_utc IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    1
), warehouse_regions AS (
  SELECT
    w.warehouse_code,
    COALESCE(w.region_code, 'GLOBAL') AS region_code
  FROM warehouses AS w
), shipment_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', s.shipped_at) AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    COALESCE(w.region_code, 'GLOBAL') AS region_code,
    COUNT(*) AS shipments,
    AVG(IF(s.is_dispatch_on_time, 1, 0)) AS on_time_dispatch_rate,
    AVG(s.hours_to_deliver) AS average_hours_to_deliver
  FROM shipments AS s
  LEFT JOIN warehouse_regions AS w
    ON s.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  WHERE
    NOT s.shipped_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
), spend_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    s.spend_date AS kpi_date,
    SUM(s.spend_usd) AS spend_usd,
    SUM(s.clicks) AS paid_clicks
  FROM campaign_spend AS s
  GROUP BY
    1
), stock_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    i.calendar_date AS kpi_date,
    COALESCE(w.region_code, 'GLOBAL') AS region_code,
    COUNT_IF(i.is_stocked_out) AS stocked_out_sku_days,
    SUM(i.stock_value_usd) AS stock_value_usd
  FROM inventory AS i
  LEFT JOIN warehouse_regions AS w
    ON i.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
), subscription_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    r.recognition_date AS kpi_date,
    r.region_code,
    SUM(r.revenue_usd) AS subscription_revenue_usd
  FROM recognition AS r
  WHERE
    r.revenue_stream = 'subscription'
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
), partner_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    p.placed_date AS kpi_date,
    COUNT(*) AS partner_orders,
    SUM(p.order_total_usd) AS partner_revenue_usd
  FROM partner_orders AS p
  GROUP BY
    1
), chargeback_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', c.opened_at) AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    COUNT(*) AS chargebacks_opened,
    SUM(c.amount_usd) AS chargeback_usd
  FROM chargebacks AS c
  GROUP BY
    1
), all_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST(m.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('orders' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(m.order_count AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM order_metrics AS m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(m.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST(m.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('revenue_usd' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(m.revenue_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM order_metrics AS m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(m.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST(m.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('average_order_usd' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(m.average_order_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM order_metrics AS m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(m.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST(m.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('new_customers' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(m.new_customers AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM order_metrics AS m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(r.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST(r.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('refund_usd' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(r.refund_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM refund_metrics AS r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(r.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST(r.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('refunds' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(r.refund_count AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM refund_metrics AS r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(s.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST('GLOBAL' AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('web_sessions' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(s.sessions AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM session_metrics AS s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(s.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,

  SELECT
    CAST(s.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST('GLOBAL' AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('web_bounce_rate' AS STRING) AS metric_name,

  SELECT

    CAST('GLOBAL' AS STRING) AS region_code,

    CAST(t.tickets AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM ticket_metrics AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(t.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST('GLOBAL' AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('first_response_breach_rate' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(t.first_response_breach_rate AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM ticket_metrics AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(t.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST('GLOBAL' AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('average_csat' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(t.average_csat AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM ticket_metrics AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(s.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST(s.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('shipments' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(s.shipments AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM shipment_metrics AS s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(s.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST(s.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('on_time_dispatch_rate' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(s.on_time_dispatch_rate AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM shipment_metrics AS s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(s.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST(s.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('average_hours_to_deliver' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(s.average_hours_to_deliver AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM shipment_metrics AS s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(p.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST('GLOBAL' AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('marketing_spend_usd' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(p.spend_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM spend_metrics AS p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(p.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST('GLOBAL' AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('paid_clicks' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(p.paid_clicks AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM spend_metrics AS p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(k.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST(k.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('stocked_out_sku_days' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(k.stocked_out_sku_days AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM stock_metrics AS k
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(k.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST(k.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('stock_value_usd' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(k.stock_value_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM stock_metrics AS k
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(b.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST(b.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('subscription_revenue_usd' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(b.subscription_revenue_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM subscription_metrics AS b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(p.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST('GLOBAL' AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('partner_orders' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(p.partner_orders AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM partner_metrics AS p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(p.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST('GLOBAL' AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('partner_revenue_usd' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(p.partner_revenue_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM partner_metrics AS p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(c.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST('GLOBAL' AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('chargebacks_opened' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(c.chargebacks_opened AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM chargeback_metrics AS c
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(c.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST('GLOBAL' AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST('chargeback_usd' AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(c.chargeback_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value
  FROM chargeback_metrics AS c
), metric_catalogue AS (
  SELECT
    v.metric_name,
    v.business_area,
    v.metric_label,
    v.unit,
    v.higher_is_better
  FROM VALUES
    ('orders', 'orders', 'Orders', 'count', TRUE),
    ('revenue_usd', 'orders', 'Revenue', 'usd', TRUE),
    ('average_order_usd', 'orders', 'Average order value', 'usd', TRUE),
    ('new_customers', 'customers', 'New customers', 'count', TRUE),
    ('refund_usd', 'orders', 'Refunded', 'usd', FALSE),
    ('refunds', 'orders', 'Refunds', 'count', FALSE),
    ('web_sessions', 'clickstream', 'Web sessions', 'count', TRUE),
    ('web_conversion_rate', 'clickstream', 'Web conversion rate', 'ratio', TRUE),
    ('web_bounce_rate', 'clickstream', 'Web bounce rate', 'ratio', FALSE),
    ('support_tickets', 'support', 'Support tickets', 'count', FALSE),
    (
      'first_response_breach_rate',
      'support',
      'First response SLA breaches',
      'ratio',
      FALSE
    ),
    ('average_csat', 'support', 'Average CSAT', 'score', TRUE),
    ('shipments', 'fulfilment', 'Shipments dispatched', 'count', TRUE),
    ('on_time_dispatch_rate', 'fulfilment', 'On-time dispatch', 'ratio', TRUE),
    ('average_hours_to_deliver', 'fulfilment', 'Hours to deliver', 'hours', FALSE),
    ('marketing_spend_usd', 'growth', 'Marketing spend', 'usd', FALSE),
    ('paid_clicks', 'growth', 'Paid clicks', 'count', TRUE),
    ('stocked_out_sku_days', 'inventory', 'Stocked-out SKU days', 'count', FALSE),
    ('stock_value_usd', 'inventory', 'Stock value', 'usd', FALSE),
    ('subscription_revenue_usd', 'finance', 'Subscription revenue', 'usd', TRUE),
    ('partner_orders', 'partners', 'Partner orders', 'count', TRUE),
    ('partner_revenue_usd', 'partners', 'Partner revenue', 'usd', TRUE),
    ('chargebacks_opened', 'finance', 'Chargebacks opened', 'count', FALSE),
    ('chargeback_usd', 'finance', 'Chargeback amount', 'usd', FALSE) AS v(metric_name, business_area, metric_label, unit, higher_is_better)
), metric_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    a.region_code,
    a.metric_name
  FROM all_metrics AS a
), dense_grid AS (
  SELECT
    w.calendar_date AS kpi_date,
    r.region_code,
    r.metric_name
  FROM reporting_window AS w
  CROSS JOIN metric_regions AS r
), filled AS (
  SELECT
    g.kpi_date,
    g.region_code,
    g.metric_name,
    COALESCE(a.metric_value, 0) AS metric_value
  FROM dense_grid AS g
  LEFT JOIN all_metrics AS a
    ON g.kpi_date = a.kpi_date
    AND g.region_code = a.region_code
    AND g.metric_name = a.metric_name
), compared AS (
  SELECT
    f.kpi_date,
    f.region_code,
    f.metric_name,
    f.metric_value,
    SUM(f.metric_value) OVER (
      PARTITION BY f.region_code, f.metric_name
      ORDER BY f.kpi_date NULLS LAST
      RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '7' DAYS PRECEDING AND INTERVAL '7' DAYS PRECEDING
    ) AS value_week_ago,
    AVG(f.metric_value) OVER (
      PARTITION BY f.region_code, f.metric_name
      ORDER BY f.kpi_date NULLS LAST
      RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '27' DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS trailing_28d_average
  FROM filled AS f
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      DATE_FORMAT(c.kpi_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') || ':' || c.region_code || ':' || c.metric_name
    ) AS STRING) AS kpi_key,
    CAST(c.kpi_date AS DATE) AS kpi_date,
    CAST(c.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST(m.business_area AS STRING) AS business_area,
    CAST(c.metric_name AS STRING) AS metric_name,
    CAST(m.metric_label AS STRING) AS metric_label,
    CAST(m.unit AS STRING) AS unit,
    CAST(m.higher_is_better AS BOOLEAN) AS higher_is_better,
    CAST(c.metric_value AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS metric_value,
    CAST(c.value_week_ago AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS value_week_ago,
    CAST(ROUND(100 * (
      c.metric_value / NULLIF(c.value_week_ago, 0) - 1
    ), 2) AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS week_over_week_pct,
    CAST(ROUND(c.trailing_28d_average, 4) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS trailing_28d_average,
    CAST(IF(
      m.higher_is_better,
      c.metric_value >= c.value_week_ago,
      c.metric_value <= c.value_week_ago
    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_favourable_change
  FROM compared AS c
  LEFT JOIN metric_catalogue AS m
    ON c.metric_name = m.metric_name
)
SELECT
  *
FROM final

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__rpt_daily_sales_by_region
), recognition AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__rpt_revenue_recognition_monthly
), monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', s.placed_date_local) AS DATE) AS scorecard_month,
    s.region_code,
    CAST(SUM(s.order_count) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS orders,
    CAST(SUM(s.revenue_usd) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS revenue_usd,
    CAST(SUM(s.first_order_count) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS first_orders,
    CAST((
      SUM(s.revenue_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(s.order_count), 0)
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS average_order_usd
  FROM sales AS s
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
), wide AS (
  SELECT
    m.scorecard_month,
    m.region_code,
    m.orders,
    m.revenue_usd,
    m.first_orders,
    m.average_order_usd,
    CAST(COALESCE(r.refund_ratio, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS refund_ratio,
    CAST(COALESCE(r.subscription_usd, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS subscription_usd
  FROM monthly_sales AS m
  LEFT JOIN recognition AS r
    ON m.scorecard_month = r.recognition_month AND m.region_code = r.region_code
), long_form AS (
  SELECT
    u.scorecard_month,
    u.region_code,
    u.measure,
    u.measure_value
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM wide
    UNPIVOT(measure_value FOR 
      measure IN (
        orders,
        revenue_usd,
        first_orders,
        average_order_usd,
        refund_ratio,
        subscription_usd
      )
    )
  ) AS u
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      DATE_FORMAT(l.scorecard_month, 'yyyy-MM') || ':' || l.region_code || ':' || LOWER(l.measure)
    ) AS STRING) AS scorecard_key,
    CAST(l.scorecard_month AS DATE) AS scorecard_month,
    CAST(l.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST(LOWER(l.measure) AS STRING) AS measure,
    CAST(l.measure_value AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS measure_value,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.scorecard_month, l.measure
      ORDER BY l.measure_value DESC NULLS FIRST
    ) AS INT) AS rank_among_regions
  FROM long_form AS l
)

WITH balances AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_ledger_balances_daily
), fx_rates AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
), month_ends AS (
  SELECT
    b.account_code,
    b.account_class,
    b.currency_code,
    b.calendar_date AS month_end,
    LAST_DAY(b.calendar_date) AS month_last_day,
    b.closing_balance,
    b.is_normal_side
  FROM balances AS b
  WHERE
    b.is_month_end OR b.calendar_date = CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE)
), month_flows AS (
  SELECT
    b.account_code,
    b.currency_code,
    LAST_DAY(b.calendar_date) AS month_last_day,
    SUM(b.debit_minor) AS month_debit_minor,
    SUM(b.credit_minor) AS month_credit_minor
  FROM balances AS b
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3
), with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    m.account_code,
    m.account_class,
    m.currency_code,
    m.month_end,
    m.month_last_day,
    m.closing_balance,
    m.is_normal_side,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM month_ends AS m
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM fx_rates AS fx
    WHERE
      m.currency_code = fx.currency_code AND m.month_end >= fx.rate_date
    ORDER BY
      fx.rate_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fx
), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      w.account_code || ':' || w.currency_code || ':' || DATE_FORMAT(w.month_end, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
    ) AS STRING) AS ledger_month_key,
    w.account_code,
    w.account_class,
    w.currency_code,
    w.month_end,
    CAST(COALESCE(f.month_debit_minor, 0) AS INT) AS month_debit_minor,
    CAST(COALESCE(f.month_credit_minor, 0) AS INT) AS month_credit_minor,
    w.closing_balance,
    CAST(ROUND(w.closing_balance * w.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS closing_balance_usd,
    w.is_normal_side
  FROM with_rate AS w
  LEFT JOIN month_flows AS f
    ON w.account_code = f.account_code
    AND w.currency_code = f.currency_code
    AND w.month_last_day = f.month_last_day
)

WITH recognition AS (
  SELECT
    *

), monthly AS (

    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', r.recognition_date) AS recognition_month,
    r.region_code,
    r.revenue_stream,
    r.revenue_usd
  FROM recognition AS r
), pivoted AS (

    *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *

    PIVOT(SUM(revenue_usd) FOR 
      revenue_stream IN (
        'product' AS `'product'`,
        'refund' AS `'refund'`,
        'subscription' AS `'subscription'`
      )
    )
  ) AS p(recognition_month, region_code, product_usd, refund_usd, subscription_usd)
), final AS (

    CAST((
      DATE_FORMAT(p.recognition_month, 'yyyy-MM') || ':' || p.region_code
    ) AS STRING) AS recognition_month_key,

    CAST(p.region_code AS STRING) AS region_code,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.product_usd, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS product_usd,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.refund_usd, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS refund_usd,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.subscription_usd, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS subscription_usd,
    CAST((
      COALESCE(p.product_usd, 0) + COALESCE(p.refund_usd, 0) + COALESCE(p.subscription_usd, 0)
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS net_revenue_usd,
    CAST(ROUND(-p.refund_usd / NULLIF(p.product_usd, 0), 4) AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) AS refund_ratio
  FROM pivoted AS p
)

    s.tracking_event_count

WITH exceptions AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM rel__int_delivery_exceptions_classified
), dated_codes AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', e.occurred_at)) AS DATE) AS exception_month,
    e.carrier_code,
    e.responsibility,
    e.exception_code
  FROM exceptions AS e
  WHERE
    NOT e.exception_code IS NULL
), code_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.exception_month,
    d.carrier_code,
    d.responsibility,
    d.exception_code,
    COUNT(*) AS code_exceptions
  FROM dated_codes AS d
  GROUP BY
    d.exception_month,
    d.carrier_code,
    d.responsibility,
    d.exception_code
), top_codes AS (
  SELECT
    cc.exception_month,
    cc.carrier_code,
    cc.responsibility,
    cc.exception_code
  FROM code_counts AS cc
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY cc.exception_month, cc.carrier_code, cc.responsibility
      ORDER BY cc.code_exceptions DESC NULLS FIRST, cc.exception_code NULLS LAST
    ) = 1
), counts AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((
      DATE_FORMAT(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', e.occurred_at)), 'yyyy-MM') || ':' || e.carrier_code || ':' || e.responsibility
    ) AS STRING) AS exception_month_key,
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', e.occurred_at)) AS DATE) AS exception_month,
    e.carrier_code,
    e.responsibility,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS INT) AS exceptions,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT e.shipment_id) AS INT) AS shipments_affected,
    CAST(ROUND(MEDIAN(e.hours_to_resolve), 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS median_hours_to_resolve,
    CAST(SUM(e.compensation_usd) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS compensation_usd
  FROM exceptions AS e
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', e.occurred_at)),
    e.carrier_code,
    e.responsibility
), final AS (
  SELECT
    c.exception_month_key,
    c.exception_month,
    c.carrier_code,
    c.responsibility,
    c.exceptions,
    c.shipments_affected,
    c.median_hours_to_resolve,
    c.compensation_usd,
    CAST(t.exception_code AS STRING) AS top_exception_code
  FROM counts AS c
  LEFT JOIN top_codes AS t
    ON c.exception_month = t.exception_month
    AND c.carrier_code = t.carrier_code
    AND c.responsibility = t.responsibility
)

WITH attempts AS (

    *

), with_exponent AS (
  SELECT
    a.payment_id,

    a.is_final_attempt,
    a.payment_method,
    a.authorised_at,

    a.decline_family,

    a.currency_code,
    a.amount_minor,
    c.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM attempts AS a
  INNER JOIN currencies AS c
    ON a.currency_code = c.currency_code
), with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    w.payment_id,
    w.order_id,
    w.attempt_number,
    w.is_final_attempt,
    w.payment_method,
    w.authorised_at,
    w.is_successful,
