    w.risk_band,
    w.card_scheme,
    w.had_chargeback,
    w.currency_code,
    w.amount_minor,
    w.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM with_exponent AS w
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM fx_rates AS fx
    WHERE
      w.currency_code = fx.currency_code AND w.authorised_date >= fx.rate_date
    ORDER BY
      fx.rate_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS fx
), final AS (
  SELECT
    r.payment_id,
    r.order_id,

    r.decline_family,
    r.risk_band,
    r.card_scheme,
    r.had_chargeback,
    r.currency_code,
    CAST(ROUND(
      CAST((
        (
          r.amount_minor
        ) / NULLIF((
          CAST(POWER(10, (
            r.minor_unit_exponent
          )) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
        ), 0)
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
      6
    ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS amount,
    CAST(ROUND(
      (
        CAST(ROUND(
          CAST((
            (
              r.amount_minor
            ) / NULLIF((
              CAST(POWER(10, (
                r.minor_unit_exponent
              )) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
            ), 0)
          ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
          6
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
      ) * r.rate_to_usd,
      2
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS amount_usd
  FROM with_rate AS r
)

), firsts AS (

), final AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(c.month_start AS DATE) AS month_start,
    CAST(c.closing_mrr_usd AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS closing_mrr_usd,
    CAST(LAG(c.closing_mrr_usd, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY c.month_start NULLS LAST) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS opening_mrr_usd,
    CAST(COALESCE(f.new_mrr_usd, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS new_mrr_usd,
    CAST(GREATEST(
      LAG(c.closing_mrr_usd, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY c.month_start NULLS LAST) + COALESCE(f.new_mrr_usd, 0) - c.closing_mrr_usd,
      0

    CAST((
      c.closing_mrr_usd - LAG(c.closing_mrr_usd, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY c.month_start NULLS LAST)
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS net_change_usd,
    CAST(c.active_subscribers AS INT) AS active_subscribers,

), ordered AS (

    e.customer_id,
    e.platform,
    e.event_name,
    e.screen_name,
    e.event_at_utc,
    CAST(e.attributes:screen_class AS STRING) AS screen_class,
    LEAD(e.event_at_utc) OVER (
      PARTITION BY e.device_id
      ORDER BY e.event_at_utc NULLS LAST, e.event_id NULLS LAST
    ) AS next_event_at_utc
  FROM app_events AS e
  WHERE
    NOT e.device_id IS NULL
), final AS (
  SELECT
    o.event_id,

    o.event_at_utc AS viewed_at_utc,
    CAST(LEAST(
      DATEDIFF(
        SECOND,

    ) AS BOOLEAN) AS mentions_order_rlike,
    REGEXP_LIKE(s.body, '(?is).*ds-o-\\d+.*') AS mentions_order_regexp_like,
    CAST(REGEXP_COUNT(s.body, 'DS-O-\\d+') AS INT) AS order_ref_count,
    CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.body, '(?i)refund(ed)?') AS STRING) AS refund_word,

), scans AS (
  SELECT

    CAST(e.value:code AS STRING) AS raw_code,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(CAST(e.value:ts AS STRING) AS TIMESTAMP),
      TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(e.value:ts AS STRING), 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm XX')
    ) AS event_at,
    CAST(e.value:location AS STRING) AS raw_location
  FROM shipments AS s, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(CAST(s.tracking_events AS VARIANT)) AS e
), scan_events AS (
  SELECT
    (
      s.shipment_id || ':' || CAST(s.event_sequence AS STRING)
    ) AS tracking_event_key,
    s.shipment_id,
    'scan' AS event_source,
    UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(s.raw_code, '[^A-Za-z_]', '')) AS event_code,
    s.event_at,
    INITCAP(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(s.raw_location, ',', 1))) AS location_text,
    UPPER(
      TRY_ELEMENT_AT(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(s.raw_location, ',\\s*([A-Za-z]{2})\\s*$', 1), 1)
    ) AS location_country_code,
    s.event_sequence
  FROM scans AS s

  SELECT
    (
      x.shipment_id || ':x:' || x.exception_id

    x.shipment_id,
    'exception' AS event_source,
    (
      'EXCEPTION_' || x.exception_code

    se.event_at,
    CAST(se.location_text AS STRING) AS location_text,
    CAST(se.location_country_code AS STRING) AS location_country_code,
    CAST(se.event_sequence AS INT) AS event_sequence
  FROM scan_events AS se
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST(ee.tracking_event_key AS STRING) AS tracking_event_key,
    ee.shipment_id,
    CAST(ee.event_source AS STRING) AS event_source,
    CAST(ee.event_code AS STRING) AS event_code,
    ee.event_at,
    CAST(ee.location_text AS STRING) AS location_text,

  FROM exception_events AS ee

), explicit_consents AS (
  SELECT

    c.customer_id,
    UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(c.consent_type, '[^A-Za-z]+', '_')) AS consent_type,
    COALESCE(c.granted, FALSE) AS is_granted,
    c.captured_at,
    COALESCE(CAST(c.source_context:surface AS STRING), 'unknown') AS capture_surface,
    TRY_ELEMENT_AT(
      REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(CAST(c.source_context:policy_url AS STRING), 'v([0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?)', 1),
      1
    ) AS policy_version,
    FALSE AS is_legacy
  FROM cdc_latest AS c
), legacy_profiles AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,
    p.created_at,
    p.profile
  FROM customers AS p
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p._seq DESC NULLS FIRST) = 1
    AND p._op <> 'D'
), legacy_consents AS (
  SELECT
    (
      'legacy:' || l.customer_id || ':' || UPPER(CAST(f.value AS STRING))

    TRUE AS is_granted,
    l.created_at AS captured_at,
    'profile' AS capture_surface,
    NULL AS policy_version,
    TRUE AS is_legacy
  FROM legacy_profiles AS l, LATERAL VARIANT_EXPLODE(l.profile:consents) AS f

  SELECT
    lc.consent_id,

    lc.consent_type,
    lc.is_granted,
    lc.captured_at,
    lc.capture_surface,
    lc.policy_version,
    lc.is_legacy
  FROM legacy_consents AS lc
  LEFT JOIN explicit_consents AS ec
    ON lc.customer_id = ec.customer_id AND lc.consent_type = ec.consent_type
  WHERE
    ec.consent_id IS NULL
), final AS (
  SELECT
    e.consent_id,

  FROM explicit_consents AS e

  SELECT
    CAST(l.consent_id AS STRING) AS consent_id,
    l.customer_id,
    CAST(l.consent_type AS STRING) AS consent_type,
    l.is_granted,
    l.captured_at,
    CAST(l.capture_surface AS STRING) AS capture_surface,
    CAST(l.policy_version AS STRING) AS policy_version,
    l.is_legacy

    """A basket tag as a display label; 'Untagged' for a missing tag.

  SELECT

    CAST('2026-04-03' AS DATE) AS holiday_date,
    'Good Friday' AS holiday_name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT

    'Synthetic holiday'
), __ref__dim_date AS (
  WITH holidays AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM __seed__holiday_calendar
  ), generated AS (
    SELECT
      DATEADD(DAY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id NULLS LAST) - 1, CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)) AS calendar_date
    FROM RANGE(1095)
  ), holiday_days AS (
    SELECT
      h.holiday_date,
      ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(h.region_code)) AS holiday_regions
    FROM holidays AS h
    GROUP BY
      h.holiday_date
  ), attributes AS (
    SELECT
      g.calendar_date,
      EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK_ISO FROM g.calendar_date) AS day_of_week_iso,
      DAYNAME(g.calendar_date) AS day_name,
      EXTRACT(YEAROFWEEK FROM g.calendar_date) AS iso_year,
      WEEKOFYEAR(g.calendar_date) AS iso_week,
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', g.calendar_date) AS month_start,
      LAST_DAY(g.calendar_date) AS month_end,
      YEAR(g.calendar_date) || '-Q' || QUARTER(g.calendar_date) AS quarter_label,
      YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, 12 - 4 + 1, g.calendar_date)) AS fiscal_year,
      CEIL(MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, 12 - 4 + 1, g.calendar_date)) / 3) AS fiscal_quarter
    FROM generated AS g
  ), final AS (
    SELECT
      CAST(a.calendar_date AS DATE) AS calendar_date,
      CAST(a.day_of_week_iso AS INT) AS day_of_week_iso,
      CAST(a.day_name AS STRING) AS day_name,
      CAST((
        a.day_of_week_iso >= 6
      ) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_weekend,
      CAST(a.iso_year AS INT) AS iso_year,
      CAST(a.iso_week AS INT) AS iso_week,
      CAST(a.month_start AS DATE) AS month_start,
      CAST(a.month_end AS DATE) AS month_end,
      CAST(a.quarter_label AS STRING) AS quarter_label,
      CAST(a.fiscal_year AS INT) AS fiscal_year,
      CAST(a.fiscal_quarter AS INT) AS fiscal_quarter,
      CAST(COALESCE(h.holiday_regions, ARRAY()) AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS holiday_regions,
      CAST((
        NOT h.holiday_date IS NULL
      ) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_holiday_somewhere,
      CAST((
        a.calendar_date <= CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE)
      ) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_on_or_before_valuation
    FROM attributes AS a
    LEFT JOIN holiday_days AS h
      ON a.calendar_date = h.holiday_date
  )
  SELECT
    *
  FROM final

  HAVING

            6

    FROM campaign_keys AS k
    INNER JOIN currencies AS cur
      ON k.currency_code = cur.currency_code
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (

  WITH lines AS (
    SELECT
      e.entry_id,
      e.order_ref,
      e.line_no,
      e.sku,
      e.quantity,
      e.unit_price_minor,
      e.customer_tier
    FROM __ref__stg_edge_ledger_entries AS e
    WHERE
      NOT e.order_ref IS NULL
  ), final AS (
    SELECT
      l.order_ref,
      CAST(COUNT(*) AS INT) AS line_count,
      CAST(LISTAGG(l.sku, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY
        l.line_no NULLS LAST,
        l.sku NULLS LAST,
        l.entry_id NULLS LAST) AS STRING) AS sku_list,
      CAST(TRANSFORM(
        ARRAY_SORT(
          COLLECT_LIST(NAMED_STRUCT('k0', l.line_no, 'k1', l.sku, 'k2', l.entry_id, 'v', l.sku)) FILTER(WHERE
            NOT l.sku IS NULL)
        ),
        s -> s.v
      ) AS ARRAY<VARIANT>) AS sku_array,
      CAST(MAX_BY(l.sku, l.unit_price_minor) AS STRING) AS priciest_sku,
      CAST(MIN_BY(l.sku, l.unit_price_minor) AS STRING) AS cheapest_sku,
      CAST(ANY_VALUE(l.customer_tier) AS STRING) AS customer_tier,
      CAST(MEDIAN(l.unit_price_minor) AS DECIMAL(38, 3)) AS median_unit_price,
      CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY
        l.unit_price_minor NULLS LAST) AS DECIMAL(38, 3)) AS percentile_unit_price,
      CAST(PERCENTILE_DISC(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY
        l.unit_price_minor NULLS LAST) AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS percentile_disc_unit_price,
      CAST(MODE(l.quantity) AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS modal_quantity
    FROM lines AS l
    GROUP BY
      l.order_ref

    *

    FROM transactions AS t

      t.gift_card_id
  ), balances AS (
    SELECT
      g.gift_card_id,
      g.currency_code,
      g.issued_at,
      g.expires_on,
      g.initial_amount_minor,
      COALESCE(m.redeemed_minor, 0) AS redeemed_minor,
      GREATEST(g.initial_amount_minor + COALESCE(m.net_movement_minor, 0), 0) AS balance_minor,
      COALESCE(m.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
      m.last_used_at,
      c.minor_unit_exponent,
      CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE) AS valuation_date
    FROM gift_cards AS g
    INNER JOIN currencies AS c
      ON g.currency_code = c.currency_code
    LEFT JOIN movement AS m
      ON g.gift_card_id = m.gift_card_id
  ), valued AS (
    SELECT
      b.gift_card_id,
      b.currency_code,
      b.issued_at,
      b.expires_on,
      b.initial_amount_minor,
      b.redeemed_minor,
      b.balance_minor,
      b.transaction_count,
      b.last_used_at,
      b.minor_unit_exponent,
      b.valuation_date,
      fx.rate_to_usd
    FROM balances AS b
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT
        *
      FROM fx_rates AS fx
      WHERE
        b.currency_code = fx.currency_code AND b.valuation_date >= fx.rate_date

            CAST(POWER(10, v.minor_unit_exponent) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
          ), 0)
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
        3
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS initial_amount,
      CAST(ROUND(
        CAST((
          v.redeemed_minor / NULLIF((
            CAST(POWER(10, v.minor_unit_exponent) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))
          ), 0)
        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
        3
      ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) AS redeemed_amount,
      CAST(ROUND(
        CAST((

        ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),

      CAST(ROUND(
        (

            CAST((
              v.balance_minor / NULLIF((

              ), 0)
            ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),
            6
          ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6))
        ) * v.rate_to_usd,
        2
      ) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS balance_usd,
      CAST(v.transaction_count AS INT) AS transaction_count,
      v.last_used_at,
      CAST(CASE
        WHEN v.balance_minor = 0
        THEN 'fully_redeemed'
        WHEN v.expires_on < v.valuation_date AND v.redeemed_minor = 0
        THEN 'expired_unused'
        WHEN v.expires_on < v.valuation_date

  ), decline_reasons AS (

    FROM sequenced AS s
    WHERE

  ), classified AS (

        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(d.decline_message, '.*(3ds|authentication|challenge).*')

        ELSE 'other'

      (

    FROM __ref__stg_price_lists
  ), ordered AS (
    SELECT
      p.price_list_id,
      p.sku,
      p.currency_code,
      p.list_amount_minor,
      p.valid_from,
      COALESCE(
        p.valid_to,
        LEAD(p.valid_from) OVER (
          PARTITION BY p.sku, p.currency_code
          ORDER BY p.valid_from NULLS LAST, p.price_list_id NULLS LAST
        )
      ) AS effective_valid_to,
      LAG(p.list_amount_minor) OVER (
        PARTITION BY p.sku, p.currency_code
        ORDER BY p.valid_from NULLS LAST, p.price_list_id NULLS LAST
      ) AS previous_amount_minor,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY p.sku, p.currency_code
        ORDER BY p.valid_from NULLS LAST, p.price_list_id NULLS LAST
      ) AS price_version,
      MIN(p.list_amount_minor) OVER (
        PARTITION BY p.sku, p.currency_code
        ORDER BY p.valid_from NULLS LAST
        RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30' DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) AS lowest_price_30d_minor
    FROM price_lists AS p

    SELECT
      o.price_list_id,
      o.sku,
      o.currency_code,
      o.list_amount_minor,
      o.valid_from,
      o.effective_valid_to,
      CAST(o.previous_amount_minor AS INT) AS previous_amount_minor,

        100 * (

      CAST(o.price_version AS INT) AS price_version,
      CAST(DATEDIFF(o.effective_valid_to, o.valid_from) AS INT) AS days_at_price,
      CAST(o.lowest_price_30d_minor AS INT) AS lowest_price_30d_minor
    FROM ordered AS o
  )

    *
  FROM final

  ), current_prices AS (

    FROM price_history AS ph
    WHERE
      ph.effective_valid_to IS NULL
  ), with_exponent AS (

      w.minor_unit_exponent,

    FROM with_exponent AS w
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT
        *
      FROM fx_rates AS fx
      WHERE
        w.currency_code = fx.currency_code AND w.valuation_date >= fx.rate_date
      ORDER BY

            ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),

            CAST(ROUND(

                r.list_amount_minor / NULLIF((

          CAST(ROUND(

              r.list_amount_minor / NULLIF((
                CAST(POWER(10, r.minor_unit_exponent) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))

            ) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)),

        WHEN (
          SCHEMA_OF_VARIANT(e.spec_value) IN ('TINYINT', 'SMALLINT', 'INT', 'BIGINT')
          OR SCHEMA_OF_VARIANT(e.spec_value) LIKE 'DECIMAL%'
        )
        OR SCHEMA_OF_VARIANT(e.spec_value) IN ('TINYINT', 'SMALLINT', 'INT', 'BIGINT')
        THEN CAST(e.spec_value AS DECIMAL(18, 4))
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(CAST(e.spec_value AS STRING), '(?i)^\\s*[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?\\s*(mm|cm|m)\\s*$')
